jobs.description:
Rollen som matrevisor/underleverandørRollen inkluderer revisjoner hos våre kunder i ulike deler av næringsmiddelindustrien fra jord til bord. Det er en variert jobb med mye reising, hvor kundene befinner seg rundt om i Norge og Skandinavia, men også i andre deler av verden. Vi ser etter underleverandører innen både styringssystem og produktstandarder, som ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000, FSSC, BRC, IFS, GMP+ og MSC/ASCASC. Revisorer er kvalifisert for standarder og spesifikke bransjekoder basert på erfaring, utdanning og interesseområder.

Ansvar for deg som revisjonsleder inkluderer revisjon, rapportering og oppfølging av forbedringsområdene som er definert under revisjonene. Vi bruker hjemmekontor fordi vi har kunder over hele Norge, så vi er fleksible med hensyn til din plassering. Som matrevisor hos oss har du med andre ord stor innflytelse på hvordan arbeidstiden din fordeles og hvor mange oppdrag du er interessert i.

Som underleverandør har du allerede et konsulentselskap eller starter et, og får da oppdrag fra Intertek.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et internasjonalt miljø
  • Evne til å påvirke omfanget av oppgaver
  • Et inkluderende team
  • Kvalifisering innenfor de ulike standardene

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du har akademisk utdanning innen matfaget og minst 5 års arbeidserfaring innen mattrygghet, miljø og bærekraft fra ulike deler av matindustrien
  • Du har god kunnskap om styringssystemer og/eller har fungert som intern/ekstern revisor for mattrygghet, kvalitet og miljø i tidligere roller
  • Har du tidligere jobbet som matrevisor og/eller underleverandør innen matsertifisering, er det ekstra meritterende.
  • Du kan kommunisere på norsk og engelsk muntlig og skriftlig
  • Har førerkort

Vi legger stor vekt på dine personlige egenskaper. Som person er du drevet, pragmatisk, kreativ og lydhør. Du er utadvendt og kommunikativ samtidig som du er vant til selvstendig arbeid. Det kreves en god del initiativ for å takle rollen på en god måte. Videre har du med suksess kjørt og fullført prosjekter der din evne til å tenke helhetlig er testet. Du kan skape og vedlikeholde forretningsrelasjoner og ha en sterk faglig integritet.

Om IntertekMed mer enn 45 000 ansatte over hele verden er vi et av de største selskapene i vår bransje. I vårt daglige arbeid hjelper vi selskaper over hele verden med å sikre at produktene deres er trygge å bruke og oppfyller kundenes og myndighetenes krav til kvalitet og ytelse. Vi gjør dette ved å revidere prosessene deres, sertifisere styringssystemene deres, revidere leverandørene deres, teste, analysere og sertifisere produktene deres, inspisere produksjonsanlegg og forsendelser, og jobbe med råd om regulatoriske, kjemiske og bærekraftige spørsmål.

Hver dag streber vi etter å hjelpe våre kunder med å ha trygge og sosialt ansvarlige produkter og tjenester – Vi bringer kvalitet og sikkerhet til live!

Har vi fanget interessen din?
Velkommen med søknaden din i dag! Utvelgelsen av søknader er løpende, og vi oppfordrer deg derfor til å sende din CV så snart som mulig. Vi kan dessverre ikke behandle søknader via e-post, men søknaden gjøres via lenken.

Eventuelle spørsmål kan besvares av Jesper Nyman, Auditor Manager, .

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Summary

Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers transform the way they run their stores, making operations more data-led, agile and impactful. Using Quorso's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn vast amounts of retail data into clear, actionable insights that influence decisions from store level to the C-suite.

We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now expanding our data capability in the US to support new global growth.

About Quorso

Quorso is one of retail’s most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalised daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we’re scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.

The Opportunity

As an Implementation & Insights Consultant, you’ll sit at the heart of our customer analytics function, helping some of the world’s largest retailers make smarter, faster decisions. You’ll use SQL and BI tools to explore complex operational data, uncover trends, and turn those findings into clear, actionable insights.

You’ll work closely with our Customer, Product and Implementation teams to ensure that the data powering Quorso’s platform is accurate, meaningful, and easy for our clients to act on.

This is an analytical role focused on insight generation - not building data pipelines or warehouses.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with enterprise customer teams to understand business operations and define analytical requirements.

  • Use SQL and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) to analyse large, messy retail datasets and surface meaningful insights.

  • Create dashboards and visualisations that highlight store performance, identify improvement opportunities and measure results.

  • Translate data findings into practical recommendations that drive operational excellence.

  • Collaborate with Product, Customer and Implementation teams to ensure our data stories connect with business priorities.

  • Continuously refine how we interpret and present data, improving clarity, speed and impact for internal teams and clients alike


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years’ experience in BI, analytics or data-driven decision support (ideally within retail, FMCG, or SaaS).

  • Strong SQL and Excel skills, with confidence working directly with complex datasets.

  • Experience creating reports or dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar.

  • An analytical mindset with a genuine curiosity about what data reveals and how it can drive action.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

  • Organised, proactive and comfortable managing multiple projects at once.

  • Collaborative and commercially aware, able to work effectively with both business and technical teams.


Even better if you have

  • Experience working with retail, FMCG or other operational data environments

  • Exposure to data pipelines, ETL processes or data modelling

  • Hands-on experience using data to drive operational change or performance improvement

  • Familiarity with how data flows from source systems into BI tools

  • A track record of influencing decisions or improving processes through data insights


Is this you?

  • You’re data-driven, curious and thrive in fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments.

  • You enjoy solving messy data problems, working directly with stakeholders and turning analysis into measurable impact.

  • You plan strategically but execute precisely, stay calm under pressure and bring a mix of analytical rigour and creative problem-solving to everything you do.


Inclusion matters

At Quorso, inclusion isn’t just a value, it’s a foundation. We’re committed to building diverse, balanced and open teams where everyone can thrive and contribute. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities.

jobs.description:
Olá!

Estamos à procura do futuro Professor(a) de Matemática do Ensino Secundário/Acesso ao Ensino Superior que queira juntar-se a uma equipa que sonha em mudar a forma como as pessoas aprendem.

O setor educativo não consegue evoluir nem aproveitar o poder da tecnologia para maximizar as oportunidades de cada estudante de tirar todo o seu potencial, e é daí que nasce a ideia da Ucademy.

Junta-se a nós?

O nosso objetivo é tornar o caminho dos nossos alunos mais simples, curto e agradável para alcançarem os objetivos que estabeleceram. É simples assim.

Para isso, oferecemos um método de estudo flexível e 100% personalizado através de uma plataforma que aprende com os acertos e erros do aluno para recomendar o caminho a seguir no dia a dia.

Somos 2 engenheiros apaixonados por tecnologia e educação, com vários projetos de empreendedorismo. Há pouco mais de 2 anos, decidimos dar o passo em frente (mais uma vez) e oferecer uma forma diferente de aprender.

Nos nossos primeiros anos:

  • Desenvolvemos uma plataforma totalmente personalizada para que os alunos atinjam os seus objetivos. Este é, claro, o nosso principal objetivo e queremos que você também faça parte dele.

  • Somos uma empresa Great Place to Work (entre as 100 melhores empresas para trabalhar em Espanha em 2023).

  • Ganhámos o prémio de excelência educativa como a melhor academia online de Espanha!

  • Crescemos de 4 para 62 pessoas!

Mas somos muito ambiciosos e não gostamos de nos conformar, por isso, este ano, o desafio é implementar a estratégia de expansão, abrindo escritórios na América Latina e em Portugal, e formar uma comunidade de mais de 12.000 alunos e 1.000 professores.

O que procuramos num Professor(a) de Matemática?

Procuramos alguém com grande vontade de ensinar e de se juntar ao desafio de fazer parte de uma equipa que gosta de assumir riscos, adaptar-se a mudanças e é amante da inovação.

Em poucas palavras, será responsável por ensinar e motivar os nossos alunos do Ensino Secundário no seu novo desafio: a Universidade! Se gosta de explicar, sente-se à vontade com tecnologias e é apaixonado por educação, este é o seu lugar!

A motivação e o compromisso são o nosso motor, por isso procuramos alguém que partilhe essa paixão e entusiasmo pelo que faz. É um deles?

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  1. Criar conteúdo atualizado e de qualidade em formato digital, tanto escrito como gravado, sobre os tópicos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior. Não perdemos o foco no detalhe, por isso consideramos fundamental todas as melhorias que possam ser feitas.

  2. Revisar e atualizar os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior existentes na nossa plataforma. Ser eficiente está no nosso sangue e queremos que você também faça parte disso.

  3. Dar aulas online em direto aos alunos. Tudo o que considerar que pode funcionar para que os alunos sejam mais produtivos e gostem de estudar, será da sua responsabilidade.

  4. Dar apoio aos nossos alunos Ucademy nas suas dúvidas e consultas relacionadas com os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior fornecidos na plataforma, bem como correção de tarefas.

Deve ter excelentes habilidades de comunicação dinâmica, juntamente com a capacidade de priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos estabelecidos. Será uma peça-chave no processo de seleção.

O que esperamos de si?

  1. Experiência prévia como Professor(a) de Matemática de Acesso ao Ensino Superior.

  2. Estar habituado(a) a trabalhar com plataformas tecnológicas e bases de dados.

  3. Experiência a gerar conteúdo digital escrito e, idealmente, conteúdo videográfico.

  4. Como diríamos aqui, "a atitude não é negociável": ter proatividade é indispensável.

  5. Que a motivação e o bom ambiente façam parte do seu ADN, que venha para se divertir e se adapte às mudanças que temos no dia a dia.

  6. Valorizamos que tenha trabalhado previamente em empresas do setor de educação ou tecnologia. Assim, entenderá muito melhor todos os nossos processos!

O que oferecemos?

  1. Total liberdade para decidir, dar opinião e criar. Juntos organizamos o como, você decide o que.

  2. Trabalho 100% remoto!

  3. Contrato de prestação de serviços (freelance/recibos verdes).

  4. Remuneração económica muito competitiva – Explicamos tudo na primeira chamada!

  5. Um excelente ambiente de trabalho numa equipa apaixonada por formação e tecnologia!

jobs.excerpt: Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant?  Don’t worry - you’re not alone.
jobs.description:
Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant? Don’t worry - you’re not alone.

Accounting is stuck in the past.

So, we get stuck doing boring, monotonous work as a small cog in tedious firms, or struggling to make an impact in businesses that don’t really care.

RORA was founded to improve the career options for Accountants. We promise impact, variety and progression. We’re looking for those who crave more - more responsibility and more impact - and want to keep progressing and learning with a group of people just like them.

Sound like you? Read on...

The roleWe’re hiring for a FinOps Analyst to be embedded remotely across multiple UK startups and scaleups. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of each partner, taking care of the accountancy fundamentals, whilst also iterating and improving processes through automation and technology.

Here's what the role looks like:

  • Own finance operations: Oversee finance essentials including bookkeeping, (UK) payroll, month-end processes, VAT, and AP/AR, ensuring accuracy and compliance using Xero and other software.

  • Context switching: Balance working across different startups, projects, and changing priorities with accuracy, ensuring partner expectations are managed.

  • Optimise as you go: Identify and drive improvements in finance processes/controls and support with new tech implementations.

  • Build strong connections: Collaborate closely with RORA's FinOps teams across the UK and India, plus your partners, to innovate and solve challenges collaboratively.

Your experience:

  • A minimum of 3 years experience in finance and accounting

  • Confident running finance processes independently (you MUST have strong knowledge across AP, AR and month end as a minimum)

  • Familiar with UK accounting and tax regulations including VAT and payroll etc

  • Experienced in using cloud software such as Xero (strongly preferred)

  • Excellent level of English (verbal and written)

Your setupYou have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in India, whether at home or a co-working space. Your working environment should be quiet and free from distractions, plus strong and reliable internet in a must! Your working day will need to overlap with GMT standard working hours - we ask for at least 4 hours of your day to coincide with UK hours.

It’s probably not for you if…

  • You crave structure and predictability - we believe in moving fast, iterating on the go and figuring things out for ourselves

  • You prefer direction - startups can be unpredictable, we move and adapt with the changes (that’s the fun part!)

  • You require focus on individual tasks - variety is the spice of RORA life, we effortlessly move between competing priorities.

Life at RORAWe’re committed to providing variety, impact and progression, and we do it better than anywhere else.

Benefits

💰 A starting salary of 15 lakhs pa, increasing to 16 lakhs upon successful completion of probation (Mon-Fri)

⏰ Quarterly feedback and bi-annual progression reviews

💰 Annual profit share

⏱ Flexible working

🏝 Fully flexible holiday (34 days to take whenever you like)

🥂 Virtual and in-person team get-togethers

👩‍💻 Co-working space allowance

🚑 Healthcare cover (on passing probation)

💻 One-time tech allowance

🥗 Monthly lunch allowance

🔎 New to startup/scaleup life? Don’t worry - we’ve created a FinOps Training course just for you.

Meet RORARORA builds fractional Finance teams for startups and scaleups, giving you access to some of the most exciting and innovative businesses in the world. We offer the security of being an employee, the variety of contracting, and the support and development opportunities of a big firm.

We promise transparency and fairness

This applies to both our recruitment process and the way we run the company. We're committed to fostering a diverse, healthy and supportive workplace for all. We’re an equal opportunities employer and we genuinely welcome applications from all backgrounds.

Sound good?Please apply! You can expect the application process to take 5 - 10 minutes - we ask for a little effort upfront when applying and in return we promise that we personally review all applications. Your application answers are carefully assessed so please provide honest and reflective answers that are your own (and not AI generated!) Please note: we do not accept reapplications within 12-months.

P.S. If you’re curious to learn more about RORA, our team handbook contains loads of information about life at RORA.

Lieu de travail : France, à distance

Les participants enregistreront de courtes phrases d’activation et des énoncés scénarisés généralement utilisés lors d’interactions avec un assistant vocal.

Pour participer, vous devez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • Avoir 18 ansou plus.
  • Être né(e) et vivre en France.
  • Être de langue maternelle française (France), de n’importe quelle région de France.
  • Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais car toutes les instructions du projet seront en anglais.
  • Être en mesure d’utiliser un téléphone portable pour ce projet.
  • Pouvoir utiliser un casque filaire ou le microphone de l’appareil pour enregistrer des phrases.
  • Avoir accès à un environnement intérieur calme pour effectuer les enregistrements.

Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous recherchons des participants issus de groupes démographiques spécifiques afin de contribuer au développement d’une technologie impartiale qui soit représentative de tous.

Durée de la tâche :

La durée estimée de la tâche d’enregistrement est de 30 minutes.

Rémunération :

Vous recevrez 33 $ USDpour vos livrables entièrement terminés et acceptés.

Programme général de prime de parrainage

Nous offrons une prime de parrainage de 15 $ USD pour chaque participant que vous recommandez pour l’étude et qui la termine avec succès.

Comment parrainer quelqu’un :

  • Partagez ce lien d’inscription avec vos amis et votre famille
  • Lors de l’inscription, ils doivent répondre « Referral / Recommandation » à la question « Comment avez-vous entendu parler de cette opportunité ? » et indiquer votre nom et votre adresse e-mail dans les champs : Prénom, Nom et adresse e-mail.

Comme mode de paiement, nous proposons le Virement bancaire, PayPalet la Carte cadeau, selon votre préférence.

Veuillez noter que notre équipe d’assurance qualité examinera toutes les soumissions pour s’assurer qu’elles respectent les exigences spécifiques du projet. L’équipe du projet vous enverra des commentaires une fois le processus de contrôle qualité terminé.

Des questions ou des doutes ?

Si vous avez des doutes ou des questions, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à :

DataForce by TransPerfect fait partie de la famille d’entreprises TransPerfect, le plus grand fournisseur mondial de solutions linguistiques et technologiques pour les entreprises internationales, avec des bureaux dans plus de 100 villes à travers le monde. jobs.description:
About the Project

DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.

The goal of this project is to help make technology more accessible for everyone and promote greater inclusion of Deaf and signing communities in the development of future technologies.

We believe that projects involving ASL, BASL, and the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities should include meaningful representation from the communities themselves. Our project team includes Deaf and Hard of Hearing professionals who are directly involved in the administration and development of the project.

Their perspectives help us make informed decisions, advocate for the interests of the community, and ensure that accessibility, cultural considerations, and participant experience are represented throughout the project.

What You’ll Do

Participants will record approximately 1,000 short ASL/BASL videos from home, including phrases, numbers, fingerspelling sequences, and conversational prompts.

Each recording is approximately 10 seconds long. Completing the full set is expected to take approximately 10 hours in total.

The project can be completed remotely from home using a compatible Apple device.

Compensation

$700 USD for completing the project according to the study guidelines.

This is a project-based opportunity and not a full-time employment position.

Who Can Participate

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older

  • Be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL) and/or Black American Sign Language (BASL)

  • Currently reside in the United States, excluding Texas, Illinois, and Washington

  • Be able to understand written English instructions

  • Be comfortable recording yourself on video

  • Have a suitable environment at home for recording

  • Have access to a compatible Apple device:

    • iPhone 12 or newer

    • iPad 9th Generation (2021) or newer

    • MacBook with M1 chip or newer

    • iMac with M1 chip or newer

Why Participate?

Your contribution will help support the development of technologies that better recognize and represent ASL, BASL, and diverse signing communities.

You'll participate entirely from home, complete the recordings on your own schedule according to the project instructions, and receive $700 USD upon successful completion of the project according to the study guidelines.

How to Apply

Click Apply and complete the short application.

Work Location: United States; Remote

We are currently looking for contributors for our Ronia Raw Photo Collection Project.

What is the project about?

We invite photographers, photo hobbyists, visual creators, and anyone passionate about photography to participate in our RAW Photo Collection project.

Do you regularly capture high-quality photos in RAW format to expand your photo library? If the answer is yes, this project allows you to earn extra income by contributing your photos to the development of advanced AI and computer vision technologies. Your images can have a real-world impact beyond your personal library.

Task Description:

Participants may submit both existing photos from their personal archives and newly captured images in RAW format. We’re looking for a wide variety of subjects, styles, lighting conditions, and environments—including nature, events, everyday scenes, objects, and more.

Photos may be captured in RAW and other supported formats using eligible iPhones or digital cameras. Uploading is quick and easy via our mobile app or browser-based data collection tool.

We will be collecting the following types of photos:

  1. RAW Images: individual, unedited images captured directly from the device.

  2. Image Pairs: pairs of identical unedited photos, with specific objects present in one and absent in the other photo.

Accepted Formats:
The photos should be native RAW and DNG where applicable (including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF). These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken.

All submitted photos must be original and taken by you. Photos downloaded from the internet or generated using AI will not be accepted.

Intellectual Property Rights:Participants retain full ownership of all submitted photos, which will be used exclusively for internal purposes by our client and will not be distributed, or published.

Who is eligible?

To participate you should meet the following qualifying criteria:

  • Be 18 years or older.

  • Be a resident of the United States.

  • Be able to upload RAW images or a pair of two images following our instructions.

  • All images should be taken with one of the following devices:

    • iPhone models accepted:

      • 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max

      • 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max

      • 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max

        All accepted iPhone models should run iOS 14.3 or later.

        No other smartphones are permitted.

    • Digital Cameras

      • Full-frame mirrorless

      • Full-frame DSLR

      • APS-C mirrorless

      • APS-C DSL

Where is the project taking place?

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home or preferred location within the US.

Please note the following location-based limitations:

  • Public Images

Public Images are photos taken in publicly accessible places and/or featuring identifiable individuals. We can accept Public Images only if they were captured in the following U.S. states: AL, AK, AZ, AR, FL, GA, HI, ID, KS, LA, ME, MA, MI, MS, MO, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, VT, WV, WI, WY.

  • Non-Public Images

Non-Public Images (for example, photos taken in private settings without public access) are accepted from all U.S. states, except IL, WA, and TX.

Image

How much is the compensation?

You will receive $1.50 USD per each accepted photo. Participants may submit as many photos as they wish across all open categories. Please note that some categories may have submission limits, and once a category is filled, it will be closed. Submissions are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis.

Example earnings:
50 accepted photos x $1,50 = $75 USD

100 accepted photos x $1.50 = $150 USD

Please note that all submissions will be checked by our Quality Assurance team, and compensation will be provided for submitted and accepted photos. The project team will provide you with feedback once the Quality Check process is completed.

As payment methods we offer Wire Transfer, PayPal, Gift Card and Check according to your preference.

Referral Bonus Program
We offer a referral bonus of $15 USD for each participant you refer to the project who submits a minimum of 50 accepted photos.

jobs.title: Development Team Lead
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Open to Australian Candidates only.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Open to Australian Candidates only. You must have full right to work in Australia with no visa requirements

Kyckr is a B2B API platform that gives regulated businesses access to legally authoritative company data from 300+ corporate registries across 120 countries. Our customers are banks, fintechs, and compliance teams who rely on Kyckr to power their Know Your Business (KYB) and AML workflows. Data is sourced in real time from official government registries and delivered through a normalised, machine-readable API.

We were recently named a Category Leader for KYC Data Solutions by Chartis Research. After a year of record growth, we are investing in our engineering team to accelerate delivery of our next-generation Registry Hub architecture.

We are a small, focused engineering team distributed across Australia, Ireland, the UK, and the Philippines. We operate on Azure, run a large .NET monorepo alongside a newer microservices architecture, and are actively adopting AI-assisted development tooling — including Claude Code and GitHub Copilot — as a core part of how we build software.

The Role

We are looking for a Development Team Lead to lead a small team of four developers while remaining a hands-on senior engineer. This is a player-coach role: we anticipate roughly an 80/20 split between writing code and leading the team. You will spend the majority of your time building software, and the rest growing your engineers, unblocking delivery, and raising the technical bar.

You will be one of our most senior technical contributors — setting the standard for code quality, design, and AI-assisted ways of working — at the same time as owning the line management and career development of your team. You will report directly to the CTO and work closely with them on technical direction, delivery, and team growth.

Two areas matter especially for this role. First, agentic AI for coding: we are not experimenting at the edges — Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows are central to how we build, and we want a leader who can drive that adoption from the front. Second, product integrations: a large part of our value is connecting reliably to corporate registries and third-party data sources worldwide, and to our customers’ systems, so deep, practical integration experience is important.

The right person is an excellent engineer who genuinely enjoys developing people, communicates clearly in a distributed team, and is energised by working in a domain where data quality has real regulatory consequences.

What You’ll Be Doing

Hands-On Engineering (the majority of your time)

Spend most of your time writing clean, testable, production code in .NET (C#) and SQL Server across our monorepo and newer Registry Hub services — leading by example, not from the sidelines.

Take on the most complex and ambiguous technical work, and set the standard for design, code quality, and testing across the team.

Own significant features and services end-to-end, from design through delivery and operation.

Lead architecture and design discussions, making pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions and clearly communicating the trade-offs.

Agentic AI for Coding

Drive the team’s use of Claude Code and agentic development and QA workflows — for code generation, refactoring, test writing, code review, automated regression checking, and code analysis.

Define and continuously improve the prompt engineering practices, agent configurations, and guardrails that let the team build faster without compromising quality.

Evaluate and introduce new AI tooling as the landscape evolves, and help the wider engineering organisation adopt what works.

Establish how we measure the impact of AI-assisted development on velocity and quality, and use that to guide adoption.

Product Integrations

Lead the design and delivery of integrations with third-party registry APIs and data sources, handling the complexity of varied data formats and reliability characteristics across 120 countries.

Own the patterns for resilient, observable, and maintainable integrations — retries, error handling, rate limiting, and monitoring.

Work with product and customer-facing teams to deliver integrations into customers’ systems and workflows that solve real compliance problems.

Team Leadership & People Management

Line-manage a team of four developers, including regular one-to-ones, performance management, and active career development and growth planning.

Mentor and coach engineers, giving and receiving constructive feedback through code review and day-to-day collaboration.

Own your team’s delivery — planning, prioritisation, and removing blockers — in partnership with product and the CTO.

Foster a pragmatic, high-trust, high-ownership engineering culture and help recruit and onboard new engineers as the team grows.

Delivery, Quality & Collaboration

Champion strong engineering practices: meaningful tests, safe and repeatable deployments through our Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and continuous improvement.

Work asynchronously with a distributed team across three time zones, using Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and Jira.

Document technical decisions, architecture, and runbooks clearly — good written communication matters in a remote team.

Collaborate with product, compliance, and customer success to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real-world needs.


Requirements

We are looking for 7–10 years of hands-on software development experience, including time spent leading or mentoring other engineers. You don’t need to have held a formal “Team Lead” title before, but you should be ready to combine deep, current technical contribution with real responsibility for a team. You don’t need to have worked in FinTech or RegTech specifically, but you should be comfortable building production services where reliability and security matter.

Essential

7–10 years of professional software development experience, with strong, current hands-on skills in .NET / C#.

Solid experience with SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, and relational data modelling.

Proven experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party systems and data sources.

Demonstrable experience leading, mentoring, or line-managing engineers — and a genuine interest in developing people and their careers.

Hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar), and enthusiasm for making it central to how a team works.

Strong system design and architecture judgement, with the ability to make and clearly explain pragmatic trade-offs.

Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills across a distributed system.

Strong written and verbal communication for a remote, distributed team.

Comfortable balancing hands-on delivery with leadership responsibilities (an 80/20 coding-to-leadership split).

Nice to Have

Experience configuring or operating agentic AI workflows for development or QA at a team level.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure Functions, App Services, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Key Vault, APIM).

Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Azure DevOps, YAML pipelines, automated deployments).

Experience with message-driven and event-driven architectures (Azure Service Bus, queues).

Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and Kubernetes.

Front-end experience with React or other modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

Experience working in a regulated industry (FinTech, HealthTech, GovTech, or similar).


Benefits

Our engineering team is distributed across Australia, Ireland, the UK, and the Philippines. We work asynchronously by default, using Microsoft Teams, Azure DevOps, Confluence, and Jira to coordinate. The CTO is UK-based, and you will have a regular, collaborative working relationship with them.

We are a pragmatic team. We prefer well-considered decisions over process for its own sake. We document our architecture in Confluence, use Miro for diagrams, and write diagrams inline where appropriate. We are actively improving our engineering practices — including metrics, better CI/CD, and more consistent Infrastructure-as-Code — and every engineer contributes to that effort.

We use Claude Code as our AI coding assistant and are building out agentic workflows for development and QA. We take a practical, incremental approach to AI adoption — this is not theoretical experimentation. It is how we are choosing to build software, and we want a leader who is excited to take that further.

What We Offer

A genuine player-coach role — stay deeply technical while leading and growing a team.

Remote-first working with flexibility over your schedule.

Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

Direct access to technical leadership and real influence over how the platform and team evolve.

A small, experienced team with low bureaucracy and high trust.

A genuinely interesting platform: real-time data from 120 countries, complex legacy systems being modernised, and a clear architectural direction.

AI-first development culture — you will lead the team in using cutting-edge AI tooling as a core part of how we build, not as a side project.

DATA ANALYST

Department: Finance and Administration

JOB SUMMARY

One More Child is seeking to employ a full-time Data Analyst to support its mission of impacting vulnerable children and struggling families through the collection, integration, analysis, forecasting, and visualization of organizational data. The Data Analyst will bridge the gap between raw data and actionable intelligence by leveraging Microsoft Fabric's unified analytics platform to transform data into strategic insights that improve decision-making across fundraising, finance, program operations, and organizational leadership.

This position will be responsible for analyzing data from multiple sources, developing semantic data models, identifying trends and opportunities, conducting predictive analysis, and delivering interactive Power BI dashboards that translate data into meaningful business insights. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, advanced Microsoft Fabric and Power BI expertise, and the ability to communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS

  • Design and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and scorecards using Power BI
  • Monitor Fabric data pipelines and datasets and extend semantic models.
  • Perform trend analysis, forecasting, and predictive analytics to support organizational planning and decision-making.
  • Maintain reliable reporting systems that include data from multiple legacy organizational systems and new data systems as needed; identify inaccurate or inconsistent data and work with appropriate departments to cleanse data and resolve underlying issues.
  • Utilize SQL, Power BI, and Fabric analytics tools to identify insights, opportunities, risks, and performance trends.
  • Develop and support machine learning and predictive models using Microsoft Fabric Data Science tools, Spark and/or Python.
  • Maintain and respond to automated monitoring, alerts, and reporting solutions using Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, KPIs, and analytical needs.
  • Develop report wireframes, mockups, or prototypes to validate layout, metrics, filters, and user experience prior to dashboard development.
  • Present data-driven recommendations and insights to leadership and department teams.
  • Support data governance, data quality, security, and reporting best practices across the organization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Helpline Contact Center Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
jobs.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

In 1957, The Medical Foundation (TMF) was created to primarily fund biomedical research in Massachusetts. Since then, we’ve been on a journey of evolution. We changed our name to Health Resources in Action (HRiA) to reflect our impact in the field of public health. Today, HRiA works with individuals, organizations, and communities to drive a policy and systems change approach to advance health and racial equity.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 270 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

As part of our Public Health Services, HRiA manages an extensive portfolio of behavioral health initiatives, including statewide substance use helplines in Vermont and Oregon and substance use and problem gambling helplines in Massachusetts and Illinois. The Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) was launched in 2017, building upon our experience operating the MA Substance Use Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Bureau of Substance Addiction Services) for over 23 years. HRiA launched the Vermont Helplink (Vermont Department of Health, Division of Substance Use Programs) in 2019. HRiA began operating the MA Problem Gambling Helpline (Massachusetts Department of Public Health, Office of Problem Gambling Services) in 2020 and the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline (Illinois Department of Human Services, Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery) in 2022. In December 2023, HRiA launched the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline, now the Oregon Hopeline (Oregon Health Authority).

The Helpline contact center is the hub for the Helplines. Screening & Information Specialists (SIS) comprise most of the contact center team and respond to incoming Helpline inquiries. Four Contact Center Supervisors provide Helpline services and provide direct supervision to a portion of the SIS team. Three Masters-level Clinicians supervise a portion of the SIS, implement follow-up services, and provide additional coverage and support. Additional Helpline team members deliver and support program operations, marketing and communication, web management, and data analysis and management, supervision, and leadership. The larger team is overseen by the Managing Director, Behavioral Health.

To learn more about HRiA and our helplines, visit the following:

  • HRiA:
  • IL Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • MA Problem Gambling Helpline:
  • IL Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances:
  • VT Helplink: www.VTHelplink.org
  • MA Substance Use Helpline:
  • Oregon Hopeline:

Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team on the Oregon Recovery Center Hotline (Oregon Hopeline), Massachusetts Substance Use & Problem Gambling Helplines (MA Helpline), the Illinois Helpline for Opioids and Other Substances (IL Helpline), the Illinois Problem Gambling Helpline, and the Vermont Helplink (VT Helplink). This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly developed position to support substance use treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

Position Description

We are seeking a full-time Helpline Contact Center Supervisor to join our team for the MA Helpines, the IL Helplines, and VT Helplink. We refer to these projects collectively as “the Helplines.” This is an exciting opportunity to support substance use treatment and problem gambling treatment access across three states and supervise a diverse team of staff.

The Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for handling incoming Helpline inquiries and providing supervisory support to the contact center team. A portion of their time is providing scheduled and as-needed Helpline coverage, in addition to our dedicated team of 22 Screening & Information Specialists (SIS). This includes responding to incoming calls, online chats, and SMS text messages from people seeking information about and help with accessing substance use and/or problem gambling services for themselves, a family member or friend, and/or a client. In this capacity, they assess Helpline users’ needs, determine the most appropriate substance use prevention, treatment, and/or recovery support service options, identify available options (through the Helplines’ databases), and refer callers to those services. They provide accurate information, education, support, and referrals in a non-judgmental, respectful, and culturally competent manner.

About half of their time, Contact Center Supervisors provide supervisory support to the SIS team. Each Supervisor acts as a shift supervisor for SIS while they are working. This includes monitoring SIS consumer interactions, consulting with SIS and intervening during difficult interactions, and addressing any urgent issues as well as supporting the social-emotional wellbeing of staff and fostering their skill-building and professional growth. The Contact Center Supervisor will provide on-going training to SIS through periodic in-service trainings on relevant topics and will assist in the onboarding of new SIS.

Each Supervisor also directly supervises up to six SIS team members. This includes providing bi-weekly supervision, processing timesheets, and assisting with schedule coordination. (SIS also receive regular, group-level supervision from one of our Clinicians.) Contact Center Supervisors are responsible for supporting contact center operations, including helping to coordinate a 24/7 coverage schedule, staffing, and technology needs. They are the liaisons between the contact center team and information technology (IT) support. The Contact Center Supervisor will also be called upon to contribute expertise to the development of policies, procedures, protocols, and curricula to support the Helplines, and may be engaged in providing this expertise to other HRiA teams and projects focused on substance use, problem gambling, and/or behavioral health equity.

This is a full-time, remote position with a salary range of $57,000 to $64,000 based on skills and experience. Supervisors will receive training to assess the needs of Helpline users, provide appropriate information and referrals to services, and engage with and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals. They will also receive training on Contact Center operations, supervision essentials, and addiction, screening, treatment services, and resources.

Benefits

HRiA offers strong benefits to its employees, including:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Health insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Flexible summer hours
  • Vacation starting at four weeks
  • 13 paid holidays, and office closure at the end of December

Duties and Responsibilities

Management

  • Coordinate and implement projects related to contact center operations, including technology, equipment, onboarding & training, among others, as assigned.
  • Work with Helpline Management to coordinate Helpline staffing schedules to ensure continuous 24-hour staffing coverage.
  • Serve as liaison between SIS and other project and organizational teams, to ensure appropriate representation and facilitate team integration.
  • Supervise up to six SIS.
  • Participate in on-call rotation.

Project Work

  • Troubleshoot technical contact center issues, and serve as liaison to IT support.
  • Assist with coordination and implementation of onboarding and professional development activities.
  • Assess the needs of Helpline users by telephone, online chat, and SMS texting.
  • Provide appropriate information and referrals to substance use, problem gambling, and/or related services.
  • Engage and motivate Helpline users to follow through on referrals by using active listening and motivational interviewing techniques.
  • Obtain feedback on interactions with Helpline users.
  • Gather and record data from Helpline users in Helpline database.
  • Verify Helpline users’ insurance status, as applicable.
  • Escalate Helpline user interactions to Helpline Managers as needed.
  • Represent the Helpline at outreach events, meetings, and/or presentations as needed.

Thought Leadership

  • Continue to build and develop expertise in substance use disorders, problem gambling, and behavioral health equity.
  • Suggest ideas/improvements through participation in teams and committees.
  • Attend and actively participate in Helpline meetings and other activities to develop skills and make suggestions for project enhancements.

New Business Development

  • Maintain updated resume and bio for use in new business proposals.
  • Assist with technical components of new business proposals as needed.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Five years of related experience (lived or professional) in the fields of substance use, recovery, problem gambling, and/or harm reductions Services, and manage mentor bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or related field in lieu of experience.
  • Certified Resource Specialist (through Inform USA) preferred or willingness to obtain certification (at HRiA expense) within one year of hire.
  • Demonstrated experience and ability to supervise staff, and provide appropriate guidance, feedback, mentorship, and support.
  • Experience in information and referral services, customer service, counseling, substance use, problem gambling, or human services required.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in work environment and expectations.
  • Customer/consumer focused with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Good computer skills and experience and/or ability to use online systems and databases.
  • Openness to information that may be different from personal views.
  • Willingness to work with consumers who may be ambivalent, resistant, impaired or have psychological disorders.
  • Must be open to providing information about a variety of treatment options and paths to recovery based on a caller’s needs.
  • Must be respectful of cultural differences and value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives.
  • Must have high ethical standards and a willingness to comply with professional expectations.
  • Demonstrated history of dependability needed.
  • Two years of sobriety requested for people in recovery.
  • Fluency in a language other than English (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin) is a plus.

Hours for this position will be non-traditional, requiring either early morning or late evening and weekend availability. The position includes weekend or overnight on-call duties. The Helplines are open 24 hours/day, 7 days/week, 365 days a year.

This description is intended to indicate the kinds of work duties that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under his/her supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

Position Title: Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage

Position Location:Remote - workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

Salary

DLB recognizes salary ranges from jobboardsdo not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

DLB is expanding its energy storage engineering services and is seeking a Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage to support and help grow this practice. This roleis responsible forthe engineering delivery of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections across utility, renewable, data center, and industrial markets, from concept through construction, commissioning, and energization.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage will provide technical input, support engineering decisions, and represent the firm with clients, utilities, and partners. This position is hands-on, blending detailed engineering execution with quality-focused delivery and support of business growth.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage works with a high degree of independence on day-to-day work and receives general direction on new projects, tasks, or assignments. Will execute projects, tasks, or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage will communicate andoperatein line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectives.

Essential Functions

Energy Storage Engineering (40%)

Perform detailed design, analysis, and engineering of BESS, microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) systems, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, utility requirements, industry standards,codesand regulations
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate BESS and IBR designs seamlessly into larger electrical systems, including substation, generation, and grid interconnection infrastructure
  • Support technical scoping, design, and utility/developer coordination for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections at the medium- and high-voltage level, including protection philosophy, interconnection studies, and compliance with IEEE 1547 / IEEE 2800

Reporting (10%)

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Intermediate to Advanced level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of medium- and high-voltage electrical systems including BESS, microgrid, and IBR configurations, protection & control philosophies, and utility-scale grounding and electrical safety design
  • Knowledge of various electrical topologies and distribution systems
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards, specifically NESC, NEC, NFPA (including NFPA 855 for battery energy storage systems), ANSI, and utility interconnection standards, along with IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 (interconnection of inverter-based resources), IEEE 1584 (arc flash), IEEE 519 (harmonics), and IEEE 80 (substation grounding grid design), with ability to apply requirements through code analysis and system design.

  • Strong working knowledge of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), microgrids, and inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection requirements, including protection coordination, anti-islanding/transfer trip schemes, and utility interconnection processes (LGIA/SGIA)

  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet tight deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability toleverageAI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows,optimizeoperational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements

  • Experience supporting engineering delivery on medium- to high-voltage BESS, microgrid, or IBR interconnection projects, including in an engineer-of-record support capacity.

  • Direct experience navigating LGIA/SGIA processes and utility interconnection requirements.

  • Direct, hands-on experience on at least one BESS, microgrid, or inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection project, from interconnection application/study through protection design and commissioning.
  • Working knowledge of IEEE 2800 and/or IEEE 1547 interconnection standards for inverter-based resources.

Benefits

jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.
