At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
As we scale into new products, partners, geographies, and channels, we need an exceptional leader to own the strategy of how our servicing operating model evolves globally. In this role you'll set the customer operations strategy for a portfolio of complex, cross-functional expansion programs, lead a team of program and process managers, and be accountable for adapting the servicing model to new and differentiated products across markets. In addition, you will be the leader who represents operations across international business teams providing transparency into performance and partnering across product, engineering, and operations to help drive continuous improvement in service delivery for international customers. The ideal candidate pairs strong business acumen and judgment with the ability to lead teams, shape ambiguous problem spaces into clear operating plans, and influence senior partners across the company. A deep passion for growing international businesses and working to understand the localization needs for customer experience and being able to implement with scale and efficiency will be key.

This role requires deep expertise in the customer/merchant servicing space and a strong grounding in financial services. You'll own a portfolio that spans a multitude of international servicing landscapes — launching, testing and learning in operations, and scaling geo expansions, new product scaling, and new channel expansion — and you'll build the standards, methods, and team that make those programs repeatable at global scale via playbooks.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for how Customer Operations scales to support global expansion — new products, merchants/partners, geo launches, and channels — translating ambiguous, undefined business direction into structured programs and clear operating plans.
  • Establish and modify the team's operational objectives, policies, procedures, and work plans; define the methods, frameworks, and success criteria used to run initiatives across regions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning two or more disciplines (e.g., program management and service delivery via process/continuous improvement); oversee professionals and, where applicable, other people leaders; delegate assignments and ensure effective execution.
  • Drive the strategy and success of large-scale, cross-area programs for operations— merchant/geo launches, automation and efficiency programs, new-product scaling — managing scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, and risk across a complex, multi-market servicing landscape.
  • Partner in lock step with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Risk, Training, Knowledge, and Service Delivery leads to run cross-functional discovery and scoping, coordinate planning, and oversee dependencies through the full program lifecycle.
  • Build alignment across mid- to senior-level leaders cross-functionally; influence outcomes in complex or sensitive situations while strengthening those relationships.
  • Own portfolio-level governance (working groups, weekly/monthly business reviews) to drive awareness, issue resolution, and decision-making; be accountable for decisions that affect team, program, and overall business results over a medium-term (1yr+) horizon and that can carry company-wide effects.
  • Own post-launch operational performance for the global international operations portfolio and set up rituals and roles to support global business teams with transparent performance and improvement plans across servicing and operations.
  • Serve as a recognized subject-matter expert and thought leader on the global servicing operating model; build networks and represent Customer Operations on broader, organization-wide initiatives.
  • Champion an analytical, data-driven culture within the team and across Product, Analytics, Engineering, and the broader business.
  • Develop communication and change-management plans for the portfolio, and own the processes for logging and tracking risks, issues, actions, and dependencies.
  • Represent the unique customer servicing needs of global customers at scale across core operations.

What We Look For

  • 12+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading teams and/or managing other managers or senior professionals.
  • Experience building and scaling global customer experience operations and working in global environments across cultures and geographies.
  • Deep program and process management expertise (PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus), with a track record of defining methods and standards — not just applying them.
  • Broad, cross-disciplinary expertise and a strong understanding of how the wider organization and market operate, complemented by deep functional knowledge of customer care, fraud, and/or merchant operations (processes, systems, and key metrics).
  • Strong knowledge of how shared services operate; experience in services, operations, and/or sales.
  • Experience delivering programs across multiple geographies or markets strongly preferred; consumer lending or financial services background strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to work on unique, poorly defined problems that lack strategic direction — evaluating intangibles, applying conceptual thinking, and creating the approach and evaluation criteria.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build alignment among diverse, senior stakeholders in complex or sensitive situations.
  • Sound judgment to make discretionary decisions with significant latitude, balancing research, creativity, and business impact.
  • Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency, accountability, and results orientation, and a genuine enthusiasm for developing people and building new capabilities.

The Principal Data Enterprise Architect is a senior strategic leader responsible for defining and executing the enterprise data strategy and architecture, guiding the transformation from fragmented, point-to-point integrations to a modern, domain-driven data product model. You will establish the target architecture, define data products and systems of record, and create a clear roadmap to migrate consumers from legacy data assets to trusted, governed data solutions. By driving alignment across business and technology teams, modernizing data integration patterns, and establishing governance and standards, you will reduce duplication, improve data quality, and enable scalable, high-value data capabilities that support digital, analytics, and AI outcomes.

The Principal Data Enterprise Architect is a senior strategic leader responsible for defining and driving the enterprise data architecture vision, strategy, and roadmap. You will lead the transformation from fragmented, point-to-point data integrations to a modern, scalable data product model that delivers trusted, governed, and reusable data aligned to business domains.

This architect will partner with business and technology leaders to establish clear data ownership, reduce duplication, improve data quality, and enable consistent, enterprise-wide data consumption to support digital, analytics, and AI initiatives.

This position falls within our Individual Contributor career pathway, and it will not manage any direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define Enterprise Data Strategy & Architecture

    • Establish and evangelize the enterprise data vision, principles, and target architecture aligned to business strategy

    • Design the transition from legacy point-to-point integrations to domain-aligned data products

  • Drive Data Product Operating Model

    • Partner with Data Governance Office to define standards for data products, including ownership, lifecycle, quality, and consumption models

    • Establish clear systems of record and authoritative data sources across domains

  • Develop and Execute Transformation Roadmap

    • Build a prioritized, multi-year roadmap to modernize data platforms and integrations

    • Sequence migration of consumers from legacy data assets to modern data products

  • Lead Enterprise Data Modernization

    • Drive adoption of scalable, event-driven, and real-time data patterns to reduce duplication and latency

    • Evaluate and guide selection of data platforms, tools, and integration technologies

  • Governance and Standards

    • Partner with Data Governance Office to establish enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and metrics to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance

    • Partner with security, legal, and compliance teams to align with regulatory requirements

  • Stakeholder Alignment & Change Leadership

    • Align business and IT leaders on data ownership, priorities, and adoption strategies

    • Drive enterprise-wide adoption and migration to new data products through strong influence and communication

  • Mentorship & Leadership

    • Provide architectural leadership and mentoring across data, integration, and domain architecture teams

    • Promote best practices and build enterprise-wide data architecture capabilities


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise or data architecture, with deep expertise in data architecture and strategy

  • Proven leadership in large-scale data transformation initiatives (data platforms, integrations, or migrations)

  • Demonstrated ability to define enterprise roadmaps and execute across complex organizations

  • Expertise in data governance, data modeling, and systems of record

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARYCordia is seeking a senior-level leader to lead and operationalize the AIM (AI Impact & Modernization) program across the enterprise.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Cordia is seeking a senior-level leader to lead and operationalize the AIM (AI Impact & Modernization) program across the enterprise. AIM is Cordia's enterprise AI enablement program designed to accelerate productivity, improve operational performance, and enable innovation while maintaining strong governance and data protection. This role leads, but does not solely own Cordia's AI transformation. Working through the broader AIM team and business stakeholders listed in the Key Relationships section, this person helps make AI a successful part of the fabric of every function in the business. The role drives AI governance, enterprise adoption, and business value realization by building a structured, scalable approach to AI usage, use case delivery, and workforce enablement

This person serves as the bridge between IT, cybersecurity, data, operations, and all business functions, ensuring AI is deployed securely, compliantly, and strategically. Because the role interacts with large segments of the business, it has the opportunity to make a meaningful, visible impact across Cordia. This hire reports directly to the CIO. The role is initially an individual contributor with enterprise-wide influence and a path to expanded scope including data governance and agentic AI solutions

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

AI Governance & Risk Management

  • Own and evolve Cordia’s AI governance framework aligned to the AIM charter and Cordia AI Policy (v2.0, effective July 15, 2025)
  • Enforce AI Acceptable Use Policy including disclosure requirements, approved tool usage, ethical standards (fairness, equity, privacy, accountability, human oversight), and data protection standards
  • Manage the approved tools list: evaluate new tools against data privacy, enterprise security (SSO, RBAC, audit logging, data residency), cost/value, integration, and vendor viability criteria
  • Partner with cybersecurity team on Digital Loss Prevention (DLP) controls, monitoring, shadow AI detection, and security architecture review
  • Maintain visibility into AI tool usage across the enterprise; identify and mitigate shadow AI risk (Risk R-01 in charter risk register: High Probability / High Impact)
  • Ensure alignment with Zero Trust and enterprise identity controls, especially for agentic AI solutions requiring strict identity access controls
  • Support the RACI decision authority matrix: IT Directors Responsible, CIO Accountable for approved tools list changes, AI policy updates, and platform evaluation

Enterprise AI Enablement & Adoption

  • Lead enterprise rollout of AI capabilities across Copilot Pro, Salesforce Einstein, NetSuite AI, NSAW, Monday.com AI, Aveva PI/Twin Thread, and future approved platforms
  • Design and execute the three-tier workforce enablement strategy:

Tier 1 – Enterprise AI Literacy: All office-based employees (field-based staff opt-in). AI concepts, Acceptable Use Policy, hands-on Copilot Pro, data protection practices Tier 2 – Role-Based Enablement: Targeted training for functional teams (finance, operations, customer, HR). Use case workshops tailored to departmental workflows Tier 3 – Power User & Advanced Enablement: Advanced prompt engineering, multi-model usage, use case development, AI champion certification and peer training

  • Ensure all training is branded as Cordia University content per corporate training committee guidance
  • Identify and empower AI Champions across business units for peer training, use case evangelism, and feedback loops
  • Drive meaningful adoption of approved AI tools across licensed users and business functions
  • Build a culture of responsible AI use aligned with Cordia Beliefs: Safety, Talent, Value, Collaboration, Accountability, Customers, Sustainability

Use Case Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end AI use case lifecycle: Intake → Screening → Prioritize → Pilot → Measure → Scale
  • Manage the formal intake process: receive submissions via AI Forum or intake form, screen for feasibility and policy compliance, assign business owners, define KPIs and success criteria
  • Apply prioritization scoring: Business Impact (High), Scalability (High), Data Readiness (Medium), Risk (Medium), Effort to Pilot (Low-Medium), Strategic Alignment (Medium)
  • Execute the pilot framework: Define → Build → Test → Measure → Decide (go/no-go at pilot close)
  • Enforce scale criteria: KPIs met or exceeded, business owner confirms value, security/compliance validated, operational support model defined, budget and licensing implications approved
  • Focus areas: operations, finance and corporate, customer and commercial functions
  • Balance individual empowerment with governance guardrails and tool access, not permission-based gatekeeping for every task

AI Operating Model & Program Management

  • Stand up and run the enterprise AI operating model:

◦ AI Forum: Monthly cross-functional meetings with ad-hoc sessions, supported by Viva Engage ◦ IT Leadership Team (ILT): Weekly execution oversight, resource allocation, issue resolution ◦ ELT Reporting: Quarterly program status, value realization, and strategic alignment review

  • Maintain reporting cadence: Program Dashboard (monthly/IT), Executive Report (quarterly/ELT), Use Case Scorecards (per pilot), AI Forum Updates (monthly/all employees)
  • Execute the three-phase roadmap: Phase 1 Launch & Foundation (Q2–Q3 2026), Phase 2 Pilot Expansion (Q3–Q4 2026), Phase 3 Scale & Optimize (Q1–Q2 2027)
  • Manage the AIM communication plan including three-part launch email series and ongoing Viva Engage communities
  • Coordinate with Program Coordinator and Administrative Support on scheduling, communications, and logistics
  • Follow Cordia’s standard change management process for scope, timeline, or budget changes via Monday.com form, assessed against Quality/Cost/Timing triangle

Solutions Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Lead AI platform evaluation driven by three objectives: broader model access (multi-LLM: OpenAI, Claude, etc.), enterprise-grade security and governance, and cost optimization (Copilot price increases effective July 2026)
  • Ensure integration with Cordia’s technology ecosystem: Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Fiix, Salesforce, NSAW, Monday.com, Dayforce, Aveva PI, and cybersecurity tools (ReliaQuest, SentinelOne)
  • Pursue standardization: fewer platforms, not more make a clear standardization decision and prevent tool fragmentation
  • Coordinate with Data & Analytics team on platform readiness and data integration across enterprise systems
  • Influence design of scalable, secure AI solutions including agentic AI architectures with proper identity access controls and validated data sets
  • Minimize data duplication, maintain governance, and support the data foundation strategy across all integration decisions

Data Foundation Alignment

  • Ensure AI initiatives are built on Cordia’s data foundation. AI effectiveness is directly constrained by data quality
  • Partner with data team on data quality, ownership, and stewardship as prerequisites for AI scaling
  • Support NSAW integration: data from NetSuite ERP, EDM, built-in connectors (Salesforce, Google Analytics), custom integrations (CSV files), and other connections (Monday, Fiix, Dayforce)
  • Align with Cordia IT Data Management & Governance Plan: SDLC, Change Control Board (CCB) process, data catalog, coding standards, and cybersecurity alignment
  • Champion the evolution from current "System Provider" model to a "Business Enabler" model that democratizes analytics through self-service capabilities
  • Manage unstructured data initiatives to make more organizational information searchable and usable for AI

Stakeholder Engagement & Coordination

  • Serve as the primary liaison between IT enablement and business execution across all functions
  • Coordinate with Operations on AI/ML energy efficiency initiatives (chilled water optimization, extension to other sites) to share learnings, avoid duplication, and ensure governance alignment
  • Engage with KKR portfolio-level AI initiatives (OpenAI/ChatGPT Enterprise, SkanAI) as applicable
  • Manage external partner relationships
  • Support Energy Center communication: translate AIM updates, training expectations, and relevant use cases for site-level and field-based employees

GROWTH PATH:

This role starts as a senior individual contributor with direct CIO reporting line and enterprise-wide influence. Within 12–24 months, scope may expand to include:

  • Enterprise data governance and data management leadership
  • Dedicated resources for agentic AI solutions (automation, digital workers, department-specific agents)
  • Team build-out: AI engineers/analysts, data governance resources, AI compliance/risk support
  • This is a build-from-scratch opportunity to define how Cordia scales AI across the enterprise. The program transitions from project mode to sustained operating capability as AI governance becomes embedded in standard IT operations and the use case lifecycle becomes routine.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 8–12+ years in IT, data, or digital transformation roles with cross-functional program leadership
  • Proven experience standing up governance programs (AI, data, or IT governance)
  • Strong understanding of generative AI capabilities, enterprise architecture, and cybersecurity/risk frameworks
  • Experience managing use case pipelines, pilot programs, and measuring business outcomes with defined KPIs
  • Proven ability to influence senior leadership and drive enterprise-wide adoption at scale
  • Experience with change management and workforce enablement in technology programs
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating vendor contracts, with familiarity in key contract provisions, vendor onboarding, relationship management, performance monitoring, and issue resolution
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, and analytics platform strategy

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Copilot, NetSuite Analytics Warehouse (NSAW), Oracle Autonomous Database, or enterprise analytics ecosystems
  • Familiarity with multi-model AI environments (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, etc.)
  • Exposure to agentic AI, automation, and digital worker architectures
  • Experience in energy, utilities, district energy, infrastructure, or private equity portfolio companies
  • Change management
  • PMP or program management certification

Cordia Belief How This Role Delivers Safety Enforce governed AI usage, acceptable use policy, and data protection across the enterprise Talent Enable and upskill employees with AI literacy and role-based training through Cordia University Value Prioritize AI use cases that create measurable business value Collaboration Foster cross-functional engagement through the AI Forum and use case sharing Accountability Define clear ownership for use cases, governance, and business outcomes Customers Improve service delivery through AI-enhanced operations and decision-making Sustainability Protect our environment, systems, and data through responsible AI practices

FEDlogic:

FEDlogic is a people-first benefits navigation company dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex landscape of federal and state benefits. As the only vendor in the country providing unbiased education and advocacy on all federal and state benefits, FEDlogic stands out in its mission to ensure no one misses out on the benefits they are entitled to.

We partner with employers to help their employees and families understand and access federal and state programs. Our experts provide confidential, unbiased guidance that lowers healthcare costs, reduces financial stress, and improves well-being. By bridging the gap between government programs and workplace benefits, FEDlogic delivers meaningful impact for employees while helping employers manage risk, reduce costs, and strengthen their benefits offering.

Job Description

Title: Client Success Manager

Location: Fully Remote (with travel)

Employment Type: Full Time

Reports To: Director of Client Engagement, Exec Vice President of Client Success

Position Overview:
FEDlogic is seeking a strategic and client-focused Client Success Manager; this rolel play a pivotal role in nurturing and expanding our client relationships. This role will serve as a liaison between our company and our valued clients, ensuring their needs are understood, addressed, and exceeded. This role requires exceptional communication skills, strategic thinking, and a customer-centric approach. The Client Success Manager will play a critical role in maintaining FEDlogic's reputation for unparalleled service while working to enhance client retention and engagement. Key performance indicators will include, but shall not be limited to, the following: (1) Client engagement; (2) Client satisfaction; and (3) Client retention.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, offering comprehensive support to the client, with no initially assigned clients, while serving as a key point of contact.
  • Understand client needs and offer tailored solutions.
  • Collaborate internally to develop strategies for increased engagement.
  • Communicate with clients regularly through various channels, including meetings and reports.
  • Act as the client’s advocate, ensuring their needs are met and issues are resolved proactively.
  • Occasionally, present “pitch” deck presentations to potential clients. Assist Client Development with prospective client presentations and communications.
  • Forecast intervention needs by utilizing data and reporting.
  • Complete administrative work by onboarding clients into customer relationship management system (CRM), building out client profiles and ensuring data in the CRM system is accurate and complete.
  • Contribute to a positive, supportive, and collaborative team environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support client satisfaction and business growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong communication, business acumen, platform, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to translate client requirements into actionable strategies and solutions.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, HubSpot, Salesforce, Tableau and Slack
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, health administration or related field.
  • Customer Service experience preferred.
  • Would prefer candidates to have previous experience in the benefits and insurance industries.

What we Offer:

  • Flexible remote work environment
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) plus all federal holidays off
  • Comprehensive benefits package with health, dental, vision insurance group term life, short term disability, long term disability and voluntary life plans. Numerous supplemental plans to assist employees.
  • Paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave.
  • Cancer Experts Now - supplemental plan
  • 401(k) with matching contributions.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing company dedicated to making a difference in the lives of families.

Travel:

  • Up to 25% travel per year for client meetings and engagements, both local and occasional out-of-town.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veterans status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: About CardiffCardiff lends to small businesses.  Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between.
jobs.description:
About Cardiff

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

Location: Remote (U.S.)

Employment Type: Full-time

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Managing Partner

Why This Role Matters

Cardiff's edge is how quickly we can convert a lead into a funded customer. Today our average turnaround is 24 business hours; our goal is minutes, through automated systems with human-in-the-loop oversight. We have the projects, the budget, and the stakeholders lined up to get there. What we need is one person accountable for the whole department: for what ships, when it ships, and whether it holds up in production.

This is the senior technology role at Cardiff, and it is a hands-on job rather than a strategy seat. You will run the engineering department day to day, carry the delivery dates yourself, and build alongside the team when that's the fastest way to unblock them.

How We Build

We are all in on AI, and we mean it structurally rather than as a tool choice.

Software factory. We're building an engineering organization where agents do the mechanical work of software; specification, implementation, testing, review, and deployment run as orchestrated loops, and engineers spend their time on judgment, architecture, and correctness. We want the department's output measured in systems shipped per month, not story points per sprint.

Agents end to end. Our production agents already talk to customers over SMS and email, work renewals and win-back campaigns, and take internal workflows off people's plates. The next step is agents that carry a process from trigger to funded outcome, with the loops, tool use, evals, and human checkpoints to be trusted with it.

Knowledge graph and total intelligence. Cardiff's institutional knowledge is scattered across Salesforce, Snowflake, email, Slack, Zoom, and documents. We're consolidating it into a queryable graph so that any agent or any person can get the full picture of a merchant, a deal, or a decision in one call. Every system you build should feed that graph rather than create another island.

Adopt before you build. Where the work isn't core IP, a strong open-source project beats owning the support and upgrade burden of a homegrown clone; Buzz, the agent-native workspace Block open-sourced, is the kind of thing we'd rather adopt and extend than rebuild.

If that philosophy is one you've already been living, this role is a place to run it at full speed with real budget behind it. If it reads as aspirational to you, this isn't the right seat.

The Role

You own Cardiff's engineering department: the in-house engineering team, our outside contractors and offshore Salesforce developers, and the vendor relationships our roadmap depends on. You report to the Managing Partner and sit on the leadership team alongside operations, sales, underwriting, marketing, and finance; those departments are your internal customers.

You'll set the delivery cadence, decide what gets built and what gets bought, keep production healthy, and be the single person the business goes to for a straight answer on status. The team is small and senior. Expect roughly 80% leading (planning, prioritization, review, unblocking, hiring) and 20% building; the ratio shifts toward building when we're behind.

Cross-department program management runs in parallel to you rather than under you, and underwriting decisioning is owned by a dedicated hire who works directly with the Underwriting department. You'll partner with both; you won't be carrying their calendars.

What You'll Own

  • Delivery. Every committed date in the department, including the ones you inherit
  • The team. Hiring, onboarding, one-on-ones, performance, and growth for in-house engineers and contractors; you'll inherit an open Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native) req and run that search
  • The platform. Our Salesforce/Fundingo core, the Cardiff API, Snowflake, cloud infrastructure, and the migration path off legacy systems
  • AI products in production. Customer-facing agents for collections, renewals, and win-back campaigns, plus internal agents that take work off people's plates
  • The knowledge layer. The graph and the pipelines that feed it, and the standard that new systems connect to it
  • Vendors. Technical evaluation, integration ownership, and honest reporting on whether a vendor is earning its invoice
  • Production quality and security. Uptime, data integrity, access control, and the incident response when something breaks

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: You've met every stakeholder, inventoried what's in flight, and given the Managing Partner a written assessment of each project: real status, real risk, and a date you're willing to be held to. You've told us at least one thing we're doing that you'd stop.

First 90 days: A weekly delivery rhythm the business can see without asking for it. At least two stalled projects either shipped to production or formally killed. One agent-built workflow running end to end with the evals and human checkpoints to prove it's safe. Your first hire in process.

First year:

  • Measurable movement on time-to-fund, with the automation to show for it
  • A team that ships on a predictable cadence, where the engineers are visibly better than when they joined
  • The knowledge graph in real use, with agents and people querying it instead of hunting through five systems
  • A roadmap the business trusts, because the last three quarters of commitments landed
  • Systems that stay up, and a technology spend you can defend line by line

What You'll Do

  • Run planning and prioritization with the department heads, and say no when the answer is no
  • Give proactive status: the business hears about slipped dates from you, on the day you know, not from asking
  • Design and operate agent systems: orchestration loops, multi-step tool use, retrieval against the graph, evals, and the human checkpoints that make them safe to run on customers
  • Review code and architecture, and stay close enough to production to know when an AI-generated pull request is wrong
  • Manage the offshore and contract developers to the same standard as the in-house team
  • Build against our stack: Salesforce, Snowflake, Gmail, Zoom, Slack, Twilio, and internal tools
  • Make AI tooling the department's default way of building, and hold the line on reading what it produces before it ships
  • Ship a working v1 today and improve it Monday, instead of a "perfect" v1 a month from now
  • Own the incident when something breaks in production, including the write-up afterward

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years building production software, with 3+ years managing engineers directly; you've run a team of 10 or more
  • A track record of hitting dates on projects you owned, and a clear story about a date you missed and what you did about it
  • Still technical: you've written and shipped production code in the last year, and you can read a pull request and catch what's wrong with it
  • Agent systems in production, not prototypes: orchestration loops, graphs, multi-step tool use, multi-agent patterns, RAG over real data, and evals you actually run
  • Coding agents as your primary way of building; Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar, with a recent example of delivering something 3–5x faster than you could have without them
  • Range across the stack: Python, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, REST/GraphQL, and cloud deployment (AWS preferred)
  • Build-vs-adopt judgment: fluent enough in the open-source AI ecosystem to reach for a strong community project rather than hand-rolling what already exists
  • Communication discipline: you escalate early in writing, and your stakeholders always know where things stand

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or unified data layers built for machine consumption
  • Fintech, lending, payments, or another regulated data environment
  • Salesforce APIs, Snowflake, or replacing a CRM-as-application architecture
  • Contributions to open-source AI projects

We weigh what you've shipped in the last 90 days more heavily than the brand on your resume. A builder with a public track record of working agent systems beats a longer tenure that stopped at experimentation.

Who Does Well Here

You ship: a rough v1 in production beats a polished v1 in staging. You're fine with priorities that move. When something is blocked, you say so the same day, in writing, with what you need.

You know the frontier better than we do. We're not looking to teach you the latest capabilities; we're looking to be wowed, and to learn from you.

You want ownership, and you understand what comes with it. You'll have direct access to the Managing Partner, a real budget, and the authority to make technology decisions. You'll also be the person who answers for the outcome.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If You

  • Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than accountability for delivery
  • Have been out of the code long enough that you'd need someone to translate a pull request for you
  • Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
  • Solve problems offline and come back with results, instead of communicating while you work
  • Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base salary from $180,000, with room above it for the right person
  • Performance bonus of up to 30% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) plan
  • Flexible PTO and observed holidays
  • Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
  • Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

Cardiff, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

SailPoint is the Worldwide Leader for Enterprise-Class Identity Security.

We minimize risk and maximize business growth by managing access to data and resources across our client’s enterprise. We do it effectively and securely for every person who interacts with our client’s organization—any user, on any device, anywhere in the world.

We were first to recognize that companies could benefit from an approach to identity that addresses both IT and business priorities. We developed a unique, risk-based model and leveraged that approach for everything from compliance to user provisioning. Then we followed that with the industry's first solution for truly extending enterprise identity management to applications in the cloud.

The ideal candidate on Service Enablement team will be a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced job, thrives on problem-solving, and is committed to delivering seamless product availability to large enterprises around the world. You will work across AWS and Azure and partner with engineering and service teams to build, run, and improve the environments that power Identity Security Cloud. We value depth in AWS together with curiosity and collaboration across both AWS and Azure, so we can standardize patterns, share operational practices, and hand off work cleanly between teams.

Roadmap for Success

  • 30 Days: Complete SailPoint onboarding, gain access to cloud environments and tooling, and develop a comprehensive understanding of the Identity Security Cloud architecture. Familiarize yourself with the Service Enablement intake process, operational runbooks, and participate in team triage and shadow on-call rotations.
  • 60 Days: Independently manage service enablement requests, contribute to standard infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) modules and Kubernetes deployments (EKS/AKS), and handle production monitoring and incident triage within established SLAs.
  • 90 Days: Fully integrate into the primary follow-the-sun on-call rotation, author or refine critical operational runbooks, and lead the enablement and standardized deployment of a new service or cloud workload across AWS or Azure.
  • 6 Months: Drive cross-functional platform initiatives that optimize cloud reliability, capacity, and cost management. Partner with development teams to establish automated CI/CD guardrails and tenant lifecycle workflows that accelerate production rollouts.
  • 1 Year: Act as a subject matter expert and technical mentor across multi-cloud operations (AWS and Azure). Influence platform architectural standards, pioneer automated self-service patterns for engineering teams, and deliver measurable improvements to system availability and service delivery velocity.

Responsibilities:


  • Build and maintain a resilient, secure, and efficient SaaS (software as a service) application platform to meet established SLAs
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, management, and incident response across cloud infrastructure (e.g., compute, networking, Kubernetes, and supporting services on AWS and/or Azure)
  • Monitor site stability and performance and troubleshoot production issues across the stack
  • Scale infrastructure to meet rapidly increasing demand—applying sound capacity, reliability, and cost practices in whichever cloud the workload lives
  • Manage cross-functional requirements working with Engineering, Product, Services, and other departments
  • Collaborate with developers to bring new features and services into production
  • Develop and improve operational practices and procedures; contribute to runbooks and reusable patterns that help teams deploy and operate safely
  • Proactively meet standards for information security and compliance, such as ISO27001, SOC1, SOC2, etc.
  • Must be willing to be part of an on-call rotation. We use a follow-the-sun model so no nighttime alerts.
  • Write and maintain architectural, stakeholder, and policy documentation
  • Create and maintain internal documentation on DevOps and platform processes, and be able to perform live demos to a potentially wide audience of stakeholders

  • Operate as a force multiplier: prioritize incoming platform work, keep work-in-progress manageable, and deliver predictable outcomes even when demand spikes
  • Participate in intake and triage: validate requests, confirm scope and readiness, and route work to the right owners when a request is larger than a short, well-defined increment
  • Meet response and resolution commitments for service requests while balancing project-style work alongside the broader platform organization when capacity allows
  • Partner with product and platform engineering teams on service design and handoffs—translating asks into durable, supportable patterns on AWS, Azure, or both, depending on where the service runs
  • Build and maintain standard implementation methods and automation for recurring platform needs (Infrastructure as Code, pipelines, modules/charts, and guardrails)
  • Author and curate runbooks so common procedures are repeatable, auditable, and safe for others to execute
  • For new cloud services, datastores, or non-standard deployment patterns (whether on AWS, Azure, or bridging the two), collaborate with subject matter experts to produce production-ready assets (modules, charts, automation) before wide adoption—recognizing that net-new capabilities may follow a longer, discovery-oriented timeline than cookie-cutter requests
  • Support tenant and environment lifecycle workflows (for example provisioning, URLs and certificates, and related controls) in line with security and compliance requirements

  • Hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production; Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), or equivalent managed Kubernetes is strongly preferred

  • Preferred: Experience with Java/JVM-based services, data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Elasticsearch), or .NET workloads—common in our Azure- and service-oriented paths

Education:

You understand the full pipeline data landscape, CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation tools (Marketo, Pardot), demand generation platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), call tracking and form capture tools (CallRail, Unbounce), and the messy reality of lead data that arrives in every format imaginable: CSV dumps, screenshot imports, manual spreadsheets, and custom-built ingress pipelines. You know how to bring structure to unstructured data, where pipeline attribution breaks down, and what it takes to connect marketing activity to revenue outcomes for clients where the sales cycle is long and the data is rarely clean.

This role reports to the Director of Data Operations & Enablement and works closely with the Appraisal team, the Measurement team, Analytics Engineering, and client account leads.

Responsibilities:

B2B & Lead Gen Vertical Client Delivery:
- Own the end-to-end data onboarding experience for B2B and Lead Gen clients post-signature — from scoping through integration validation and measurement readiness
- Lead structured data intake sessions to document lead definitions, pipeline stage mapping, CRM field configuration, conversion logic, and any known attribution nuances
- Coordinate standup of B2B and Lead Gen data pipelines — CRM connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot), MAP integrations (Marketo, Pardot), demand gen platforms (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase), and call/form tracking tools (CallRail, Unbounce)
- Own the ingestion and normalization of unstructured lead data sources — CSV imports, manual spreadsheets, screenshot-based reporting, and custom ingress tooling — leveraging AI-assisted schema mapping and data extraction where applicable
- Validate integrations are live and pipeline data is landing correctly before handing off to analytics engineering for modeling
- Maintain living integration documentation per client, usable by any team member

Pre-Sales Support:
- Join sales calls and pitch meetings for large B2B and Lead Gen prospects — speak credibly to Power Digital's data capabilities, CRM integration experience, and onboarding process
- Conduct pre-signature data audits: assess the prospect's CRM setup, lead data quality, attribution methodology, and integration complexity — flag custom data requirements and surface red flags before contract
- Partner with the Appraisal team to scope data complexity into deal pricing — translate CRM fragmentation, unstructured data ingress, and pipeline attribution requirements into effort estimates
- Produce pre-sales data profiles that set accurate expectations for what onboarding will require and what measurement programs are viable

Measurement & Meridian Support:
- Support the Measurement team's data readiness requirements for MMM programs, with specific focus on B2B and Lead Gen clients where offline conversion data and long sales cycles create unique modeling challenges
- Own data input preparation for pipeline-focused measurement models — ensuring lead volume, qualified pipeline, and closed revenue data are reconciled, validated, and delivered to spec
- Serve as the B2B and Lead Gen data subject matter expert for incrementality and attribution programs that require clean mapping of marketing touchpoints to pipeline and revenue outcomes
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years in data operations, marketing analytics, or marketing technology with direct client or stakeholder-facing responsibilities
  • Deep hands-on experience with B2B and Lead Gen data ecosystems — CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot), marketing automation (Marketo, Pardot), and demand generation tools (LinkedIn Ads, 6sense, Demandbase)
  • Proven experience handling unstructured and non-standard lead data ingestion — CSV imports, manual data entry reconciliation, screenshot-to-data workflows, and custom ingress pipelines
  • Solid SQL skills and hands-on Snowflake experience — you can write queries, validate data, and troubleshoot without engineering support for day-to-day tasks
  • Comfort in client-facing settings: you can speak to data capabilities in a sales conversation and gather requirements from a non-technical marketing stakeholder in the same day
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted data tooling for unstructured data extraction, schema mapping, or data normalization
  • Familiarity with ETL tools (Fivetran, Funnel) and data pipeline concepts

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

B2B/CSV client data coverage:
- Target: ≥70% at 6 months → 100% at 12 months
- Measurement: % of active B2B/Lead Gen clients with validated data landing in novaCloud / Omega

Data onboarding SLA:

- Measurement: Tracked per-source, per client; re-submissions count against first-pass rate

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Unstructured Data Ingestion: Own the hardest part of B2B data onboarding — bringing structure to data that arrives in every format imaginable, using AI-assisted tooling where applicable

Customer Success Engineer

Remote (US) · 10–20% travel · HQ in Atlanta, GA

About the company

StartProto is the cloud-native, AI-native manufacturing operating system replacing the aging on-prem systems most shops still run on. We cover the full quote-to-cash workflow in one platform — RFQs and quotes, sales orders, jobs, routings, BOMs, purchasing, inventory, scheduling, shipping, and invoicing — giving manufacturers real-time visibility and end-to-end traceability. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, we serve small-to-mid CNC machine shops, Swiss shops, and fabricators (typically 20–300 employees), including a growing aerospace and defense segment on our ITAR-ready AWS GovCloud deployment.

About the role

We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer (you'll also hear us say Solutions Engineer — same job) to lead onboarding and implementation for new manufacturing customers and to own an ongoing book of accounts. The core of the work is translating a shop's physical world into a digital workflow: understanding how they actually quote, build, buy, and ship, then mapping that into StartProto and training their team until it's how they run the business.

You'll start by working alongside our two current Customer Success Engineers, pick up your own accounts, and grow into leading new onboardings end to end. This is a customer-facing engineering hybrid: part trainer, part process consultant, part technical problem-solver. If you're strong in front of customers, there's room to take on our largest and most complex accounts.

What you'll do

You will lead onboarding and implementation for new customers — kickoff, process mapping, data migration from legacy systems (JobBoss, E2, spreadsheets), configuration, and go-live

  • You will train customer teams across the shop — owners, planners, buyers, material handlers, and operators — and explain concepts like lead time and work-in-progress in plain language to people who have never used a modern system

  • You will split your time roughly 60% training and 40% closing the gap: finding where a customer's workflow and the system don't yet meet, and bridging it with a custom report, a custom page, an import, or a better process

  • You will own ongoing relationships through regular check-ins, office hours, quarterly business reviews, and our in-app support chat, driving adoption module by module (sales, engineering, procurement, shop floor)

  • You will be a technical advocate for the product and its AI — showing skeptical manufacturers why the AI assistant is a useful tool rather than a threat, and helping them put it to work

  • You will decide when a request is a one-off you can solve yourself with AI tooling and when it's a real product gap, then record feature requests and bugs clearly so product and engineering can act on them

  • You will respond to the occasional "code red," including getting on a plane to a customer's plant to be the voice of the product on site

What we're seeking

Must have

  • You communicate clearly and have the EQ to earn trust on a shop floor and in an owner's office — we weight this above domain expertise

  • You learn software fast and can tell a story with it; our interview process includes exploring a sandbox account and demoing StartProto back to the team

  • You are process-oriented: you can watch how work gets done, map it, and spot what's broken

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (customer success, implementation, solutions or sales engineering, technical support) or hands-on manufacturing/operations experience

  • You use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, or similar) daily and know how to make what you build with them reliable

  • You are comfortable working with data — CSV imports, nested bills of materials, exports — and tracking down why the numbers don't match

  • You work well remotely, manage your own calendar across many accounts, and stay calm when a customer is having a bad day

  • US work authorization required; this position can be done remotely from the US with 10–20% travel to customer sites

Nice to have

  • Manufacturing background — manufacturing, industrial, or quality engineering; production planning; purchasing; or inventory/warehouse operations

  • Experience implementing or administering an ERP/MES (JobBoss, E2, ProShop, Fulcrum, Odoo, NetSuite)

  • Python or scripting skills for imports and automation — not a day-to-day requirement, but our team leans on it

  • Experience creating training content — videos, guides, webinars

  • Familiarity with aerospace and defense requirements (ITAR, DFARS, traceability and lot/serial tracking)

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We're looking for a Senior Systems & Fleet Infrastructure Lead to take full ownership of our growing estate of commercial POS terminals and edge devices. You will be the senior technical authority for the whole fleet, from hardware sourcing and supplier negotiation through to remote fleet management, patching, and Cyber Essentials compliance. You will bridge low-level hardware procurement and cloud-based fleet operations, establish and run an RMM ecosystem, lead R&D on our embedded hardware platforms, design staged update pipelines, and enforce strict Cyber Essentials compliance across the whole terminal estate.
Please note that we can only accept applications from UK based candidates and are unable to offer sponsorship for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Hardware sourcing, procurement & vendor management
  • Lead the technical evaluation, prototyping, and procurement of embedded x86 motherboard platforms (currently Mini-ITX, Intel N150 SoCs).
  • Audit OEM/ODM suppliers to verify active AMI Aptio V BIOS licensing, long-life Intel Extended Servicing Update (ESU) support, and 10-year BOM stability.
  • Negotiate volume hardware pricing (1,000-unit batches), custom factory BIOS pre-configuration, and hardware warranty SLAs.
  • Manage Product Change Notifications (PCNs), hardware revisions, and End-of-Life (EOL) transitions.

Fleet management & staging automation (RMM)
  • Establish an RMM platform (such as Intune, Atera, or NinjaOne) to monitor, inventory, and manage our fleet of Windows POS terminals.
  • Build, test, and stage automated update packages (PowerShell scripts, UEFI Capsule .cab files, silent executable flashers).
  • Enforce a strict 14-day patch SLA across all OS, firmware, and third-party software releases to maintain continuous Cyber Essentials certification.
  • Design and roll out unique per-device or per-technician credentials, replacing the shared login currently used across the terminal estate.
  • Manage disk encryption (BitLocker), remote recovery workflows, and automated system provisioning.

Level-3 technical escalation & system architecture
  • Act as the final technical escalation point for complex incidents that have not been able to be resolve through first line support.
  • Diagnose OS boot issues, UEFI Secure Boot key revocations, microcode updates, and remote recovery routines.
  • Configure and harden Windows kiosk mode (Assigned Access) to prevent escape from the SchoolGrid application to the underlying OS or desktop.

Identity, security & network governance
  • Maintain endpoint compliance across Windows, Google Workspace / GCPW, and mobile device management (MDM).
  • Audit local administrator privileges, host firewalls, and user account controls across all endpoints.
  • Oversee office/site network connectivity, router configurations, VPNs, and firewall policies.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in Windows 11 IoT, Enterprise deployment, Group Policy/registry tuning, BitLocker, and UEFI/BIOS settings.
  • RMM fleet experience. Proven track record using enterprise RMM tools (such as Intune, Atera, or NinjaOne) to manage, patch, and script endpoints at scale.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting. Ability to write clean, production-grade PowerShell scripts for silent deployments, registry modifications, and BitLocker suspension workflows.
  • General IT & networking. Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, host firewalls, and remote access protocols.
  • Basic Linux competency. Practical familiarity with Linux command-line tools (bash, systemctl, grep, dmesg, lscpu), and the ability to run firmware flash utilities (AFULNX, fwupd).
  • Hardware & firmware understanding. Knowledge of x86 hardware architecture, embedded SoC thermal management (TDP), and AMI BIOS.
  • 5+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Systems Administration, or Terminal Fleet Management.
  • Direct experience preparing for or maintaining Cyber Essentials or ISO 27001 certification (Desirable).
  • Proven commercial experience evaluating hardware suppliers and negotiating technical PO terms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and confident in managing senior stakeholders.

Benefits

  • 40 days holiday (including bank holidays) because balance matters
  • Remote first approach.
  • Ongoing development opportunities, including mentoring from senior leadership
  • Supportive, approachable team culture that values initiative and ideas
  • Career progression with being part of a fast growing company, bringing great opportunities.

Who We Are
SchoolGrid provides trusted software solutions to schools, catering providers, and local authorities across the UK. Our platform supports the full meal service journey, from menu planning to meal ordering, making daily operations more efficient for thousands of users.
With deep experience in the school catering space, we pride ourselves on building long term partnerships and delivering technology that works in the real world. Our clients rely on us not just for software, but for consistent, responsive support and a commitment to ongoing improvement.
As we continue to grow and expand our offering, we remain focused on delivering the same high standards of service, training, and innovation that our clients expect.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Receptionist — Primary Care

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with 1-hour unpaid lunch break
Work Days: Monday to Friday
Salary: $5 - $6 hourly, depending on experience
Workplace: Remote
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines or Latin America

About the Client & Role

Our client is a well-established primary care medical practice with three locations on Long Island, New York. The practice has 10 providers, approximately 40 staff members, and sees around 60 patients per day per location.

They are seeking an experienced Medical Receptionist — Primary Care to support high-volume inbound patient calls, appointment scheduling, EHR navigation, refill inquiry routing, message management, and front desk administrative workflows across all three locations.

This role is ideal for someone with medical receptionist, front desk, or Medical VA experience who is confident speaking with patients, comfortable navigating patient charts, and able to think critically in a fast-paced primary care environment. The candidate must communicate clearly with elderly patients, follow established office protocols, route messages appropriately, and escalate concerns when needed.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

High-Volume Patient Phone Support

  • Handle a high volume of inbound patient calls across all three practice locations.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and patiently with patients, including elderly patients.
  • Address routine appointment, refill, and general inquiry calls based on office protocols.
  • Route calls, messages, and concerns to the appropriate team member when needed.
  • Maintain confidence and professionalism when speaking with patients.

Scheduling & Appointment Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule, and coordinate patient appointments.
  • Review patient needs and appointment history to determine the appropriate scheduling workflow.
  • Follow office protocols when booking visits or routing scheduling concerns.
  • Help ensure patients are scheduled accurately and efficiently.
  • Escalate scheduling issues when provider or office-level guidance is required.

EHR Navigation & Chart Review

  • Navigate AdvancedMD to review patient charts, appointment history, messages, refill-related information, and relevant administrative details.
  • Use the EHR to support patient calls and determine the appropriate next step based on office procedures.
  • Document patient interactions, messages, and scheduling updates accurately.
  • Identify missing information or unclear items and escalate appropriately.

Refill Inquiries & Message Routing

  • Receive and route refill-related inquiries according to practice protocols.
  • Review patient chart information as needed to understand the request.
  • Route medication-related questions or clinical concerns to the appropriate provider or team member.
  • Avoid giving medical advice, approving refills, or making clinical decisions independently.

Office Protocol Adherence & Escalation

  • Follow established office workflows and communication protocols.
  • Recognize when an issue requires provider, manager, or in-office team review.
  • Escalate urgent, unclear, clinical, or sensitive concerns appropriately.
  • Support smooth communication between patients, front desk staff, providers, and internal teams.

Tools You’ll Use

  • AdvancedMD
  • Ooma phone system
  • Email and phone communication tools
  • EHR documentation workflows
  • Internal practice communication systems

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Healthcare Background and Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience working in a healthcare, medical office, primary care, medical receptionist, front desk, or Medical VA role.
  • Medical Receptionist / Front Desk Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience supporting patient inquiries, scheduling, message routing, refill inquiry routing, or similar front office healthcare workflows.
  • High-Volume Inbound Phone Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable handling frequent patient calls with professionalism, patience, and accuracy.
  • EHR / EMR Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable navigating patient charts, reviewing information, documenting interactions, and using an EHR to support patient calls.
  • AdvancedMD Experience: Preferred but not required. Experience with AdvancedMD is highly valuable, but candidates with strong EHR/EMR experience may also be considered.
  • Scheduling Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience scheduling, rescheduling, coordinating appointments, and following office scheduling protocols.
  • Prescription Refill Inquiry Support: Preferred. Candidates with experience receiving, documenting, and routing refill-related inquiries according to office protocols are encouraged to apply.
  • Primary Care Experience: Preferred. Experience supporting a primary care practice is a plus.
  • Medical Terminology Knowledge: Required. Candidates must understand basic medical terminology and be able to follow healthcare workflows accurately.
  • Spanish-English Bilingual Communication: Preferred but not required. Spanish-English bilingual ability is a plus, but not required.

Performance Expectations

The ideal candidate should help support:

  • Timely and professional handling of high-volume inbound calls.
  • Accurate patient scheduling and appointment coordination.
  • Proper EHR navigation and documentation.
  • Clear message routing and follow-through.
  • Appropriate routing of refill-related inquiries.
  • Appropriate escalation of clinical, urgent, or unclear patient concerns.
  • Smooth communication across three practice locations.
  • Reduced phone and administrative burden for the in-office team.
  • Able to maintain appropriate administrative and clinical boundaries at all times.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role

As a Technical Support Specialist at Aircall, you will help customers troubleshoot complex issues across our communications platform, including integrations, APIs, messaging, call configuration, analytics, and AI-powered features. This role acts as the second level of support for technical investigations and requires a strong mix of technical troubleshooting, customer communication, and problem-solving.

You will work closely with customers to investigate issues related to CRM integrations, APIs, webhooks, platform configuration, and Aircall’s growing suite of AI-powered features such as transcription and AI Assist.

Because Aircall integrates with hundreds of external tools, this role provides exposure to a broad ecosystem of technologies including CRM systems, automation platforms, APIs, and telecom infrastructure.

This is a customer-facing role, where you will investigate issues through Zendesk while also leading live troubleshooting sessions with customers when necessary.

Our Technical Support organization operates globally in a follow-the-sun model, supporting customers across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific regions.

What You Will Do

Technical Troubleshooting

  • Investigate escalated technical issues across Aircall’s platform, including integrations, APIs, telephony configuration, messaging features, and analytics
  • Troubleshoot CRM integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Zoho, Bullhorn, Monday.com, and other third-party platforms
  • Analyze webhook payloads, API responses, and request logs to diagnose integration issues
  • Use tools such as Postman, browser developer consoles, and HAR files to investigate platform behavior
  • Troubleshoot messaging functionality including SMS, MMS, and WhatsApp integrations
  • Diagnose authentication, permissions, and configuration issues within customer environments

AI and Platform Features

  • Investigate issues related to Aircall’s AI-powered capabilities, including transcription, AI Assist summaries, and AI Voice Agent behavior
  • Troubleshoot analytics and reporting issues related to the Aircall Dashboard and data integrations
  • Support customers with call flow configuration, number configuration, and feature behavior

Customer Investigation

  • Lead technical troubleshooting sessions with customers to diagnose and resolve issues
  • Translate complex technical findings into clear explanations for customers and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain strong communication throughout investigations, particularly for high-impact cases

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to diagnose platform issues and reproduce bugs
  • Collaborate with external partners such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or telecom providers when deeper investigation is required
  • Help identify systemic issues and contribute to product improvement initiatives

Internal Enablement

  • Help train frontline support teams on troubleshooting techniques and escalation best practices
  • Create and maintain internal troubleshooting documentation and knowledge base articles
  • Monitor recurring issues and recommend improvements to support processes and platform reliability

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in a technical support role within a SaaS, telecom, or platform-based company
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to investigate complex technical issues
  • Experience working with APIs and webhooks
  • Experience using tools such as Postman or similar API testing tools
  • Experience investigating browser behavior using developer tools or HAR files
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple investigations simultaneously
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong problem-solving abilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience troubleshooting CRM integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zendesk
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog
  • Familiarity with analytics tools such as Looker
  • Experience supporting AI-powered SaaS products such as transcription or AI assistants
  • Experience with messaging platforms such as SMS, MMS, or WhatsApp
  • Familiarity with Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence
  • Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment

Why join us?

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another.
