jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager - Partnerships
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Partnerships to own the lifecycle strategy and experience for users who come to onX through our partners. Partnerships are a growing channel for onX, with automotive partners Ford and Toyota as the primary focus today and opportunities to expand into additional partner categories over time.

This is a build opportunity within our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team. Partner-sourced users arrive with different context, intent, trial experiences, and expectations than users who discover onX on their own. You’ll use customer behavior and performance data to develop the lifecycle strategy and roadmap for these audiences, then bring that strategy to life across activation, onboarding, engagement, and conversion.

This role works across all four onX verticals and a broad set of cross-functional partners, including Partnerships, vertical marketing teams, Growth Product, creative, and analytics. You’ll start by building on our automotive foundation, using customer insights and experimentation to strengthen the partner lifecycle experience, then turn what works into scalable approaches for new partners and categories as our partnership ecosystem grows.

This role reports to the Director of Growth Lifecycle Marketing.

ABOUT THE GROWTH LIFECYCLE MARKETING TEAM

Our Growth Lifecycle Marketing team operates with a high degree of end-to-end ownership. We use customer behavior and data to identify opportunities, develop strategies, build and launch lifecycle experiences, measure performance, and turn what we learn into the next experiment. Rather than routinely handing work from one function to another, our lifecycle marketers have the tools and autonomy to move work forward themselves while partnering with teams across onX where their expertise is needed.

We move quickly, experiment often, and stay close to both the customer experience and the results of our work. That means being strategic and hands-on aren't separate parts of the job—they go together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

Own the partner lifecycle strategy

  • Develop and own the lifecycle strategy and roadmap for partner-sourced users across activation, onboarding, engagement, and conversion, creating structure and direction as onX expands this growing channel.
  • Partner with Partnerships and vertical business teams to translate partner agreements, customer behavior, and business goals into lifecycle programs that deliver measurable value for onX and our partners.
  • Build segmentation and personalization strategies that reflect how partner-sourced users differ by partner, entitlement, behavior, and intent.

Build, experiment, and optimize

  • Design, build, QA, and deploy lifecycle journeys across email, push, and in-app experiences in Braze, making thoughtful channel and experience decisions based on customer behavior, business goals, and potential impact to the product experience.
  • Use customer behavior and performance data to identify and prioritize opportunities, develop hypotheses, design rigorous experiments, and measure impact. Self-serve analysis using tools such as Amplitude, Braze, and Eppo, and translate what you learn into decisions about what to test, optimize, or pursue next.
  • Use AI thoughtfully and effectively throughout the lifecycle workflow—from insight and ideation through content development, execution, and analysis—to increase the speed and quality of your work while applying sound judgment to outputs.

Lead across a complex stakeholder environment

  • Drive lifecycle initiatives forward across Partnerships, vertical marketing teams, Growth Product, creative, analytics, legal, and other stakeholders, keeping priorities, dependencies, approvals, and launches moving.
  • Navigate differing perspectives and priorities across teams, building alignment while maintaining momentum and a high bar for the customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Translate lifecycle strategy, experimentation, and performance into clear, actionable communication for internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, external partners.

Turn learning into scalable approaches

  • Turn successful experiments and programs into repeatable playbooks that help onX launch new partners and categories faster and enable proven approaches to be shared across verticals.
  • Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle workflows, tools, and approaches as the partner ecosystem grows.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Seven (7) or more years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or growth marketing, ideally within consumer subscription or mobile app businesses.
  • Deep lifecycle marketing experience across activation, onboarding, engagement, conversion, and retention, with demonstrated end-to-end ownership—from using customer insights to shape strategy and priorities through building, launching, measuring, and optimizing programs.
  • Experience managing lifecycle marketing programs across multiple products or business lines, adapting strategies to different customer needs and business priorities.
  • Strong analytical fluency, with the ability to independently explore customer behavior and performance data using Amplitude or similar product analytics tools and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
  • A strong experimentation and measurement mindset, with experience developing hypotheses, designing A/B and holdout tests, interpreting results, and using learnings to determine what comes next.
  • Proficiency with Braze or a comparable lifecycle marketing platform, including building automated, behavior-based journeys, segmentation, personalization, and triggering logic.
  • Strong AI fluency, with the ability to use AI effectively across your workflow, build repeatable AI-enabled ways of working, and apply sound judgment to improve the speed, quality, and scale of your work.
  • Demonstrated success in complex, cross-functional environments, building alignment across teams with different goals and perspectives while keeping work moving.
  • Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent workstreams with a high degree of ownership.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel up to quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience marketing through partner, co-marketing, or channel relationships, including working directly with external partners.
  • Experience using in-app messaging to influence customer behavior while balancing marketing goals with the broader product experience.
  • Experience launching or scaling lifecycle programs for a new partner, channel, audience, or business area.
  • Experience with subscription, freemium, membership, or entitlement-based business models.
  • Experience prototyping or implementing advanced AI use cases for lifecycle marketing, such as agentic workflows, custom automations, scaled personalization, or AI-assisted experimentation and analysis.
  • Experience with SQL or BigQuery for deeper self-service analysis.
  • Experience with Liquid templating or similar tools for dynamic personalization.
  • A personal passion for hunting, off-roading, backcountry recreation, or fishing, and familiarity with how our customers experience the outdoors.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $115,000 and $145,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle

jobs.excerpt: Senior Marketing Manager - Narrative and LaunchUS Remote · Reports to SVP MarketingAI is hitting a limit.
jobs.description:
Senior Marketing Manager - Narrative and Launch

US Remote · Reports to SVP Marketing

AI is hitting a limit. Not in the models, not in the data, not in the software. It's a power limit, and it lives in the chip, where the physics is fixed and you can only squeeze so many bits out of a watt. Every watt AI wants comes off the same grid everyone else shares.

The problem isn't unknown. The rest of the industry is trying to solve it by making the same chip better, which earns incremental gains, not the step change that puts AI everywhere without breaking the grid. EnCharge AI is using a different set of physics: analog in-memory computing, which computes with charge instead of switching transistors, built and running at roughly 20x the performance per watt.

Why this role exists

This role is strategy and execution in the same seat, with the balance tilted toward execution. It helps shape how a genuinely hard technology gets understood, and it spends most of its days doing the hands-on work that makes that happen. That combination is hard to hold, and rewarding for the person who can.

Analog compute has been the industry's white whale. For decades it's been the thing everyone agreed would change computing, if anyone could get it to work at scale. We have. Now it has to be understood, by developers, by the companies building the devices, by the analysts shaping the category, and by an industry with a lot invested in the current answer. Hard technology does not explain itself, and the companies that win this category will be the ones people can follow.

Marketing is a small team, and this role reports to the SVP of Marketing. It drives the launches, plays a central role in developing the brand, corporate, and product narrative, and reaches into everything else a small team has to cover.

What you'll drive

Launches. You drive them: the plan, the sequencing, the proof points, and the readiness of everyone who has to talk about it. That means hands-on execution as well as coordinating digital marketing, PR, and events into one coherent multichannel launch.

The narrative. How we explain what we've built, to each audience that matters, in a way that survives contact with a skeptical one. The SVP of Marketing owns the brand, corporate, and product narrative, and you're a key player in building it: you research, build, test, and bring the evidence that changes it, then make it hold everywhere it has to work: the site, the deck, the brief, the booth, the briefing, the field.

Execution. You'll get your hands dirty: content, social, creative, events. And you'll coordinate the vendors and freelancers who extend what a small team can do and hold their work to the standard.

Translating the technology. You work directly with the people who built this and turn it into explainers, technical briefs, launch narratives, and customer stories. You are not the deepest technical mind in the room. You are the person who knows which question unlocks the explanation, and what to do with the answer.

Accuracy. We are careful about what we say publicly, and this role carries that. You won't be deriving the performance numbers. You will decide whether the way we describe them is something we can stand behind and say so when it isn't.

Competitive. Where the incumbents and the other challengers actually are, which of their advantages hold up, and what that means for how we position. Bring the research, not the opinion.

Enablement. Materials that business development and technical sales actually use, because they answer the questions they're getting. If they route around what you build, that's your signal.

Brand and breadth. How we sound, what we're recognized for, and whether the story holds together across everything a person encounters. Plus analyst and press support, internal comms, and the marketing strategy work that comes with a small team. At this size, the line between “my job” and “the work” is thin, and we're upfront about that.

How you'll work

This part matters as much as the résumé.

  • Challenge and improve. Don't assume anyone knows better, including the people who've been here longest. Especially not us.
  • Come prepared. An opinion with research, data, or intel behind it beats ten without. Bring the argument, not the instinct.
  • Don't wait for permission. See the opportunity, take it, tell us what you did. Direction will not always arrive before the moment does.
  • Build the mechanics. We're building a marketing function from scratch. The frameworks, the launch process, the enablement system, the competitive cadence: they don't exist yet, and part of this job is making them exist.

What we're looking for

Semiconductor or AI infrastructure experience is preferred, and we mean preferred rather than required. If you've done this work in another technically demanding category and can show us you get up to speed fast, we want the conversation. If you're new to semiconductors, the first ninety days are built around getting you fluent, with the engineers and with the claims, before you're expected to hold the line on either.

  • 7+ years of marketing, including roles where you owned positioning, messaging, and launches.
  • Command of the craft. Positioning and messaging architecture, audience definition, launch mechanics, enablement, competitive practice, brand expression. We're building a function, so the mechanics matter as much as the strategy.
  • The ability to get fluent fast in hard technology and make it land for people who don't share your context. You'll work closely with engineers and chip architects, and you need to hold your own in those rooms and know which question changes the message.
  • Judgment about claims. We'd rather be precise than impressive, and we need someone who will hold that line under pressure.
  • You write clearly about complicated things, for technical and non-technical readers, without diluting either.
  • You've built process where none existed, and you didn't wait to be asked.
  • You've done the work yourself, not only directed it: written the piece, run the event, briefed the freelancer, shipped the thing.
  • Creative experience, either making the work yourself or working directly with creative teams and agencies to get it made well.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with hardware timelines. Silicon doesn't move on a software cadence.

Nice to have

  • Semiconductor, hardware, or AI infrastructure marketing.
  • Edge or client AI inference, or the OEM and design-win motion around it.
  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with researchers or engineers to make their work legible.
  • Both agency and in-house experience, and a clear view of what each taught you.

What this job is not

We'd rather lose you here than at month four.

  • Not a demand gen role. There's no MQL target here, and if pipeline volume is how you keep score, this will frustrate you.
  • Not only a content or social role. You'll do that work, and it matters, but it serves the launches and the narrative rather than standing on its own.
  • Not the owner of the website or the digital channels. That sits with digital marketing.
  • Not a narrow lane. The team is small.
  • Not a first positioning job. If positioning has always been handed to you, this isn't the role yet.
  • Not a role where the brief arrives finished

Where this goes

This seat is built to grow. Director is the next step for the person who earns it, on outcomes, with or without a team to manage, and what you build in the first year will shape what the role becomes.

Why EnCharge

A brand's first and most important audience is the people who work there, and we try to act like it. You'll be close to the technology and close to the decisions, at the point where what we've built becomes what the industry understands.

Location and travel

Remote within the US, with travel to our offices, customers, and industry events several times a year.

Estimated Base Pay Range

  • $135,000 – $165,000 USD per year.
    The base pay range above represents EnCharge AI's good-faith and reasonable estimate of expected compensation at the time of this posting. Final actual salary offers are determined based on factors such as the candidate's geographic location, relevant skills, specialized experience, and interview performance

Benefits, Perks & Additional Compensation

  • Bonus Eligibility: This position is eligible for an annual performance-based cash bonus.
  • Equity: This role includes an initial equity grant of stock options, vesting over four years.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance options with 100% of premium costs covered by the company.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Time Off: 20 days of accrued Paid Time Off (PTO) and 12 paid company holidays.
  • Family Leave: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents. Birthing mothers are eligible for an additional up to 8 weeks paid.

jobs.excerpt: About the role: Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations.
jobs.description:
About the role:
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

A Senior Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the transformation of the HR function — evolution of the HR functional structure, HR roles, and HR technology strategy — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders. Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on HR functional transformation, HR strategic planning, and HR technology strategy and use cases.
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act.
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video-based presentations and discussions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or HR technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience; with the below subject matter expertise:
    • Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities
    • Experience successfully designing and leading HR functional transformations.
    • Knowledge of the HR technology landscape, including market dynamics and vendors, particularly with respect to AI, and their impact on HR strategies and workflows.
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
  • Strong business and financial acumen
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.excerpt: RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands.
jobs.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

About Evo

For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them.

Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Director of Product, Evo to lead the vision, development, and continued evolution of Evo’s live event and consumer products.

This person will define what we build, why we build it, and how Evo brings its tournaments, programming, and fan experiences to life around the world. You will own the end-to-end development of select Evo products, from tournament formats and on-site attractions to new events, specialty programming, and other major initiatives that will help shape Evo’s future.

You will take products from initial concept through launch, defining the audience, goals, scope, requirements, budget, and measures of success. You will work closely with Event Operations, Production, Broadcast, Marketing, Partnerships, and Business Development to ensure each product can be delivered successfully and remains true to Evo’s community and brand.

This is a senior leadership role within Evo. In addition to leading individual products, you will help shape Evo’s broader product portfolio, support decisions about global expansion and future growth, develop strong leaders and teams, and take on broader leadership responsibilities across the business when needed.

The right person combines product strategy, live event experience, audience empathy, and strong business judgment. They understand how to translate fighting game culture and broader gaming fandom into competitive and entertainment products that can grow without losing what makes Evo special.

At our size, this is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable moving between long-term product planning, experience design, documentation, budget decisions, team leadership, cross-functional coordination, and on-site execution.

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s General Manager.

Key Responsibilities
Evo Product Strategy
  • Own the vision, priorities, plans, and measures of success for major Evo products, including live events, tournament experiences, on-site attractions, and specialty programming.
  • Write clear product and event briefs that define experience goals, spatial concepts, stage requirements, tournament parameters, and what each team is expected to deliver.
  • Make product tradeoffs across features, formats, and investments using audience data, player sentiment, endemic impact, business value, timing, complexity, and cost.
  • Define ticket types, experience packages, benefits, and attendee value in partnership with Event Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other relevant teams.
  • Work with the General Manager and company leadership to set product priorities and evaluate new formats, events, and markets.
Event & Consumer Experience Development
  • Lead the development of flagship event features and experiential zones, including museum exhibits, indie developer showcases, vendor villages, artist alleys, community meetups, and other on-site attractions.
  • Define tournament formats, exhibition formats, rulesets, and competition structures in partnership with tournament and event teams.
  • Lead the ideation and development of new events and specialty products, including exhibition programming and publisher partnered showcases, creating repeatable, scalable formats that can be adapted for Evo events in different markets.
  • Consider the full attendee and viewer journey, including how an experience works on-site, on broadcast, and across Evo’s content channels.
Publisher & Partner Experiences
  • Partner with Partnerships, Marketing, and Business Development to design industry leading experiences for Evo’s partners that fit within Evo’s broader product and consumer plans, including activations, show features, developer panels, content presentations, commercial segments, circuit qualifier integrations, and official circuit finals.
  • Define the structural guidelines for tournament activations, publisher-supported side events, and programming
  • Ensure partner integrations add something meaningful to the player, attendee, or viewer experience and feel right for Evo.
  • Join major publisher and partner conversations when product direction, tournament formats, or fan experiences are a central part of the opportunity.
Product Management & Processes
  • Create consistent ways of evaluating, prioritizing, planning, and documenting Evo products and experiences across our global events.
  • Monitor attendance, participation, capacity, show pacing, fan feedback, and other relevant measures during live events to assess product performance and identify changes that should be made during the event or in the future.
  • Lead post-event product reviews and turn community feedback, viewership data, surveys, and internal feedback into clear improvements for future events.
On-Site Creative Stewardship & Execution Support
  • Manage the creative integrity of the event on-site, ensuring all stage presentations, experiential feature builds, and brand moments match documented expectations and creative standards.
  • Partner closely with Event Production to resolve issues that affect the player, attendee, broadcast, or partner experience.
  • Support the selection and management of specialized experiential vendors, contractors, and other outside partners when needed.
  • Provide hands-on product direction during events and work with Event Operations, Production, and Broadcast to make changes when circumstances shift.
  • Participate on-site at major Evo events and other product launches as needed.
Budget Management
  • Develop and manage approved budgets for assigned products and programs, including prize pools, experiential builds, specialty programming, and early product development.
  • Review product costs, audience engagement, and results to help decide where Evo should invest in the future.
  • Evaluate the audience, cost, revenue potential, and operational needs of proposed products and experiences.
Leadership & Team Development

WHO WE ARE

At Basis, we empower agencies and brands with cutting-edge software that automates digital media operations. Our all-in-one platform supports seamless planning, reporting, and financial reconciliation across direct, programmatic, search, and social media.
We’re not just building advanced technology; we’re also building a culture where passionate, motivated individuals come together to drive meaningful change. Our commitment to inclusivity and growth ensures our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
With our headquarters in Chicago, we offer flexible work options across the U.S. and Canada, including remote, hybrid, or on-site at headquarters.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Basis Technologies' Talent and Development (T&D) team works to make our organization an engaging, inclusive home for Beeps to develop their careers and create positive change in the ad tech industry. T&D is made up of four collaborative teams: Talent Acquisition (recruits top talent for Basis), Talent Operations (provides benefits, payroll, perks, and system support for Basis), Education and Development (leads training and education for Basis employees), and Talent Strategy (supports employee experience and engagement, business partnership, professional development, management resources, and employee relations).

Collectively, T&D is determined to bring the Basis Manifesto and guiding principles to life through our culture and practices. This team cultivates Raving Fans by constantly ideating on how to ensure every current and prospective employee receives the best experience possible.

WAYS YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE

    This role reports to the Director, Employee Experience and Engagement and provides administrative, operational, and program support across both the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams. You will help create the best employee experience possible for Beeps by keeping core programs and processes organized, responsive, and running smoothly; supporting culture and community efforts; and helping managers and employees navigate day-to-day questions and needs. You will contribute by:

    • Providing administrative, coordination, and day-to-day execution support across the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams, helping recurring priorities, requests, communications, documentation, and follow-ups move forward consistently.

    • Serving as a first line of support for routine Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner requests, including monitoring Workday Help, supporting manager office hours, answering day-to-day questions, providing guidance on policies and people processes, triaging matters to the appropriate team member, tracking requests, and ensuring timely follow-through.

    • Providing a trusted venue for employees to ask questions, share feedback, and express concerns, while escalating sensitive or complex matters when appropriate.

    • Coordinating recurring employee lifecycle and people-process work, including voluntary offboarding, exit interviews, leave of absence documentation and follow-through, Workday transactions and tasks, Workday testing, and tracker maintenance, in partnership with the appropriate T&D teams.

    • Supporting employee listening efforts, including employee check-ins and focus groups as needed, and helping identify and share themes that can inform the employee experience.

    • Identifying themes from exit interviews, employee check-ins, listening efforts, and routine requests, and sharing regular insights with the Employee Experience and Engagement and Business Partner teams.

    • Guiding employees and managers on growth opportunities for themselves and their teams, with a focus on enhancing performance and supporting employee engagement and retention.

    • Providing execution and administrative support for key talent processes, including performance reviews, talent assessments, merit cycles, talent movement, retention efforts, communications, documentation, reporting, meeting coordination, scheduling, and general process administration.

    • Supporting the execution and administration of employee experience and culture programs such as Basis Bravo, Basis Cares, recognition initiatives, mentorship programs, Workhuman administration, culture campaigns, and other recurring engagement efforts.

    • Helping bring Basis culture and community to life through Basis Neighborhood Networks, HQ Week, employee appreciation efforts, events, resource creation, communications, and other activities that strengthen connection, recognition, and belonging across the organization.

    • Partnering across T&D to brainstorm, plan, coordinate, communicate, execute, and sustain programs with a high level of quality and consistency.

    • Jumping in on projects and miscellaneous team needs with curiosity, flexibility, and an eagerness to learn. We are looking for someone who is excited to help with anything and everything!

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

    • Trustworthiness and discretion with confidential and sensitive information.

    • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and credibility with employees and managers.

    • Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a question or concern should be escalated.

    • Ability to manage time across reactive requests, recurring responsibilities, and proactive priorities as they arise.

    • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and commitment to high-quality execution.

    • Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills.

    • Solid work ethic and an unfaltering positive attitude.

    • Ability to remain curious and focused even when the situation is ambiguous.

    • Ability to work autonomously and at a fast pace; initiative and results focused.

    • Proficiency using Microsoft Office and Outlook; comfort learning and working within HR systems and tools.

    • Commitment to creating inclusive, respectful environments where all voices are valued and supported.

    • Thoughtful approach to collaboration, program execution, and decision-making that prioritizes equity, access, and continuous learning.

BONUS POINTS

    • Bachelor’s degree preferred; associate degree in business, Human Resource Management, a related field, or equivalent education and experience.

    • Professional in Human Resources (PHR) or SHRM certification preferred.

    • Two or more years of experience in Human Resources, employee experience, employee relations, people program administration, program coordination, or a related field preferred.

    • Previous experience with Workday, Workhuman, employee lifecycle processes, or people program administration preferred.

Integrity in Hiring

At Basis, integrity is at the core of how we hire. To protect our candidates and our company, we verify identity, education, and employment history for all hires. Some roles may also require onsite or in-person interviews as part of the process. Any misrepresentation of identity, experience, or skills may result in removal from the hiring process or termination of employment. We value transparency and authenticity and expect the same from every applicant.

Anything Else?

Don’t have every skill listed? No problem! We know experience can be built in many ways. If you have relevant skills that aren't reflected in your resume, we encourage you to share them in an optional cover letter.

Life with Basis

We’re committed to our people’s growth and well-being because our success is tied to theirs. That’s why we’ve earned recognition as a top workplace, including: Ad Age, #1 Best Places to Work 2025, WorkLife's #1 Most Committed to Work Life Balance, and the Chicago Tribune's Top Workplaces in Chicago. We offer competitive perks, including a flexible work week, 401k/RRSP matching, mental health support, paid sabbaticals, generous parental leave, flexible work options, and more.
Basis is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate all team members regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race or cultural background, religion, disability, age, and beyond.

THE POSITION:

Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical company products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers. Medical Information also plays an important role in post-marketing managing of adverse events and product complaints. As a functional member of the Medical Information Contact Center (MICC) team, this position delivers industry-leading services, which include Contact Center staffing for responding to product information requests as well as identifying and managing of adverse events and/or product quality issues. This position requires clinical and therapeutic knowledge, critical and analytical thinking, and customer/patient-centric approach. Medical Information Representatives typically support multiple pharmaceutical clients, products, and therapeutic areas.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Medical Information Support

  • Independently respond to unsolicited medical information inquiries from physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and other health care professionals, consumers, and payers.
  • Utilize medical information and clinical expertise to identify, research, and critically evaluate medical literature to create responses to medical information inquiries.
  • Identify & accurately document adverse events and product complaints during customer interactions.
  • Perform intake & generate accurate adverse event and product complaint reports in compliance with EVERSANA-MICC and client standard operating procedures.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of FDA’s post-marketing adverse event reporting regulations and safety terminology.
  • Ability to make accurate assessments regarding level & depth of information required.
  • Utilize writing skills for adverse event and product complaint narrative during intake as well as documentation of medical inquiry.
  • Independently Handle requests across multiple channels and platforms (phone, email, CRM, chat, etc.)
  • Coordinate & support processes necessary for responding to product quality-related complaints. This process may involve collaborating with personnel in the following departments: Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and the complainant.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, therapeutic areas, and client specific requirements.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, high quality, and excellent customer service.
  • Staffing at scientific medical affairs booths.
  • On-call responsibilities on an assigned basis.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • All other duties as assigned.

  • Education: Advanced healthcare degree or higher in healthcare-related field or equivalent
  • Licenses/Certificates: Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent licensure.

Who we are

Isla Health is a venture-backed health-tech startup, supporting our partners across the UK, EU and internationally. We have built a new category of healthcare technology which we refer to as the Digital Pathway Platform (DPP). Founded in 2019, we now support 25% of NHS Trusts and see 2 million submissions on the platform every year.

As a company we are all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent co-horting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity.

------

The role

We're looking for a Senior Node.js Engineer to work closely with our product & client facing teams, understand our customer challenges, and ship things quickly to test & learn. You will design, scope, build and deploy new features quickly for our users.

You’ll have high ownership over whole areas of the codebase and who features end-to-end, contributing to a platform that supports millions of patient interactions.You should be biased towards pace and experimentation and excited about solving the big challenges in healthcare.

------

What you’ll do

  • Build the platform that will allow our clients to look after their patients, integrating new data sources to drive our DPP, managing those complex clinical data flows to ensure that data is where it needs to be, and then writing updates back to 3rd party systems.
  • Own services in production, including monitoring, debugging, and improving reliability over time
  • Collaborate with product and design to deliver user-focused solutions
  • Support and improve our cloud infrastructure

Outcomes you’ll be responsible for

  • Deliver high-quality, maintainable backend systems that scale with growing usage
  • Take ownership of features/services and ensure they are reliable in production
  • Support and mentor other engineers through collaboration and code review
  • Champion technical excellence and continuous improvement by driving best practices in software development, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure

------

Team

You will be joining a lean & high performing engineering organisation. We value pace, but also hold really high quality standards for each other.

  • The structure: You will be a member of our Backend/Platform team. As a Senior Engineer, you will report directly to our Platform/Backend Lead.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You’ll work in a tight loop with our Product, Design, and Frontend teams.

Our tech & tools:

We lean into modern, scalable infrastructure (Node.js, TypeScript, GCP). We prioritise tools that enable velocity - such as Terraform and automated CI/CD. We also lean heavily into AI, and you’ll be able (encouraged) to use whatever tools you need to scale your own and the team’s workflows

Requirements

  • As a person:
    • You're a proactive Engineer who enjoys collaborating with all areas of the business and our customers directly
    • You’re Passionate about solving complex problems in a team of brilliant people
    • You bring empathy and enthusiasm to help the wider team progress through mentoring. You’ll bring strong experience in GCP and backend design, and support others through collaboration and knowledge sharing
    • You’ll be super curious & love pushing the boundaries of agentic coding & scaling your own abilities
  • As a developer:
    • You’ll have professional experience as a Senior Developer
      • Ideally in a start up
      • Ideally ~5+ years as a developer
    • On that journey, you’ll have worked with lots of variety (exhaustive list below, not all required!):
      • Writing code: Deep understanding of best practices when building Node.js applications with Typescript & experience integrating with a variety of APIs, e.g. REST & SOAP
      • Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure. Ideally Google Cloud Platform, although not required. E.g: Datastore, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, Docker
      • Networking: Solid understanding of VPCs, subnets, private VPNs
      • CI/CD: automation, such as github actions
      • Infrastructure
      • Proven experience with unit testing frameworks such as Jest

Benefits

🏡 Work from home - this is a remote first role

🕜 Flexible working times

🌍 Work abroad for up to 90 days per year

🏖️ 25 days annual leave on top of Irish bank holidays. Plus, take your birthday off and another significant day off of your choice 🎂

🍜 Quarterly meal on us enjoy up to £75 to treat friends or family

🧘‍♀️ Private medical insurance

🎉 Enhanced parental leave to support your family when it matters most

🎳 Quarterly team socials based in London

📚 An annual learning budget to support your growth

💗 Work with purpose - you'll be delivering social impact through improved patient healthcare

🚀 Join at an exciting stage - we're a well-funded, rapidly growing health tech company tackling a global challenge

🌱 Help shape the future of Isla - your ideas won't disappear into layers of management. You'll have real ownership, real impact, and help define how we grow the business

Interviewing with us will be split into 4 stages (all conducted virtually):

1️⃣ A screening interview with someone from our People team - 15 minutes

2️⃣ A technical task you will complete independently

3️⃣ A technical interview with two of our Backend Engineers - 1 hour

4️⃣ A final interview with our Director of Engineering and Co-founder/CTO - 30 minutes

Diversity and Inclusion

Isla is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Isla does not discriminate against anyone on the basis of their race, gender, disability, religion, national origin, age, or any other protected category. We choose to celebrate our team’s differences and see them as one of our most valuable assets.

Recruitment is not one-size-fits-all and we're happy to tailor our hiring process to better meet the needs of individual applicants. Please email with any requests for support.

Using AI tools for your application

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Sobre a Abbott

A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.


Trabalhando na Abbott

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos

Benefícios como Assistência Médica e Odontologica, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Subsidio de Medicamentos, Desconto para compra de ações da Abbott, entre outros.

Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune.

Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas.

Políticas de trabalho flexíveis que permitem um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional.

Um ambiente onde cada pessoa é ouvida e valorizada.


A oportunidade

Esta posição para oportunidade futura com local de trabalho nível Brasil na Divisão de Produtos Estabelecidos. Estamos comprometidos em prover os benefícios de nossos medicamentos de confiança para mais pessoas nos países que mais crescem e se desenvolvem no mundo. Nosso amplo portfólio de medicamentos de marca de alta qualidade e diferenciados alcança múltiplas áreas terapêuticas, incluindo gastroenterologia, saúde feminina, cardiometabólico, sistema nervoso central, respiratório, produtos de consumer health care e vacina contra a gripe.

Como Gerente de Acesso e Contas Estratégicas você terá a missao de fortalecer o engajamento estratégico com as contas-chave nos diferentes sistemas (publico e privado) de saúde brasileiro, promovendo áreas de interesse estratégicas, tratamentos inovadores e soluções para ampliar o acesso às inovações e portfolio da Abbott, sendo o principal ponto de contato do cliente com a ABBOTT.


Você será responsável por introduzir e sustentar o crescimento das inovações da Abbott no ambiente das fontes pagadoras do sistema suplementar, Hospitais privados de alta prioridade para a ABBOTT, sistema público de saúde, assim como a gestão e governança das atividades em nível de conta, orquestrando estas com o time multidissiplinar, demonstrando os benefícios para os pacientes, profissionais de saúde e gestores para a sustentabilidade do ecossistema. Para isso, deverá considerar os diferentes aspectos de impacto no acesso privado: cobertura e processos regulatórios, processos operacionais das fontes pagadoras, modelos de remuneração e de relacionamento entre os players, diferentes incentivos e valores na definição de terapias, jornadas terapêuticas e tendências de mercado do setor - protocolos assistenciais influenciados pelas operadoras de saúde.

E para o acesso publico: Entendimento dos modelos de incorporação, remunerações do sistema e politicas publicas de saúde, conhecimento dos processos referentes a jornada do paciente em instituições hospitalares públicas, secretarias municipais e estaduais.

Você irá gerenciar os principais indicadores de performance das terapias Abbott nos ambientes prestador-pagador (publico & privado) de forma direta. Será responsável pela definição de planos táticos e estratégicos para as diferentes contas e jornadas, considerando a estratégia, ESSOatuando de forma 360° dentro de contas específicas, garantirá a gestão e a entrega de resultados com o suporte das equipes multidisciplinares e áreas viabilizadoras, avaliando oportunidades nas áreas de acesso, promoção, médica e comercial, propondo estratégias eficazes para o desenvolvimento de relações de acesso às inovações de longo prazo.

É crucial manter uma comunicação consistente e personalizada com os stakeholders internos e externos, monitorando e adaptando suas abordagens conforme necessário para alcançar os objetivos corporativos da Abbott e demonstrando o valor gerado dentro da conta em todas as jornadas que atuamos.


O que você vai fazer

Gestão de Relacionamentos

  • Cultivar Relacionamentos: Desenvolver e manter relações sólidas e estratégicas com stakeholders e decisores em contas chave.
  • Ponto de Contato Principal: Servir como o principal ponto de contato para os clientes, assegurando respostas rápidas e eficazes a suas necessidades.

Desenvolvimento de Negócios

  • Promoção e sustentabilidade do relacionamento: Identificar e capitalizar oportunidades para expandir o negócio dentro das contas existentes.
  • Proposta de Soluções: Propor inovações, soluções e serviços adaptados às necessidades dos clientes, promovendo o crescimento sustentável da conta.

Gestão da Informação

  • Utilização de sistemas de CRM corporativos para gerenciar informações das contas envolvendo todos os stakeholders internos e profissionais Abbott que interagem na conta.
  • Gerar insigths e acionavéis a partir dos dados e conhecimendo do cliente e conta.
  • Monitorar e reportar o desempenho das contas, utilizando KPIs e métricas de sucesso específicas.
  • Preparar relatórios regulares e detalhados sobre o status da conta e os resultados das atividades de ampliação.
  • Gerenciamento de Recursos: Alocar e gerenciar recursos de forma eficiente na conta, garantindo que o planejamento versus execução resulte em resultados tangíveis e concretos.

Estratégia e Planejamento

  • Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e implementar planos estratégicos de contas para atingir metas robustas de vendas e crescimento.
  • Canais Digitais: Utilizar canais digitais para interações eficazes com profissionais de saúde, potencializando o impacto e o valor das comunicações.
  • Coordenação Interna: Sincronizar esforços com equipes internas de marketing, comercial, medica e demanda assim como áreas viabilizadoras para atendimento ao cliente para garantir a entrega excepcional de produtos e serviços. Conectando prioridades ABBOTT, cliente e paciente.

Liderança por Influência de Time

  • Orientar e desenvolver membros da equipe de contas, compartilhando melhores práticas, estratégias de sucesso e desenvolvendo competências.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inovador e de alto desempenho em modelos de squads.

Compliance e Ética

  • Garantir que todas as atividades de contas estejam em conformidade com as diretrizes internas, políticas e regulamentações externas.
  • Promover e manter padrões éticos elevados em todas as interações com clientes e em todas as atividades de negócios

Qualificações necessárias

  • Formação superior completa e Desejável Pós-graduação/ MBA.

- Desejável Inglês Avançado.

  • Sólida experiência em gestão de projetos e coordenação de atividades, com habilidade para demonstrar os valores da Abbott, compromissos de liderança, alta capacidade de influência e liderança ágil personalizada (fit-for-purpose).
  • Experiência em relacionamento institucional com clientes do ecossistema - Saúde Suplementar/Fontes Pagadoras/ Hospitais Públicos e secretaria de estado de saúde em diferentes níveis de governança corporativa.
  • Conhecimento sobre modelos de remuneração do ecossistema privado (Saúde suplementar) e sistema Público (Secretarias de estado e Hospitais).
  • Profundo conhecimento multidisciplinar (Acesso; Médico Científico; Experiência do Cliente e Comercial) e seus processos internos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e gerenciar cenários de múltiplas variáveis: diferentes jornadas (portfólio), operadoras, prestadores, modelos de relacionamento.
  • Capacidade de definir com clareza objetivos de médio e longo prazo e processos de acompanhamento de atingimento dos resultados.
  • Experiência em liderar times na alocação de recursos e gestão de budget.
  • Comunicação estrategica: Gerar pautas relevantes e estrategicas com clientes, Promover visibilidade (interna e externa) dos avanços e gargalos dos planos em contas

- Agilidade cultural e organizacional.

  • Satisfação ao trabalhar em ambientes ambíguos e flexíveis.

Candidate-se agora


Siga suas aspirações de carreira nas diversas oportunidades da Abbott, uma empresa que pode ajudar você a construir seu futuro e viver da melhor maneira possível. A Abbott é uma companhia que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, estando comprometida com a diversidade de colaboradores.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

  • Domain: AI-powered sales co-pilot
  • Location: Israel, USA
  • Company size: up to 10 employees
  • Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Join a forward-thinking technology company building intelligent systems that transform how people interact with digital experiences. Focused on the next generation of AI-driven applications, the company develops advanced solutions powered by large language models and real-time decision-making to create responsive, adaptive platforms.

If you’re passionate about building cutting-edge AI systems and want to help shape technology that can reason, adapt, and communicate instantly, this is an opportunity to contribute to a platform redefining intelligent interaction.

What makes you a great fit

  • Native or near-native English, comfortable leading calls with US customers, from end users to enterprise IT
  • Hands-on IT experience: SSO and identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or similar), MDM, VPNs, and user and group management
  • Strong Mac and Windows troubleshooting, including desktop app installs and OS-level permissions
  • Experience with CRM administration or integrations (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot), especially user permissions
  • A structured debugging approach: you can separate user error from a real bug and back it up with evidence
  • Ownership of deadlines and follow-ups across multiple customers at once
  • Experience in a technical support, support engineering, IT or implementation role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprises.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 admin, especially calendar app approvals
  • Familiarity with enterprise security and IT review processes
  • Basic scripting or log analysis skills for debugging
  • Startup experience.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own incoming technical issues end to end, from first report to resolution
  • Resolve issues directly with the customer, or debug them using our internal tools
  • Act as the filter before R&D: decide whether an issue is user error, a product knowledge gap, or a real bug
  • Coach users through product gaps so the same question doesn't come back
  • When it's a bug, confirm it with certainty, then report it to R&D with clear reproduction steps and context
  • Own the technical onboarding of each new pilot, from kickoff to go-live
  • Work with the customer's enterprise IT to set up SSO and identity provider access (Okta and other IdPs), including making sure every pilot user is in the groups allowed to access
  • Handle desktop app rollout on Mac and Windows: installation, OS permissions, and compatibility with the customer's MDM and VPN setup
  • Own CRM connection and onboarding, including working with the customer's CRM admin to make sure users have the right permissions
  • Lead onboarding meetings with customer IT teams and train them on the platform so they can complete the integration
  • Troubleshoot anything that blocks onboarding, and escalate to the CTO when needed
  • Drive follow-ups with customer stakeholders and hit the onboarding deadline committed for each customer.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

jobs.description:
About Us

Zact is a Fintech innovator dedicated to a singular idea : Organizations need simpler expense and payment management systems that align the spending employee with finance and accounting while providing inherent guardrails and continuous reconciliation with financial systems.
Zact enables all parts of the company to Pay by the Rules.

About the Role

We are building out a dedicated Application Support function for our GCP-hosted, microservices-based commercial card and payments platform. This mid-level analyst is the second US seat on the team, working alongside a Lead Application Support Engineer who anchors the function.

You will handle tier-1 and tier-2 support tickets independently, investigate issues across GCP logs and MySQL data, and be a reliable presence during US banking hours for our bank clients. This is a hands-on investigation role — you will spend real time in log consoles and query interfaces, not just routing tickets.

Location

  • Zact is a global company with multiple locations across US, Europe and India.
  • We provide 100% Remote Working Option.
  • Candidates applying for this role should be located in India;

What You’ll Do

Day-to-Day Ticket Handling

  • Own the Zendesk ticket queue during US hours — triage incoming issues by severity, respond within SLA, and resolve or escalate with full documentation
  • Handle known incident types independently using the team’s runbook library — no need to escalate for established patterns
  • Be the first US contact for bank client technical queries — acknowledge promptly, investigate thoroughly, communicate clearly
  • Cover the queue when the Lead is occupied with complex incidents, client escalations, or tooling work

Investigation & Triage

  • Search and filter GCP Cloud Logging to find error entries, trace requests across microservice boundaries using correlation IDs, and identify where failures occur in the service chain
  • Write MySQL SELECT queries against production read replicas to investigate transaction status, card data, account records, and settlement details
  • Escalate to the Lead with a structured handoff — logs reviewed, queries run, hypothesis formed, nothing left vague
  • For P1/P0 incidents, join the Lead immediately — contribute to the investigation rather than waiting for direction

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Check GCP monitoring dashboards and Zendesk alert channels at shift start — surface anything anomalous before clients report it
  • Track open incidents across shifts and ensure clean handoff to the team at end of US day
  • Flag alert noise or misconfigured thresholds to the Lead — you are on the front line and will notice signal problems first

Client Communication

  • Write clear, professional, jargon-free updates to banking client operations teams during and after incidents
  • Follow up on resolved tickets — confirm the fix, provide a plain-language explanation, close cleanly
  • Maintain a professional tone under pressure; bank clients operate in regulated, audit-sensitive environments

Documentation & Knowledge base

  • Document every new issue investigated — symptom, logs found, queries run, resolution or escalation path
  • Contribute to and improve runbook entries after resolving incidents
  • Build and share a personal MySQL query library for common investigation patterns

Technology Environment

  • Cloud platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Logs & monitoring: GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring — primary investigation tools
  • Database: MySQL — read-only investigation queries (SELECT only; strict change-control for anything else)
  • Architecture: Microservices — REST APIs; tracing requests across services using correlation IDs
  • Ticketing: Zendesk — managing your queue, documenting investigations, client communication
  • Scripting: Python / Bash — desirable; the Lead will help you grow here if needed
  • Product domain: Commercial card programs — card issuance, payments authorization, settlement, spend controls
  • Client environment: US community and regional banks — SLA-bound, audit-sensitive, regulated

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years in application support, technical support, IT operations, or a closely related role
  • Solid SQL — you write SELECT queries with JOINs, subqueries, and WHERE clauses without needing a template; you read query results and know what to look for
  • GCP Cloud Logging or equivalent — you have used at least one cloud log platform (CloudWatch, Splunk, Kibana, Datadog, or GCP) to investigate a real production issue
  • Familiarity with microservice concepts — you understand that a user action may touch multiple backend services and know how to trace a request across them
  • REST API literacy — HTTP status codes, reading API responses, identifying where in a request chain an error originated
  • Methodical troubleshooting — you rule out possibilities systematically and document as you go
  • Clear written communication — you can write a calm, professional client-facing update mid-incident
  • Change-control discipline — you never modify production data without explicit authorization

Nice to Have

  • GCP-specific experience — Cloud Logging query syntax (Log Explorer), Cloud Monitoring dashboard navigation
  • Familiarity with Zendesk as a support platform — using ticket views, macros, and SLA tracking
  • Basic Python or Bash scripting — log parsing, simple automation, or one-off scripts count
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment — fintech, banking, healthcare, or telecoms
  • Exposure to commercial card or payments concepts — authorization flows, settlement, spend controls — helpful but fully trainable

Working Hours

  • Standard shift of 8–10 hours per day, US business hours (Eastern or Central preferred for bank client coverage)
  • ~2-hour overlap with India team at start of US day — used for handoff, standups, and any incidents in flight
