jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GENERATIONAt Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GENERATION

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

JOB OBJECTIVES

The BD Associate - Partnerships & Advocacy is responsible for strengthening Generation Ghana's employer ecosystem, strategic partnerships, and market presence to increase employment opportunities and drive graduate outcomes across both Permanent and Freelance programmes.

The role is responsible for the development and management of relationships with aggregators, employers, industry bodies, government agencies, and other strategic stakeholders that contribute to Generation's impact and growth.

Reporting to the Employer Engagement Manager, the BD Associate - Partnerships & Advocacy drives employer acquisition, partnership expansion, stakeholder engagement, employer advocacy, ecosystem visibility, and thought leadership efforts that contribute to Generation Ghana's placement outcomes and long-term sustainability.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic Partnership Development & Management

  • Identify, develop, and manage strategic relationships with employers, aggregators, industry associations, government institutions, ecosystem actors, and workforce development stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain a diversified partnership pipeline that drives Generation's placement, programme and growth objectives.
  • Develop partnership engagement plans and maintain consistent communication with strategic stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for collaboration, co-delivery, referrals, sponsorship, and ecosystem partnerships.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of partnership agreements and engagement frameworks.
  • Maintain accurate records of partnership engagements and opportunities within Salesforce and other designated system.

2. Employer Engagement & Employer Advocacy

  • Strengthen Generation Ghana's reputation as a trusted workforce development partner within the labour market ecosystem.
  • Engage employers to better understand hiring needs, workforce challenges, and sector-specific demand trends.
  • Facilitate employer participation in graduate engagement activities, networking events, mock interviews, employer panels, workshops, and programme-related initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain employer advocacy initiatives that promote graduate success stories and positive employer experiences.
  • Gather employer feedback and insights to support continuous programme improvement and graduate employability outcomes.
  • Support the Employer Engagement team in deepening relationships with existing employers and identifying opportunities for repeat engagement

3. Ecosystem Development & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive relationships across the employment, technology, education, entrepreneurship, and workforce development ecosystems.
  • Represent Generation Ghana at industry events, conferences, networking sessions, ecosystem engagements, and stakeholder forums.
  • Identify opportunities for Generation's increased visibility and influence within relevant sectors and communities.
  • Coordinate stakeholder engagement activities that strengthen Generation's partnerships and market positioning.
  • Support the development and management of engagement initiatives with coalition partners, programme partners, and strategic ecosystem stakeholders.

4. Market Positioning, Events & B2B Marketing

  • Support the implementation of employer engagement campaigns that increase awareness of Generation's programmes, graduates, and employer value proposition.
  • Coordinate employer-focused events, industry roundtables, networking forums, employer showcases, and ecosystem engagement activities.
  • Contribute to the development of employer-facing materials including presentations, partnership decks, case studies, success stories, impact reports, and marketing collateral.
  • Support the utilisation of allocated employer engagement marketing and events budgets in line with agreed objectives.
  • Promote Generation's impact and employer successes through strategic stakeholder engagement opportunities.

5. Labour Market Intelligence & Sector Insights

  • Monitor labour market trends, industry developments, hiring patterns, and workforce needs across priority sectors.
  • Conduct stakeholder and sector mapping exercises to identify emerging partnership and employment opportunities.
  • Gather and analyse market intelligence that informs employer engagement strategies, programme expansion, and curriculum reviews.
  • Share employer and industry insights with programme delivery, placement, and leadership teams to support strategic decision-making.
  • Identify emerging sectors and ecosystem opportunities relevant to Generation's future growth and graduate outcomes.

6. Programme, Partner & Ecosystem Support

  • Support employer and stakeholder engagement activities across Generation's Permanent and Freelance programmes.
  • Collaborate with programme teams, coalition partners, Training Service Providers (TSPs), delivery partners, and other stakeholders to support employment outcome objectives.
  • Support onboarding, orientation, and relationship management activities for new partners and stakeholders where required.
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects, programme launches, employer initiatives, and partnership development activities.
  • Support partner engagement and communication efforts across multi-country and multi-location programmes.

7. Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and timely records of stakeholder engagements, employer interactions, partnership activities, event participation, and opportunities within Salesforce and other systems.
  • Track and report on partnership performance, employer engagement activities, stakeholder engagement outcomes, and ecosystem initiatives.
  • Prepare periodic reports, presentations, and insights that support Employer Engagement planning and decision-making.
  • Ensure stakeholder data quality, completeness, and compliance with organisational standards.

8. Other Responsibilities

  • Undertake any other duties reasonably assigned by the Employer Engagement Manager to support graduate outcomes, partnership growth, employer engagement objectives, and Generation Ghana's broader strategic priorities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years' professional experience in business development, partnerships, stakeholder engagement, account management, B2B sales, client relationship management, advocacy, ecosystem development, consulting, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B sales or business development within a consulting, professional services, training, workforce development, technology, or advisory environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

Business Development & Commercial Acumen

  • Strong understanding of B2B business development, stakeholder engagement, account management, and relationship-building principles.

Job Description

Company Summary

Constellation Brands is a leading international producer and marketer of beer, wine, and spirits with operations in the U.S., Mexico, New Zealand, and Italy. Our mission is to build brands that people love, pushing boundaries to think beyond today because we believe that elevating human connections is Worth Reaching For. Our success is powered by a high-performing, entrepreneurial team that moves with agility, works collaboratively, and is driven to win while growing their careers in a dynamic, rewarding environment.

Position Summary

The Senior Pricing Analyst, Wine & Spirits Revenue Growth Management, independently manages pricing and promotion processes and provides analytical support to RGM, Sales, Brand, and Finance. The role evaluates pricing, promotional effectiveness, and volume, revenue, profit, and PPM performance; delivers actionable recommendations; and develops tools, processes, and controls that strengthen data integrity, execution, and RGM capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Independently manage and coordinate price and promotion changes in Vistaar, partnering with Sales, Sales Finance, and distributors to ensure timely execution and accurate pricing data.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain internal control procedures that support the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of pricing and promotion system data.
  • Design, implement, and maintain analytical tools, processes, systems, and reporting to evaluate volume, revenue, and profit performance against defined key performance indicators and identify actionable opportunities to improve business results.
  • Evaluate pricing actions and strategies, assessing their impact on volume, price, revenue, and profitability and communicating clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Conduct pre- and post-promotion effectiveness analyses and deliver strategic recommendations to improve promotional performance and return on investment.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAt Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Description

At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build, we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

Position Overview:

The Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis is responsible for building and leading Montera's forward-looking financial planning function as the company continues to scale its hyperscale data center development platform.

Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer, this role will own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, project cash flow analysis, and executive reporting. The position partners closely with Development, Delivery, Procurement, People, Accounting, and executive leadership to provide financial visibility, improve planning processes, and support strategic and operational decision-making.

The ideal candidate brings strong financial modeling capabilities, a practical understanding of data center development and construction economics, and experience managing financial planning activities in a capital-intensive environment. Success in this role means establishing reliable financial forecasts, creating scalable planning and reporting processes, and delivering actionable financial insights that support company growth.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys building processes, models, dashboards, and reporting infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables:

Corporate Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Lead the annual budgeting and planning process, including development of templates, planning timelines, departmental inputs, financial consolidation, and leadership reporting.
  • Own and maintain the corporate financial model, including operating expenses, G&A, headcount, capitalized costs, and company-wide financial forecasts.
  • Manage ongoing forecasting and reforecasting activities to provide visibility into financial performance, spending trends, and future funding requirements.
  • Partner with People and Accounting to develop and maintain a rolling headcount model that connects hiring plans to operating budgets and cash flow.
  • Develop financial scenarios and sensitivity analyses to evaluate business decisions, resource allocation, and long-term financial impacts.

Project Financial Analysis & Cash Flow Management

  • Develop and maintain project-level cash flow forecasts to provide visibility into development spending, construction funding requirements, and overall liquidity.
  • Partner with Development and Delivery teams to evaluate project budgets, construction spending, change orders, contingencies, and cost variances.
  • Analyze key development and construction financial metrics, including cost per megawatt (MW), dollars per watt ($/W), and overall project economics.
  • Track construction draw schedules, funding requirements, and projected cash outflows to support financial planning and capital management.
  • Identify financial risks, cost pressures, and opportunities to improve project financial performance.

Procurement & Commercial Financial Support

  • Collaborate with Procurement to evaluate equipment purchasing decisions, payment terms, supplier deposits, milestone payments, and working capital requirements.
  • Assess the financial and cash flow implications of long-lead equipment purchases and major procurement commitments.
  • Support commercial decision-making through financial modeling, pricing analysis, and evaluation of lease economics.
  • Assist in establishing a commercial deal desk to support pricing discipline, financial approvals, and yield-on-cost analysis.
  • Develop financial analyses and recommendations that support project-level investment decisions and commercial negotiations.

Financial Reporting, Analytics & Process Development

  • Build and maintain financial dashboards, key performance indicators, and executive reporting packages for the CFO and leadership team.
  • Provide clear financial reporting on actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and company objectives.
  • Translate complex financial information into actionable recommendations for executive and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Establish scalable financial planning processes, reporting tools, and analytical frameworks as the organization grows.
  • Partner with Accounting and other business functions to improve financial data accuracy, reporting consistency, and operational visibility.
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, automate reporting, and strengthen financial decision-making across the organization.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 6–10 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, development finance, project finance, or a related financial function.
  • Experience working within a data center developer, owner, or operator.
  • Strong understanding of data center development economics, construction costs, capital requirements, and project cash flows.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or playing a significant role in corporate budgeting, financial forecasting, and long-range planning.
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience building and maintaining comprehensive financial models.
  • Experience partnering with development, construction, procurement, accounting, or other operational teams.
  • Strong understanding of project and construction finance, including budgets, cash flow forecasting, contingencies, and cost variance analysis.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.
  • Ability to independently develop financial reporting, dashboards, and analytical tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial information and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced development environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting financial planning for hyperscale data center development, construction, or operations.
  • Experience developing project cash flow models, construction spending forecasts, and capital expenditure plans.
  • Familiarity with data center financial metrics, including cost per MW, $/W, development yields, and lease economics.
  • Experience evaluating commercial agreements, procurement payment structures, or major capital commitments.
  • Background in investment banking, Big Four accounting, transaction advisory, or a similar environment, paired with meaningful operating experience.
  • Experience establishing FP&A processes, financial reporting frameworks, or corporate planning functions within a growing organization.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

  • Remote Work: Montera operates as a remote-first company. Employees are expected to maintain a professional, reliable remote work setup and appropriate availability during working hours.
  • Travel Requirements: Travel may be required for meetings, company planning sessions, and other business activities, depending on organizational needs.
  • Physical Demands: This role primarily involves standard office and computer-based work, including participation in virtual and in-person meetings, financial analysis, and regular communication with internal stakeholders.
  • Montera will provide reasonable accommodations to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role, consistent with applicable law.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

This position offers the opportunity to help establish the FP&A function within a growing data center infrastructure platform. Rather than managing a narrow piece of financial planning within a large organization, you'll partner directly with the CFO and company leadership across development, construction, procurement, and commercial decision-making.

For the right candidate, there is flexibility to consider the position at the Senior Manager level based on relevant data center development and construction finance experience.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable base salary range for this role is $150,000–$180,000 annually, plus an annual performance-based bonus.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences, and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

Why Enlighten?

At Enlighten, our team’s unwavering work ethic, top talent and celebration of innovative ideas have helped us thrive. We know that our employees are essential to our company’s success, so we seek to take care of you as much as you take care of us. Here are a few highlights of our benefits package:

Anticipated Salary Range: $148,203.00 - $230,000.00. The salary range for this role is intended as a good faith estimate based on the role's location, expectations, and responsibilities. Occasionally positions/roles may include additional non-recurrent compensation and will be addressed by the recruiter during the interview process.

Job Description

Enlighten is seeking an experienced and mission-focused Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the day-to-day execution and delivery of our next-generation Data Lakehouse platform—a system that empowers Department of War (DoW) cyber operators with unparalleled data access and analytical capabilities at massive scale.

In this role, you are the connective tissue across our Application, Data, and Infrastructure engineering teams, responsible for turning a prioritized roadmap into shipped, deployed, and accredited software on a predictable cadence. You will own the release train end to end—managing cross-team dependencies, schedules, risk, and communication—so that complex, interdependent components come together into a cohesive product our nation's cyber defenders can depend on. You are the single-threaded owner for platform delivery—leading through influence, earning trust across teams you do not directly manage, and freeing engineering and QA leadership to stay focused on architecture, quality, and the platform's future direction.

You will partner closely with Product Owners, engineering leads, QA, and operations, and communicate release contents and delivery timelines directly to government stakeholders. Product vision, roadmap, and prioritization remain with Product Owners and engineering leadership; you own the execution machinery—backlog to build to release—that turns those priorities into shipped, validated software. Open to remote work within the United States (US), with occasional travel (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.

#Executive

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Program Execution: Drive the platform delivery cadence—monthly sprints and quarterly releases—across all engineering teams. Translate the roadmap into milestone-driven delivery plans.
  • Roadmap Operationalization: Partner with Product Owners to convert roadmap priorities into sprint-ready backlog items with clear acceptance criteria. Manage intake mechanics and track feature validation.
  • Release Management: Orchestrate the end-to-end release process from code-complete to deployment. Coordinate with QA/Release engineering to drive integration testing and go/no-go readiness decisions.
  • Cross-Team Dependencies: Map and sequence interdependencies between engineering teams. Actively unblock components to ensure clean integration and minimize schedule slips.
  • Risk & Blocker Mitigation: Maintain a risk register for schedule, technical, and security risks. Surface issues early and drive path-to-resolution escalations.
  • Financial Monitoring: Track program budget, burn rates, and forecasts. Ensure financial and schedule risks are managed as a single picture.
  • Security Authorization: Shepherd artifacts through customer security scanning and authorization (RMF/ATO) to keep accreditation off the critical path.
  • Program Communication: Establish reporting mechanisms, release notes, and sync cadences to keep engineering and government stakeholders aligned.
  • Technical Deep-Dive: Understand platform architecture (Lakehouse, Kubernetes, IAM) to facilitate technical tradeoff discussions and assess integration risks.
  • Stakeholder Representation: Act as the platform's voice to cyber stakeholders via release announcements and live demos. Ensure successful deployment across operating environments.
  • Business Development Support: Contribute delivery plans and technical inputs to proposals. Deliver platform demonstrations that resonate with DoW requirements.
  • Operational Excellence: Own triage for support and community requests. Partner with Product Owners to turn feedback into prioritized work while improving release processes.
  • Metrics & Improvement: Define and track metrics for predictability, cycle time, and defect rates to drive continuous delivery improvements.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Clearance Requirement: Must obtain and maintain a Secret level U.S. Government Security Clearance, but not required on day one; U.S. Citizenship required.
  • 8+ years in DoW cyber, agile software development, and/or big data with a B.A. in Business, a technical field, or related; 6 years relevant experience with a Master's in a related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 12 years relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in a Technical Program Manager, Program Manager, Delivery Lead, or equivalent role responsible for driving software delivery within an Agile development environment.
  • Demonstrated success driving complex, multi-team software programs to completion—managing dependencies, schedules, risk, and cross-functional communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence rather than authority—setting direction, forcing decisions, and holding teams accountable without direct reporting lines.
  • Demonstrated understanding of modern data architectures, including concepts like data lakes, data lakehouses, data warehousing, and big data technologies.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with DoW or other Federal Government customers, with an understanding of their operational environment, procurement, and accreditation processes.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a talent for making complex technical subjects accessible to varied audiences and for driving clarity across teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage many moving parts simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally (up to 10%, CONUS and OCONUS) to represent the platform at customer and industry events.
  • Ability to work from home office within the U.S. Flexibility is essential to adapt to schedule changes as needed.

Preferred Requirements

  • Current Clearances: Active Secret or Top Secret clearances are a strong plus.
  • DoD 8140 / 8570 compliance certifications may be required in this position as directed by the customer.
  • Program/project management or agile certifications.
  • Professional experience within or adjacent to the cybersecurity domain (e.g., Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence, Network Defense, Incident Response).
  • Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS/Azure data services, and with the container/Kubernetes ecosystem, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps-based deployment.
  • Experience shepherding software through DoW security authorization (RMF/ATO) or container hardening and vulnerability-scanning pipelines.
  • Experience establishing a TPM function within an engineering organization—standing up program mechanisms where none existed and assuming delivery ownership from engineering leads.
  • Experience working alongside Product Owners on backlog refinement, user-story mechanics, and acceptance-criteria validation in an Agile environment.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect) within the GovCon IT space.
  • Experience supporting program financial management (budget tracking, burn-rate monitoring, forecasting) and proposal development in a GovCon environment.
  • A strong understanding of the data lifecycle within a typical cyber security context.

Job Title: Bilingual Medical Patient Coordinator

Position type: Full-Time

Work hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Latin America

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare practice specializing in ultrasound imaging and diagnostic services, dedicated to providing accessible, efficient, and patient-centered care.

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Bilingual Medical Patient Coordinator who is fluent in both English and Spanish to support daily patient communications, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and remote front desk operations.

In this role, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients, helping them navigate appointment scheduling, insurance coverage, and estimated out-of-pocket costs. You will manage high volumes of inbound calls, coordinate patient appointments, and assist the on-site front desk team with remote patient check-ins during busy clinic hours.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in U.S. healthcare administration, medical reception, or virtual medical assistance, with hands-on experience in insurance eligibility and benefits verification. You should be confident handling multiple patient inquiries, communicating clearly in both languages, and maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced medical environment.

If you are a compassionate, detail-oriented healthcare professional who enjoys helping patients and keeping clinic operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Patient Communication & Inbound Call Management

  • Answer and manage high volumes of inbound patient calls professionally and efficiently.
  • Screen patient inquiries, identify their needs, and route calls to the appropriate person or department.
  • Communicate confidently and professionally with both English- and Spanish-speaking patients.
  • Handle inbound and outbound patient communications using RingCentral.
  • Respond to patient questions regarding appointments, insurance coverage, clinic services, and scheduling requirements.
  • Provide clear, accurate, and empathetic information while maintaining excellent patient service.
  • Prioritize incoming calls and requests to support efficient clinic operations.

Insurance Verification & Patient Cost Estimation

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, active coverage, plan benefits, and applicable insurance requirements.
  • Review insurance plan details to determine coverage for requested services.
  • Identify relevant patient financial responsibilities, including deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and other applicable out-of-pocket expenses.
  • Accurately calculate and communicate estimated patient costs before scheduling appointments.
  • Identify insurance discrepancies, missing information, or coverage concerns and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate insurance information and documentation in clinic systems.
  • Explain insurance-related information clearly and professionally to patients.

Appointment Scheduling & Patient Intake

  • Schedule and coordinate patient appointments based on clinic availability.
  • Assist patients with scheduling-related inquiries, appointment details, and next steps.
  • Collect and verify patient demographic, insurance, and other required intake information.
  • Ensure patient information is complete and accurately documented.
  • Coordinate with the on-site clinic team regarding appointment availability and patient needs.
  • Help maintain organized scheduling workflows to minimize delays and confusion.

Remote Front Desk & Clinic Support

  • Provide remote front desk assistance during busy clinic hours.
  • Assist the on-site front desk team with patient check-ins using a tablet or camera-based system when call volume and workload permit.
  • Support patient intake and registration processes remotely.
  • Balance inbound calls, scheduling responsibilities, insurance verification, and front desk assistance.
  • Communicate effectively with clinic staff to support smooth patient flow.
  • Follow established clinic procedures for patient check-ins and administrative coordination.

Healthcare Systems & Documentation

  • Utilize RingCentral for inbound and outbound patient communications.
  • Learn and navigate EMSOW PACS, the clinic's cloud-based ultrasound imaging system; training will be provided.
  • Maintain accurate patient records, insurance details, and appointment information.
  • Follow clinic-specific workflows, documentation standards, and operational procedures.
  • Ensure all patient information is handled in accordance with HIPAA and confidentiality requirements.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Inbound Call Management & Patient Communication

Efficiently manage high volumes of patient calls, identify the purpose of each inquiry, and route calls appropriately while maintaining professional, compassionate communication in English and Spanish.

2. Insurance Verification & Patient Cost Estimation

Accurately verify insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits, and provide patients with clear, reliable estimates of their financial responsibility before appointments are scheduled.

3. Remote Front Desk & Patient Check-In Support

Assist the on-site front desk team with remote patient check-ins and intake coordination during busy clinic hours while effectively balancing calls, scheduling, and other administrative responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Bilingual Medical Patient Coordinator provides an excellent patient experience while helping the clinic operate efficiently.

Success in this role includes:

  • Consistently handling high volumes of inbound patient calls professionally.
  • Communicating clearly and confidently in both English and Spanish.
  • Accurately verifying insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage.
  • Providing reliable patient cost estimates before scheduling.
  • Maintaining accurate patient records and appointment information.
  • Supporting efficient scheduling and patient intake processes.
  • Assisting with remote patient check-ins when workload permits.
  • Effectively prioritizing multiple responsibilities during busy clinic hours.
  • Maintaining HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality.
  • Demonstrating reliability, initiative, and strong teamwork.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Fluent in both English and Spanish, including verbal and written communication (mandatory and non-negotiable).
  • Previous experience in U.S. healthcare administration, medical reception, medical scheduling, or virtual medical assistance.
  • Hands-on experience verifying U.S. patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits.
  • Ability to review insurance plan information and accurately determine estimated patient out-of-pocket costs.
  • Experience managing high volumes of inbound patient calls in a medical or healthcare environment.
  • Strong patient communication and customer service skills.
  • Experience handling appointment scheduling, patient inquiries, and intake-related responsibilities.
  • Ability to screen incoming calls and route inquiries appropriately.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare administrative workflows.
  • Excellent attention to detail when reviewing insurance information and patient records.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize calls, insurance verification, scheduling, and front desk support in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional, patient, empathetic, and service-oriented communication style.
  • Proactive and dependable, with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to learn new systems and adapt to clinic-specific procedures.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality standards.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with on-site clinic staff and other healthcare team members.
  • Must be able to work exclusively with the assigned practice during scheduled working hours, without overlapping employment or client commitments.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience as a Medical Receptionist or Medical Virtual Assistant supporting a U.S.-based healthcare practice.
  • Experience working in radiology, ultrasound imaging, diagnostic imaging, or another medical specialty.
  • Experience providing patient cost estimates based on insurance benefits.
  • Experience supporting medical front desk operations remotely.
  • Experience with remote patient registration or check-in systems.
  • Familiarity with RingCentral or similar VoIP systems.
  • Experience using healthcare EHR/EMR, practice management, or imaging-related platforms.

Systems & Tools

The role will use:

AtScale is the semantic layer for modern data and AI.   • Handle the hard cross-protocol problems, including query translation between MDX, DAX, and SQL, while managing authentication and token flows.
  • Reproduce, triage, and fix customer-reported bugs against real semantic models, turning recurring issues into durable fixes and better tests rather than one-off patches.
  • Build and expand automated test coverage (integration and end-to-end) so adapter regressions are caught before customers see them.

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Analyst is responsible for day‐to‐day user access operations within the Cybersecurity operations team, including ensuring timely user access provisioning/deprovisioning; user access policy, standards, and process improvements via task automation and efficient workflows ensuring least privilege access to Guthrie systems and information. Core responsibilities include analyzing requirements, documenting standards, and administering IAM functions: Identity Governance and Administration, Privilege Access Management (PAM), Single Sign‐On, Imprivata “tap and go”, federation, Multi‐Factor Authentication, user access policy and standards, user access request management, and provisioning (Azure AD, Active Directory, LDAP and EPIC EMR security).

Education, License & Cert:

  • High school diploma required. Bachelors preferred.
  • Epic Security certification or within a year of hire.
  • Professional security certification or within 12 months of hire/in role.

Experience:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience as an information security analyst or IT business analyst
  • 2+ years' experience with technical experience of PAM, IAM tooling and processes
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and planning skills
  • Experience with scripting languages. (PowerShell, Perl, Python, Ruby, etc.)
  • Strong verbal and written skills to develop technical documentation, training, and presentations
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning via training, self‐study and formal education to maintain technical proficiency within the cybersecurity domain
  • Demonstrated experience with IT controls design and implementation

Essential Functions:

Identity and Access Management:

  • Understand the scope of the health services Guthrie provides its patients and the threat landscape that may disrupt these services
  • Define user access policy, standards, roles and procedures for security, efficiency, and scalability
  • Effectively communicate user access policy and standards to stakeholders
  • Participate in project work to ensure user access controls are addressed in technology designs, workflows and operating procedures
  • Participate and/or lead AD, PAM, IAM, and MFA tool installation, integration, support, and operations
  • Participates in the development, validation, and execution of comprehensive IAM use cases and test plans.
  • Identifies, analyzes, and resolves data and complex user access workflow issues.
  • Demonstrates ability to diagnose and resolve AD, PAM, MFA and IAM issues and to recommend areas for process improvement or innovation to management.
  • Provisioning and deprovisioning of regular, privileged, and Epic EMR user access
  • Maintain effective relationships with key technology vendors, industry professionals, security forums and professional associations.

Support System compliance and Information Security certification:

  • Stay informed of cyber/information security laws, regulations, and standards that may affect the information security and risk management program
  • Participate in conducting an annual user entitlement review processes across the organization
  • Aid in documenting IAM control gap findings, impacts and recommendations to management
  • Develop and maintain IAM playbooks documenting user access controls, standards and procedures
  • Establish actionable metrics to support the IAM/cyber program and influence behaviors

Other duties as assigned.

jobs.description:
Salesforce Administrator

Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

GoodPower is seeking a Salesforce Administrator who will be an essential part of the Product Engineering and Data Team. This person will support the ongoing administration and improvement of our CRM platform (Salesforce) and serve as the bridge between the teams who use Salesforce and the people who build it. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and functionality and has experience with the Nonprofit Success Pack (NPSP).

The Salesforce Administrator (the "Administrator") will work across teams, including Development (fundraising), Campaigns, and Advocacy. The Administrator will translate the business processes those teams define into clear system requirements, then deliver them: building routine configuration directly, and scoping, coordinating, and testing larger work delivered by contractors and implementation partners. The Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day configuration, support, maintenance, and improvement of GoodPower's Salesforce environment. As a member of the Data team, the Administrator will also focus on data hygiene and integrations with other systems.

This role is the Data team's day-to-day counterpart to the Development team's Director, Development Operations & Systems. The Director defines what Development needs from Salesforce. The Administrator turns those needs into requirements and system changes, and is accountable for making sure what gets built works as specified.

Technical skill is only half of this role. The Administrator is the person staff turn to when they need Salesforce explained, and is expected to lead: running trainings, championing good data practices, and making sure what the Data team builds is understood and used across the organization. We're looking for someone who can explain a data model to a fundraiser as clearly as they can explain a fundraising workflow to a developer.

This is a full-time, remote position. Candidates must be willing to work a consistent 8-hour day, during a slot of their choosing, between 9am and 8pm Eastern Time. The Administrator will work from home, meet with teams by video as needed, and join weekly online all-staff meetings. Occasional travel is required for relevant events, staff retreats, and other convenings. The Administrator reports to the Data Director.

Division of Responsibilities for Salesforce

Salesforce is shared infrastructure. Ownership is split by design so that every decision has one clear owner:

  • Development owns the what: fundraising requirements, moves management stages and workflows, data entry standards, the reports and dashboards leadership needs, and team adoption.
  • The Data team owns the how: platform administration, the data model, automations, permissions, integrations, and data consistency across systems.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Administration & Data Management

  • Serve as Salesforce system administrator and handle day-to-day configuration, including user account maintenance, roles and profiles, custom objects and fields, flows and automations, Lightning email templates, and Lightning page layouts.
  • Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for upgrades.
  • Maintain data quality across Salesforce and related systems: build validation and duplicate rules, run bulk updates, cleanup, and deduplication, and perform routine quality checks.
  • Build and maintain the reports and dashboards that leadership and teams rely on, to requirements those teams define.
  • Support data imports, exports, reporting requests, and investigation of data discrepancies.
  • Provide day-to-day Salesforce user administration and support, including routine access, permissions, and troubleshooting.
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, system how-to guides, and other support documentation.

Training, Adoption & Communication

  • Design and deliver Salesforce training for staff at every level of technical comfort, from onboarding new users to rolling out new features, through live sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and written guides.
  • Drive adoption of Salesforce across teams: track how the system is being used, notice where people are working around it, and partner with team leads to close the gaps.
  • Announce and explain system changes in plain language: what's changing, why, and what users need to do differently.
  • Champion data quality by helping staff understand why good data entry matters to fundraising results, not just how to do it.
  • Hold regular office hours where staff can bring questions, frustrations, and ideas, and turn recurring pain points into backlog items.

Requirements, Delivery & Contractor Coordination

  • Serve as the Data team's day-to-day point of contact for Development systems leadership and other stakeholder teams: take in requests, clarify needs, and translate them into written requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain the Salesforce enhancement backlog and work with stakeholders and Data team leadership to prioritize it.
  • Complete routine configuration directly. For larger work, such as custom development, integrations, and data pipelines:
    • scope the work for contractors and implementation partners,
    • coordinate delivery,
    • test it against acceptance criteria before release,
    • escalate code-level and architectural review to senior Data team engineers.
  • Monitor the health of integrations between Salesforce and connected systems including: Engaging Networks, GCP, BigQuery, Cloudingo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Reporting tools - Data Studio, Atlassian, n8n. Serve as first responder when a sync fails, and scope the fix.
  • Bring proposed changes to the business owner for sign-off before release, and communicate changes to affected users.
  • Document all configuration and integrations so system knowledge stays in-house, regardless of who built it.

Support GoodPower's Fundraising CRM Needs

  • Configure and maintain the Salesforce tools that support cultivation, stewardship, moves management, and progress-to-goal tracking, built to the stages and workflows Development defines.
  • Build and maintain automations and forms for donation acknowledgments and revenue tracking, to requirements set by Development and Finance.
  • Help ensure the Salesforce data model supports nonprofit fundraising and grant tracking workflows as Development defines them.

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience with Salesforce and standard CRM data operations in a nonprofit fundraising context, including:
    • strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and functionality;
    • experience making Salesforce configuration changes, including fields, page layouts, flows and automation, and reports and dashboards;
    • proven ability to support the implementation of new processes and help users adopt them;
    • experience translating stakeholder needs into written requirements, user stories, or specifications, and working with developers, consultants, or contractors to deliver and test them.
  • Working knowledge of how systems exchange data (APIs, integrations, imports and exports) and how integration failures show up.
  • Familiarity with ticketing and project tracking tools such as Jira.
  • Comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, reports, and data quality processes, with strong attention to detail and data hygiene.
  • A self-starter with an analytical mindset and a demonstrated ability to:
    • troubleshoot challenges with patience and creativity;
    • adapt as needed to take on additional roles, responsibilities, and opportunities;
    • manage multiple workstreams with thoroughness, accuracy, timeliness, and professionalism.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical concepts to non-technical colleagues in clear, jargon-free language, both in writing and in person.
  • Experience designing and leading trainings, workshops, or onboarding for users with a wide range of technical comfort.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead by building trust across teams, influencing how colleagues work, and driving adoption of new tools or processes.
  • Patience, empathy, and a service mindset toward colleagues who find technology frustrating or intimidating.
  • Comfort presenting to senior leadership as well as frontline staff.
  • Familiarity with nonprofit fundraising, donor management, grant and revenue tracking, and/or development operations.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification, or progress toward it, is strongly preferred.

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $95,000 - 110,000, commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
  • 8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
  • 8 weeks of paid parental leave

GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement

GoodPower is an equal-opportunity employer that highly values diversity, equity, and inclusion and views the climate crisis as a social justice crisis.

People who identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC), people who experience gender oppression, people with disabilities, and people who identify as members of the LGBTQIA+ community are particularly encouraged to apply.

GoodPower is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, GoodPower will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of the position. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or employment process, please contact

Automated Application Review Disclosure

To help us process high volumes of applications fairly and efficiently, GoodPower utilizes Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDTs). These tools scan, evaluate, and rank candidate resumes based on how closely their skills, experience, and qualifications match the core requirements of this job posting.

  • Data Privacy: Your resume data will only be processed for this specific application and will be handled securely in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
  • Human Oversight: Final hiring decisions are always made by a human recruiter or hiring manager.

By submitting an application, you consent to the use of automated tools to review and assess your application materials for this position.

At NVIDIA, AI agents are becoming part of how work gets done across engineering and enterprise workflows! As these systems begin to access tools, call APIs, and participate in multi-step operations, the identity and security controls built primarily for human users need to evolve to support non-human and agent-driven workflows safely and reliably.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to help define and build core agentic identity capabilities that enable trusted AI agents across NVIDIA’s internal ecosystem. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can turn complex problems into practical designs, quickly prototype solutions, and work across identity, security, platform, and application teams to bring the right infrastructure into production.

What you will be doing:

  • Architect and build agent identity security features for agent use cases across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Apply relevant standards and patterns where possible. Rapidly prototype, validate, and iterate on innovative ways when gaps remain, such as credential brokering, token exchange, delegation, workload identity, and lifecycle management.

  • Rapidly identify the highest-value MVP for ambiguous security and identity problems, prototype solutions, validate them with partner teams, and iterate toward production-ready services.

  • Build reusable skills, CLI tools, APIs, and integration patterns that help internal teams embrace secure agent identity approaches across enterprise tools and platforms.

  • Partner closely with teams across Enterprise Security, Product Security, Enterprise AI, Enterprise Product and relevant platform teams to align architecture with real workflow needs and operational constraints.

  • Contribute to architectural direction, reviews, and engineering standards for agentic identity and related security infrastructure across the company.

  • Help evaluate emerging standards, open-source technologies, and vendor capabilities in agentic identity, and translate the relevant pieces into pragmatic internal builds and roadmap recommendations.

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field.

  • 15+ years in software engineering, security engineering, identity, distributed systems, or related areas, including significant hands-on technical leadership.

  • Proven track record to frame sophisticated problem spaces, define an MVP, prototype quickly, and evolve ideas into reliable production systems..

  • Strong software engineering skills, including crafting and building backend services, APIs, automation, or platform components in programming environments. The role requires quickly learning new languages, frameworks, and tools as needed.

  • Experience in offensive security, adversarial thinking, red teaming, or attack-path analysis, capable of applying that perspective to architecture decisions and security tradeoffs.

  • Experience with device trust, endpoint posture, or hardware-backed trust signals, and an understanding of how device identity and device state can strengthen access decisions for agentic, workload, and human-to-agent workflows.

  • Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, balance security with usability and adoption, and drive pragmatic technical outcomes through influence.

Intelligent machines powered by artificial intelligence—computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people—are transforming every industry. GPU-accelerated deep learning provides the foundation for machines to perceive, reason, and solve complex problems. NVIDIA GPUs run deep learning algorithms that simulate aspects of human intelligence, acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world.

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Perception Engineer to lead the design and productization of NVIDIA’s next-generation autonomous driving perception stack. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical leadership. You will set the technical direction for 3D obstacle perception, drive cross-functional execution, and mentor other engineers, while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture, algorithms, and implementation, including modern transformer-based, multi-modal, and vision-language techniques where they add real value.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for 3D obstacle perception to support end-to-end autonomous driving functionalities, leveraging state-of-the-art CNN and transformer-based architectures where appropriate.
  • Design and develop advanced 3D perception models using multi-camera inputs and/or multi-sensor fusion (camera, radar, lidar) for obstacle detection and tracking, including opportunities to explore BEV and transformer-based 3D perception.
  • Lead the development of efficient, production-grade deep learning models: define objectives, select architectures, guide experimentation, and establish best practices for training and evaluation, using techniques such as large-scale pretraining, distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA).
  • Define and drive KPI frameworks to quantify perception performance; analyze large-scale real and synthetic datasets to identify failure modes and systematically improve accuracy, robustness, and efficiency, incorporating modern approaches like self-supervised and representation learning when beneficial.
  • Lead data strategy for perception: specify data and labeling requirements, prioritize data collection and annotation, and collaborate closely with data and ground-truth teams to maximize impact, including model-assisted workflows (e.g., active learning, auto-labeling, VLMs) and advanced model-in-the-loop tooling.
  • Partner with safety, systems, and software teams to ensure perception solutions meet stringent product requirements for safety, latency, resource usage, and software robustness, and are ready for deployment at scale.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, influencing design and implementation across the broader perception and autonomy teams.

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of hands-on experience developing deep learning–based perception or closely related systems for complex real-world problems, with strong proficiency in frameworks such as PyTorch and a track record of taking models from prototype to production.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership as a senior or principal-level individual contributor: owning features or subsystems end-to-end, setting technical direction, making architectural decisions, and coordinating across teams.
  • Proven experience in data-driven development, including close collaboration with data, labeling, and ground-truth teams on data strategy, labeling quality, and iterative model improvement.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++, with a history of building reliable, high-performance, production-quality software.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive consensus across multidisciplinary teams.
  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent experience).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Proven track record leading the design and deployment of perception solutions for autonomous driving or robotics using camera-based deep learning at scale.
  • Hands-on experience architecting and deploying DNN-based perception pipelines on embedded or real-time platforms, including optimization for latency, memory, and compute constraints, and experience with modern architectures such as CNNs and transformers, plus familiarity with techniques like large-scale pretraining, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), or vision-language models (VLMs).
  • Strong publication record or recognized contributions in deep learning, computer vision, or autonomous systems at leading conferences/journals (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, IROS).
  • Deep understanding of 3D computer vision fundamentals, including camera modeling and calibration (intrinsic and extrinsic), multi-view geometry, and 3D representations, ideally with experience applying these concepts in transformer-based 3D or BEV perception pipelines.
  • Experience with CUDA development and optimizing training or inference pipelines through custom CUDA kernels or other GPU-accelerated components.

  • Prioritize opportunities. Work with business and technical leaders to identify promising uses of AI. Weigh expected benefits, readiness, data needs, effort, risk, and cost. Define success measures and recommend which initiatives to fund, expand, adjust, or stop.

  • Clarify ownership and decisions. Define responsibilities and handoffs from early experiments through deployment and retirement. Resolve conflicts between enterprise and functional requirements within your authority, document decisions, and respect existing approval responsibilities.

  • Support employee adoption. Provide training suited to different roles, practical guides, templates, office hours, and peer learning. Build an AI champion network and use employee feedback to make approved tools and practices easier to use.
  • Build team capabilities. Partner with functional leaders to address skill gaps, support changing roles, and set AI goals that improve workflows, quality, employee experience, and business results.
  • Guide technology choices. Work with Engineering, IT, Security, and other responsible teams to select approved tools, reduce duplication, and develop reusable capabilities. Evaluate when to build, buy, or configure solutions.
  • Establish technical standards. Partner with implementation teams on access controls, activity records, monitoring, incident response, and ongoing management of AI systems.
  • Test ideas in practice. Use AI-assisted development and targeted prototypes to test assumptions before larger investments. Work closely with teams that build and operate production systems to understand technical constraints and trade-offs.
  • Measure results and costs. Build an executive scorecard covering adoption, business outcomes, quality, reliability, risk, cost, and value. Work with Finance and functional owners to establish baselines, verify benefits, and identify underused capabilities.
  • Lead through collaboration. Build trusted relationships across business and technical teams. Partner closely with the Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations to align enterprise requirements with operational needs. Lead executive reviews with clear recommendations, decisions, and follow-through.

Requirements:

  • Ability to prioritize opportunities, turn unclear business problems into actionable requirements, and deliver measurable operational or financial results.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain technical topics clearly, build agreement, and lead without direct authority.
  • Relevant credentials, such as IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, ISACA AAISM, CRISC, or CGEIT, or equivalent practical experience implementing enterprise AI governance.

Preferred Requirements:

ABOUT ACCELA
For nearly 20 years, Accela has been an industry leader in designing and delivering government software to improve efficiency, increase citizen engagement and enable the development of thriving communities. We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our engineering team and help shape the future of programmatic advertising. You'll architect and build high‑performance systems that process millions of ad transactions in real time, while leveraging cutting‑edge AI technologies to optimize outcomes for our partners.

This role sits at the intersection of ad‑tech and AI, working with massive‑scale systems and sub‑millisecond latency requirements. You’ll own the full development lifecycle from architecture to deployment, collaborating with a modern, high‑performing engineering team.

What makes you a great fit

How to become a Junior Project Manager at scandiweb eCommerce expert team?

We are a very inclusive company with colleagues across 30+ countries on all continents with the female developer ratio being among the highest in the industry. We welcome people from different paths of life, who can complete a technical test, which consists of a project challenge.

The test does not check any particular Project Management knowledge or understanding of a technology we work with. Instead, it aims to test common sense and understanding of cause-effect relationships, attention to detail, and the ability to give clear instructions in written and visual form. We also test your capability to learn during the test as we will share educational materials for some of the tasks.
Everybody who completes the Entry Level test and successfully passes the Practical Trial day task, is invited to an interview with 90% chance to be employed. We are confident that if you can complete the test task and technical interview, you have the necessary background to let us guide you further on the path to engineering expertise and enterprise-level delivery.
Your previous experience and education do not matter; what matters is your ability to deliver results starting from the test task, and your enthusiasm and openness to embrace new knowledge and processes. You can even fail the test and re-apply in 3 to 6 months to re-do it; we will provide you with feedback and will appreciate your ability to act on it to improve and pass. Continuous learning and acting on feedback are among our core organizational values.

What are the responsibilities of a Junior Project Manager?

Once you start your career at scandiweb, your first responsibility is to complete onboarding in the company, setting you up in all the processes and systems. This process is outlined in our Learning System and you will be supported by an HR member of our team.
Your next responsibility is to complete the Starter Training Course to ensure that you can join a commercial project with a minimum necessary knowledge of the workflow and quality requirements.

Once you start your active work in the role of Junior Project Manager, your responsibilities are:
  • Converting high-level user stories into smaller tasks, making sure the task aligns with the capabilities of the platform requiring configuration, styling, extension, or custom coding to achieve the necessary result;
  • Scheduling and facilitating set team processes such as daily standup, sprint planning, and demos;
  • Maintaining a friendly ambiance within your team, engaging our Events Team to arrange ice-breaking or celebratory events for your team;
  • Notifying the Senior Project Manager assigned to you or the Delivery Manager of any blockers, concerns, or issues beyond your resolution ability;
  • Keeping project roadmap and timeline updated, understanding project scope, and escalating once you see that there is a scope creep risk from design changes, functionality changes, or third-party dependency changes;
  • Being able to provide feedback on your team's competence, ability to communicate, and deliver results on time;
  • Assessing project scope versus resources available and requesting the Resourcing team to onboard extra or offboard some team members;
  • Maintaining active communication with customers and third-party teams to resolve any pending questions with them or escalate such to your more senior colleagues;
  • Collaborating with internal competency centers to improve delivery results and ensure the use of best practices;
  • Upgrading existing competencies by taking part in the relevant certification processes organized by the company;
  • Deepening your knowledge of libraries, frameworks, and platforms that are necessary for a successful delivery for customers;
  • Integrating internal and external AI tools and Co-pilots to improve the speed and quality of your Project Management work.
At scandiweb, we are committed to developing well-rounded professionals. You’ll have the chance to grow beyond your initial role by gaining cross-disciplinary expertise to stay on top of industry trends and excel in the future as an eCommerce expert.

Remember, at scandiweb, you will be given the necessary and sufficient training to understand the capabilities of the tools and platforms we are using. This knowledge is a key success factor in describing, detailing, and delegating work to your team.
At scandiweb, a Project Manager is not merely an administrative role putting together charts, timelines, and facilitating processes, but instead is a driving force for the project delivery coming from understanding platform capabilities and customer needs on a business level. There is a component of a small-scale Solution Architect in our Project Management role. This will help you to advance further in your career and not face the usual Project Management glass ceiling.

Further career growth for Junior Project ManagerYou will get support in career counseling from our HR department as each career path is unique taking into account your personal strengths and ambitions.
A successful Junior Project Manager becomes an independent Project Manager within a year mastering the technology, communication, and business context of their work while

Project managers typically advance to a Senior Project Manager role within the next 1-2 years by gaining the ability to oversee multiple projects and their teams, to lead the work of Junior Project managers while understanding and addressing core concerns of customers and ensuring delivery in cooperation with Delivery Managers and other internal parties.
The role culminates in a Delivery Manager and Partner position in another 2-5 years, where you take strategic ownership over the delivery of multiple projects in your portfolio by guiding responsible Project Managers and teams ensuring good project vitals, focusing on expanding cooperation, and building relations with existing and new clients.

What will help you to advance in your career starting as a Junior Project Manager?
  • Deepening your knowledge of libraries, frameworks, and platforms that are necessary for a successful delivery for customers;
  • Initially, you will focus on one specific technology or platform among the ones we use and later you will have an opportunity to expand your knowledge with other ones. The libraries we work with are React, JavaScript, Alpine, PHP, NodeJS, MySQL, ScandiPWA, Adobe Commerce, Magento, Pimcore, Sanity, and Shopify Plus;
  • Understanding your success KPIs which we will share with you and setting the goals to improve them;
  • Learning and implementation of project planning and resource management;
  • Knowledge of Scrum, Agile, and other project management methodologies and terminology;
  • Ability to speak up and proactively ask questions about your work, seek clarification for your tasks, and support and guidance from your senior colleagues;
  • Ability to integrate the use of various performance optimization tools in your learning and delivery;
  • Following the continuous learning process passing suggested courses internally and obtaining valuable external credentials such as globally recognized certifications that the company will arrange for you;
  • Participating in the company-organized events to foster collaboration both online and offline.

What is the compensation package of a Junior Project Manager at scandiweb?

  • Competitive starting salary relative to the market;
  • Salary revisions and upgrades that happen twice a year;
  • Growth path to becoming a Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Delivery Manager, and Partner;
  • Support for hardware upgrades;
  • Core health insurance coverage and sports bonuses;
  • A diverse multinational team of experts to learn from;
  • Best tools for collaboration, coding, quality assurance, and communication;
  • Company-covered training and certification;
  • Legendary online and onsite events to celebrate our success together.
Next steps
  • Apply and fill in the application form
  • Receive the test task and complete it.
Here is what people who joined as Junior Project Managers want to share with you:
“From my time at scandiweb I have learned that there is nothing you cannot handle - no matter how complicated things can seem at the moment, there will always be a solution.”
Svitlana Madei, Project Manager from Ukraine. Joined the company on 6/5/2022
“I joined as a Junior Project Manager and just started my EDU courses. In a few weeks, I got my first project, and in four months - I became the main Project Manager for a project with a multi-billion dollar company. Then I grew to senior level.
I like to learn new things, and scandiweb is a great provider of such opportunities. Now, my biggest challenge is to be a great AI Lead - building cool tools internally and helping our clients to stay on top of the game.”
Valters Cakss, Project Manager from Latvia. Joined the company on 22/7/2020
“Working in scandiweb has taught me that being enthusiastic about work and that taking challenges pays off. A great experience for me has been the possibility to get a quick rise if you put in the work. I also love conversing with coworkers and motivating them, helping them get going to become a field expert. ”
Aleksander Traks, Project Manager from Estonia. Joined the company on 15/11/2021
