jobs.title: Senior UI Designer
jobs.excerpt: In shortAs our Senior UI Designer, you'll shape how people interact with real, physical devices: the app that pairs with a smart ring, the interface that controls high-end speakers, the screen that shows your heart rate live.
jobs.description:
In short

As our Senior UI Designer, you'll shape how people interact with real, physical devices: the app that pairs with a smart ring, the interface that controls high-end speakers, the screen that shows your heart rate live. Your designs won't end up in a drawer; you'll take them from the first client workshop all the way to production, working with international startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients, side by side with a world-class UX team and developers who genuinely care about design. It's a permanent, full-time role: fixed monthly salary and full benefits from day one.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008: wearables, smart audio, and health-tech hardware for clients like Oura, BOSE, and McIntosh, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and we've been AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. If you've ever designed a pairing flow and felt weirdly proud when the LED actually blinked, you already get why we love what we do.

Who this role is NOT for

If you want a neat list of tickets every morning, and design for you means filling in screens someone else already thought through, we're probably not your people. Same if you work 8-16, log off, and would rather never hear about design systems, experiments, or knowledge-sharing again. We look for designers who ask "why" before "how", who show their work early, and who care about the device on the other end of the screen, not just the screen itself. And we're AI-native: if AI tools feel like a gimmick to you, we're not the right fit.

What you'll do

  • Conduct design workshops with clients and turn messy inputs into clear design directions

  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and prototypes for new and existing products and features, mostly native iOS and Android apps

  • Design interfaces where software meets hardware: pairing flows, device status, sensor data visualization

  • Support projects from initial design to final production, in close collaboration with developers, QA, and PMs

  • Help implement and develop our new branding

  • Push and experiment with new ideas, trends, and tools, and turn the good ones into team standards

  • Share knowledge within and outside of intent: chapter sessions, tech talks, the design community

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of commercial experience in UI design; product design is something you genuinely enjoy living and breathing

  • Advanced Figma skills: design systems built on components and auto-layouts, and files other designers can actually navigate

  • Hands-on experience designing interfaces for IoT and connected devices (not "I read about it once")

  • A broad portfolio of visually rich work you're proud to walk us through

  • Solid knowledge of Apple's Human Interface Guidelines and Android platform guidelines, paired with a real passion for mobile technology

  • Some experience with motion and animation, not only static screens

  • The basics of Photoshop and Illustrator

  • Very good English (C1), because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Confidence presenting designs to clients and explaining your decisions; joining pre-sales calls with potential clients doesn't scare you

  • Initiative, ownership, and the kind of communication where people don't have to guess what you meant

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for wearables, health-tech, or smart audio

  • Motion design tools: After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar

  • Experience running or co-running brand design work

  • Familiarity with designer-developer handoff beyond the mockup: design tokens, variables, naming conventions

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices you design for, not just the interfaces on top of them

How we work

Fully remote with an office in Warsaw if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the UX/UI Design chapter for knowledge-sharing and growth, and simultaneously on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery, working alongside mobile and firmware engineers, QA, and UX designers.

What you'll get

  • 15,500-22,000 PLN net/month on B2B, depending on your experience

  • 26 days of paid leave

  • 10 days of paid sick leave

  • Saltus medical care

  • Training budget

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your own day

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy from the design team and take on progressively bigger tasks so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often; no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. We believe in fast, honest signals: if it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions and your portfolio

  2. Portfolio review

  3. HR call (~45 min, casual)

  4. Technical interview (30-60 min, with the design team)

  5. Final feedback

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV, your portfolio, and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you point us to the project you're most proud of and tell us why.

jobs.excerpt: 💫Про RIA. com Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.
jobs.description:
💫Про RIA.com

Ми — українська продуктова ІТ-компанія RIA.com, яка розвиває відомі маркетплейси AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com. Нашими продуктами користуються мільйони українців, тож команда фахівців наполегливо працює над покращеннями та пошуками інноваційних рішень.

Ми шукаємо Клієнт-менеджера в команду Служби турботи про користувачів. На цій позиції ти будеш допомагати клієнтам швидко та якісно вирішувати їхні запити.

🔷Які задачі стоять перед Клієнт-менеджером:
  • Телефонні консультації: відповідає на вхідні та здійснює вихідні дзвінки клієнтів та допомагає у вирішенні їх запитів щодо продуктів компанії: AUTO.RIA, DIM.RIA, AGRO.RIA та RIA.com.
  • Письмові консультації: опрацювання звернень від користувачів в чатах та електронній пошті.
  • Сервісні запити: робота з CRM системою Creatio та взаємодія з іншими командами.
В середньому клієнт-менеджер отримує 60-80 звернень за робочий день.

⚡️Тепер про очікування до кандидата, якого шукаємо:
  • Досвід роботи з клієнтами: телефонні консультації або офлайн-взаємодія.
  • Турботливий підхід та емпатія: вміння розуміти потреби клієнта й прагнення допомогти.
  • Орієнтація на високий рівень сервісу: здатність забезпечити якісний клієнтський досвід навіть у складних ситуаціях.
Буде перевагою:
  • Досвід роботи з CRM-системами.
  • Досвід роботи у сфері підтримки клієнтів або контакт-центрі.
🔗Про етапи інтерв'ю:
  • Після відбору твого резюме — телефонний дзвінок з рекрутером.
  • Співбесіда в онлайн форматі з Лідеркою команди та тренером.
  • Запрошення на оплачуване стажування віддалено або в офісі (2-3 тижні)
📌Що на тебе чекає в RIA.com?
  • Практичне втілення командних цінностей: відкрита комунікація, індивідуальні тренінги з тренером, фідбек, підтримка наставника із першого дня для швидкої адаптації, без мікроменеджменту чи тайм-трекерів.
  • Комфортні умови роботи: віддалений або гібридний формат роботи, плаваючі 8-годинні зміни (4/2; 3/2; 3/1; 2/1) зі стартом між 08:00 та 14:00 та обідньою перервою, офіційне працевлаштування.
  • Здоров’я та турбота про себе: онлайн-консультації корпоративного лікаря та підтримка ментального здоров’я з психологом, оплачувані лікарняні та 20 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки.
  • Можливості розвитку:перехід між категоріями для кар'єрного зростання, отримання бонусів за чітко визначеною системою KPI. Індивідуальні тренінги та участь у внутрішніх конкурсах для розвитку професійних навичок. Компенсація вивчення іноземних мов та бонусна програма для підтримки хобі та відпочинку ріакомівців.
RIA.com — соціально відповідальна українська компанія. «Авто для ЗСУ» від AUTO.RIA — це фандрейзинговий проєкт, який офіційно працює з 2023 року. Завдяки активному залученню команди, креативним ініціативам і колабораціям із зірками та українським бізнесом, ми придбали та відправили більше 40 автівок: пікапи, позашляховики, тягачі та вантажівки для військових у найгарячіші напрямки.

Більше про те, як ми працюємо, можна дізнатися тут:
що саме команда формує продукти, які стають лідерами ринку, тож чекаємо твоє резюме!

jobs.description:
Unser Kunde ist einer der führenden Internetanbieter Deutschlands und baut und betreibt ein Glasfasernetz in ländlichen und vorstädtischen Gebieten Deutschlands. Wir suchen Customer Care Specialists für ein spezialisiertes Team im Bereich Kundenbindung und Vertragsmanagement.

Das Team arbeitet in zwei Kernbereichen: der Bearbeitung von Kündigungen und Widerrufen sowie der Bindung von Kunden durch einen beratenden, bedarfsorientierten Ansatz. Du bist die Stimme, die Kunden verbunden hält — im wörtlichen wie im übertragenen Sinne.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entgegennahme eingehender Anrufe von Bestandskunden mit dem Ziel, ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und sie durch echte, beratende Gespräche zu halten

  • Bearbeitung von Kündigungen, Widerrufen und allgemeinen Kundenanliegen — einschließlich Rechnungsanfragen, Tarifanpassungen und Stammdatenänderungen

  • Betreuung eines ausgewählten Kundenstamms und Bearbeitung von Anfragen per Telefon und schriftlich — die Rolle ist überwiegend telefonisch (~85 %), mit einem Anteil an schriftlicher Ticketbearbeitung (~15 %)

  • Arbeit mit mehreren Tools und Plattformen um Kundenanliegen effizient zu lösen und Interaktionen sorgfältig zu dokumentieren

  • Einhaltung von Qualitätsrichtlinien und Beitrag zu Teamzielen in den Bereichen Kundenzufriedenheit, Conversion und Serviceverfügbarkeit

Was wir suchen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau - sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich. Eine angenehme Stimme und ein klarer, beratender Kommunikationsstil sind essenziell

  • Berufserfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise in einer Rolle mit Schwerpunkt Kundenbindung, Upselling oder beratender Verkauf

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - du hörst aktiv zu, drückst dich klar aus und gehst empathisch auf dein Gegenüber ein

  • Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren Softwaretools gleichzeitig - der tägliche Wechsel zwischen verschiedenen Plattformen gehört zum Alltag

  • Eine zuverlässige, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise — ob im Homeoffice oder im Büro

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in Schichten von 8:00 – 20:00 Uhr

  • Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme an einer strukturierten, 14-tägigen und bezahlten Schulung zu Beginn, bestehend aus einer Kombination aus Präsenztraining im Büro (Zagreb) und Remote-Trainings.

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce

  • Kenntnisse in der Telekommunikations- oder Glasfaserbranche

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenbindung oder Rückgewinnungskampagnen

  • Grundkenntnisse in gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen

Das kannst du erwarten

  • Ein Arbeitgeber, dem dein Arbeitserlebnis und Wohlbefinden wichtig sind

  • Stabiles und wettbewerbsfähiges Einkommen

  • Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice aus ganz Kroatien zu arbeiten

  • Zusätzliche Urlaubstage abhängig von der Betriebszugehörigkeit

  • Karriere- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • MultiSport-Mitgliedschaft

  • Ein großartiges, offenes Team, das Transparenz, Vertrauen und Zusammenarbeit lebt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.excerpt: Fishing Planet is an independent game studio made up of talented and dedicated people who created a successful free-to-play game from scratch.
jobs.description:
Fishing Planet is an independent game studio made up of talented and dedicated people who created a successful free-to-play game from scratch. Today, Fishing Planet is available on eight platforms — Steam, Epic Games, Microsoft Store, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and mobile (iOS and Android). Our global community now includes over 35 million players and continues to grow every day.

We are committed to continuous improvement, providing our team with the resources, tools, and environment they need to build stable, rewarding, and long-term careers — while creating ambitious games that players want to return to again and again.

We are looking for a strong generalist Game Designer with a focus on core gameplay mechanics and game economy, who can take ownership of features and drive their design from initial concept through implementation, testing, and release.

Your impact

  • Design, develop, and iterate on core gameplay mechanics and systems.

  • Design and balance game economy, progression, rewards, upgrades, and other interconnected systems.

  • Take ownership of gameplay features end-to-end from initial concept and design through implementation, playtesting, balancing, and iteration.

  • Improve and expand existing systems while introducing new mechanics and content for a live F2P product.

  • Contribute to level design, player flow, and the integration of gameplay mechanics within locations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring features from concept to release.

  • Analyze player experience and gameplay data to identify improvements that support engagement and product KPIs.

You will bring

  • 5+ years of professional game design experience.

  • Strong experience designing core gameplay mechanics and complex game systems.

  • Experience with game economy, progression, balancing, and reward systems.

  • Ability to independently own and develop a feature from concept to release.

  • Experience with F2P and live games and a good understanding of player engagement and product goals.

  • Experience designing for multiple platforms, particularly PC and consoles.

  • Good understanding of level design, player flow, and gameplay spaces.

  • Strong documentation, communication, and cross-disciplinary collaboration skills.

Will be a plus

  • Experience with Unity.

  • Experience with simulator or other system-heavy games.

  • Experience shipping games on PC and consoles.

  • Knowledge of and interest in fishing.

Why join us

  • Make a direct impact on a successful live game played by more than 35 million people worldwide.

  • Work with a complex, established product and contribute to its future development.

  • Collaborate with an experienced and global team.

  • Enjoy a 4-day work week and a strong commitment to work-life balance.

  • Join a culture built on P.R.O.G.R.E.S.S., where passion, responsibility, openness, growth, respect, efficiency, player-focus, and agility drive everything we do.

Position Description & Requirements
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:
Radiology Partners, through its owned and affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

VP, PRODUCT MARKETING - POSITION SUMMARY:

  • Lead enterprise product positioning and messaging for RP’s technology portfolio, including AI-enabled offerings, ensuring a clear, differentiated narrative that aligns to growth priorities and strengthens market credibility.
  • Develop and evolve product and solution narratives (including clinical, technology, and AI-enabled capabilities), translating features into buyer-relevant value propositions, proof points, and outcomes.
  • Define and maintain product marketing frameworks (personas, use cases, messaging hierarchies, and solution taxonomy) that enable consistent interpretation and application across teams and channels.
  • Build future-facing platform stories and go-to-market narratives that increase relevance, resonance, and adoption—positioning RP’s technology offerings as category leaders.
  • Own go-to-market strategy for new products and major releases, partnering with product, sales, and growth teams to define target segments, ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and personas, use cases, packaging assumptions, and launch objectives.
  • Establish launch governance and operating rhythms (intake, prioritization, cross-functional planning, resourcing, and timelines), ensuring launches are aligned to enterprise priorities and executed with speed, quality, and rigor.
  • Define launch readiness standards (core messaging, demo storyline, web and campaign inputs, sales enablement, and success metrics) and use stakeholder feedback and performance results to drive continuous improvement.
  • Oversee development of a sales enablement strategy and roadmap that equips Sales, Client, and partner-facing teams to articulate product value consistently and win in competitive cycles.
  • Set clear enablement expectations and KPIs (e.g., content adoption, training completion, pipeline influence, win/loss insights); review results regularly, remove barriers, and ensure continuous optimization.
  • Oversee sales enablement governance, including prioritization, content quality standards, and tool/channel strategy (e.g., playbooks, battlecards, FAQs, demo scripts), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and field usability.
  • Lead customer and market insight efforts (voice of customer (VOC), buyer interviews, win/loss, usage and adoption signals) to sharpen go-to-market strategy and improve product-market fit.
  • Partner with Product and Sales to develop competitive intelligence (landscape, differentiation, battlecards, objection handling) that improves sales effectiveness and informs roadmap priorities.
  • Own analyst and category narrative inputs in partnership with Marketing & Communications; ensure consistent messages across PR, awareness, demand, and sales materials.
  • Support pricing and packaging strategy by providing market context, value metrics, willingness-to-pay insights, and packaging recommendations; partner on tests and iteration as offerings evolve.
  • Partner with executives, product, clinical, and marketing teams to develop compelling points of view, narratives, and proof points (e.g., articles, keynote storylines, webinars, reports, and customer stories) that build credibility and demand. Define and report on KPIs and dashboards for product marketing impact (e.g., launch outcomes, pipeline influence, enablement adoption, competitive win rates, and messaging performance); use insights to optimize strategy and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
  • Work closely with the SVP, Marketing & Communications and cross-functional executive leaders to establish effective collaboration, drive clarity on priorities, and improve go-to-market execution velocity and quality.

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive product marketing, solutions marketing, and/or go-to-market leadership experience in B2B technology; including 5+ years of people leadership.
  • Proven success commercializing technology products and/or platforms; experience with AI/ML-enabled solutions strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading go-to-market strategy and product launches for new products and major releases.
  • Experience owning positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and sales enablement in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience partnering with cross-functional teams and managing agency/vendor relationships, budgets, timelines, and quality across multiple concurrent launches and go-to-market initiatives.
FOR MORE INFORMATION:
VP- Product Marketing -VPMARKCOM- 4-20-2026
WHY RADIOLOGY PARTNERS:
Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
Flexible Remote Schedules - Nashville, TN Preferred
Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years

COMPENSATION:

The salary range for this position is $270,000-$300,000. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer.
RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. jobs.description:
About Karoo Health

Cardiovascular care is often the #1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. Karoo deploys a value-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. Karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including First Trust Capital Partners and BIP Ventures, and has near and medium-term plans for further rounds.

Senior Software Engineer - Technical Lead

Job Description

Overview

Location:Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.-based

Type:Full-time technical leadership role

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum.

This is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.

The Role

Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated Technical Leader to guide our core engineering efforts. In this role, you will maintain hands-on contribution while stepping up to lead a small team of software engineers. You will be responsible for setting technical direction, driving agile processes (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives), and fostering a high-performance culture.

In order to do this job well, you must be a curious, pragmatic problem solver and an empathetic technical leader. You strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems and know how to lead constructive technical discussions to guide your team toward the best path forward.

When applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, unblock developers, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Orchestrate Agile Processes: Facilitate daily standups, weekly sprint planning, backlog grooming, and team retrospectives to ensure predictable and timely delivery.
  • Execute: Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code in collaboration with the team.
  • Deliver: Own the software from requirements development through deployment and maintenance.
  • Operationalize Data: Architect, optimize, and maintain databases to ensure reliability and performance
  • Architect: Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure-as-code best practices
  • Safeguard Data: Ensure compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST)

What We're Looking For

  • At least 4 years of experience leading small technical teams with direct responsibility for deliverables.
  • Minimum 6 years of dedicated professional experience in backend or full stack engineering, ideally in a startup or fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and data formats (e.g. FHIR).
  • Strong communication skills with an ability to translate product requirements into technical task breakdowns.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native development.
  • Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and API design (RESTful, GraphQL).
  • Proven capability in system architecture, scalability, security best practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive salary and equity in an early-stage startup
  • Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up
  • Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours
  • Health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support
  • A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Karoo Health Inc (“Karoo”), we believe that improving healthcare starts with creating a more equitable and inclusive world, both inside and outside our organization. We are committed to fostering a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve, and to building a culture where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. Our commitment to inclusion is reflected in initiatives such as equitable compensation practices, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

Karoo Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We maintain a strict policy of non-discrimination for all applicants and employees. What does that mean for you? It means that we are dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Employment decisions at Karoo Health are made based on merit, qualifications, and business need, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. This policy applies to every aspect of the employment journey, from recruitment and hiring to compensation, benefits, training, promotion, performance evaluation, and beyond.

We’re committed to doing the right thing, always, and that includes creating a fair and inclusive hiring process and workplace for all.

Karoo Health welcomes all.

In the United States, compensation is determined by factors including location, role level, job-related skills, experience, and market conditions. Some positions may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other benefits. To learn more about Karoo Health’s benefits, please contact our People Team.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

The AI Solutions Architect will lead the design, integration, and deployment of AI-driven systems across Summit360’s internal operations and client environments.

This role blends:

  • Systems architecture
  • Automation engineering
  • AI tool orchestration
  • Web app prototyping
  • Revenue enablement

  • OpenAI / LLM APIs
  • Zapier / Make / n8n
  • Airtable / HubSpot / CRM integrations
  • Webhooks and API connections
  • Develop lightweight internal web applications or dashboards
  • Architect prompt systems and AI workflows that can be reused across teams

3. Internal AI Enablement

  • Support Operations and Recruitment teams in improving productivity via AI
  • Optimize internal workflows with automation and systemization
  • Create documentation and SOPs for AI deployment

4. Client-Facing Solutions

  • Translate client requirements into AI-driven system designs
  • Prototype and deploy automations or web apps
  • Assist in technical scoping for proposals and sales conversations
  • Help position S360 as an AI-enabled operational partner

5. Governance & Scalability

  • Ensure security, data handling, and compliance best practices
  • Create scalable AI templates that can be replicated across clients
  • Monitor performance and continuously improve AI outputs

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

  • Thinks in systems, not tasks
  • Understands both technical architecture and business impact
  • Can build, test, and deploy quickly
  • Has strong autonomy and ownership
  • Is comfortable operating in a startup-like, high-initiative environment

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Experience building automations (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations
  • Experience building lightweight web apps (React, Next.js, Node, or similar frameworks preferred)
  • Strong prompt engineering and AI workflow design experience
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Experience working with CRMs and operational tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience productizing AI services

  • Background in building AI copilots or internal AI tools
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Airtable, Notion, ClickUp integrations
  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Vercel, etc.)

What Success Looks Like in 6 Months

  • Internal AI automations significantly reduce manual workload

  • Repeatable AI frameworks built and documented
  • Summit360 positioned strongly in the market as an AI-enabled operational partner

Why Join Summit360

You won’t just be another engineer executing tickets.

You will architect the AI backbone of a scaling company — with real autonomy and influence over direction.

If you’re excited about building systems that power businesses — not just writing code — we’d love to speak with you.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As the IT Project Manager, you are the CTO's operating partner. Reporting directly to the CTO, you own the rhythm of the Technology organization: you track every initiative, commitment and decision across IT, Security and Product, run the operating cadence, and take operational work off the CTO's plate so leadership time goes to strategy. You know the status of everything, you chase what's slipping before it becomes a problem, and you make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You work across multiple time zones with a distributed team.

Responsibilities:

- Own the Technology portfolio: maintain a single source of truth for all IT, Security and Product initiatives with owners, dates, status, risks and decisions
- Run the operating cadence: leadership meeting agendas and notes, action-item tracking, vendor and contract renewal calendar, salary-cap and budget tracking, and prep for executive reporting
- Take operational work off the CTO's plate: vendor coordination, procurement follow-ups, hiring logistics with Talent, cross-department requests and documentation
- Drive follow-through: chase commitments across teams, surface blockers early, escalate with a recommendation, and close the loop with stakeholders
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years in project/program management, chief of staff, or technology operations roles supporting a senior technology leader
  • Track record running multi-workstream programs in a work-management tool. Nice to have: Fluency running business operations leveraging modern agentic tools (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Cowork, etc.)
  • Strong written English: able to turn messy updates into an executive-ready status report or decision memo
  • Working comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, renewals and procurement workflows
  • Enough technical literacy to track IT, security and software work credibly and ask the right questions
  • Relentless, respectful follow-up; comfortable holding senior stakeholders to commitments
  • Advanced spoken and written English (C1+ or higher) and availability during US business hours, and after-hours availability on short notice

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Portfolio Visibility – 100% of active Technology initiatives tracked in the portfolio with owner, due date, status and risk, updated weekly (audited monthly by the CTO)
- CTO Operational Footprint – Reduce the CTO's recurring operational meetings and tasks by a defined target within 90 days (e.g., 8+ hours/week reclaimed), measured against a baseline set in the first 30 days
- Follow-Through – 90%+ of action items closed by their due date; 100% of overdue items escalated with a recommendation within 2 business days
- Reporting Cadence – Weekly Technology status report delivered every Friday and monthly executive summary delivered by the 3rd business day; zero missed cycles per quarter
- Vendor & Renewal Management – 100% of contract renewals surfaced to the CTO at least 60 days before term; zero unintended auto-renewals.

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Nothing falls through the cracks: every commitment has an owner, a date and a status
- The CTO's time goes to strategy and leadership, not operational follow-up
- One source of truth for what Technology is working on, why, and where it stands
- Proactive communication: stakeholders hear from you before they have to ask
- Judgment on what to handle directly, what to escalate, and when

jobs.description:
work with us

Du bist ein kommunikationsstarker und begeisterungsfähiger Teamplayer (m/w/d) und hast Lust darauf, innovative 2D-, 3D- und AI-Lösungen im internationalen B2B-Umfeld zu vertreiben?

Du möchtest remote arbeiten, eigenverantwortlich deinen Vertriebsbereich gestalten, Kundenbeziehungen aktiv weiterentwickeln und gemeinsam mit uns neue Märkte in der Region DACH North erschließen?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig als:
Key Account Manager (m/w/d) – 2D, 3D & AI Solutions (DACH Nord| Remote)!

was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Sympathische und hilfsbereite Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich darauf freuen, dich während eines strukturierten Onboardings in alle relevanten Themen einzuarbeiten und dich auch danach jederzeit zu unterstützen.
  • Wir glauben an Eigenverantwortung und daran, Menschen Freiraum zu geben. Deshalb kannst du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und deine Ideen aktiv einbringen.
  • Spannende und zukunftsorientierte Technologien rund um 2D, 3D und AI in einem internationalen Umfeld mit namhaften Kunden aus der Fashion-Branche.
  • Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag mit viel Kundenkontakt, Raum für persönliche Weiterentwicklung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote zu arbeiten, damit Beruf und Privatleben optimal miteinander vereinbar bleiben.
  • Nach deiner Probezeit kannst du deinen individuellen Bonus wählen. Wir bezuschussen EGYM Wellpass, Belonio und das Deutschlandticket – The choice is yours! Außerdem bieten wir vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

deine aufgaben

  • Du betreust und entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen im Bereich 2D-, 3D- und AI-Lösungen in der Region DACH Nord weiter.
  • Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Neukunden und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Du erstellst Angebote, verfolgst diese nach und führst Preis- sowie Vertragsverhandlungen eigenständig durch.
  • Du verantwortest das Lead- und Forecast-Management zur Steuerung deiner Vertriebsaktivitäten und Umsatzplanung.
  • Du planst und präsentierst unsere Lösungen bei Kunden – sowohl remote als auch vor Ort.
  • Du repräsentierst unser Unternehmen auf Fachmessen, Branchenveranstaltungen und Kundenevents.
  • Gemeinsam mit internen Teams wie Produktmanagement, Marketing und technischem Support arbeitest du eng an erfolgreichen Kundenprojekten.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Technologietrends und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie ein.

dein profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Business Development – idealerweise im Technologie-, Industrie- oder AI-Umfeld.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb sowie in der Betreuung und Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen mit.
  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie ein sicheres Auftreten.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zielorientiert.
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der betreuten Region ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Berührungspunkte mit Machine Vision, 3D-Technologien oder AI-Anwendungen gesammelt.
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen und Vertriebsmanagement-Tools ist von Vorteil.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

jobs.excerpt: Lanterna Education is looking for talented IB graduates to join our tutor team.
jobs.description:
Lanterna Education is looking for talented IB graduates to join our tutor team. We work with ambitious IB students across 80+ countries, and the tutors who thrive here are the ones who genuinely love their subjects and know how to bring them to life for someone else.

We think you'll be a good fit if you:

  • Scored 40+ in the IB Diploma and achieved a 7 in the subject(s) you want to tutor

  • Can explain complex ideas clearly and naturally

  • Have your own reliable setup: laptop, microphone, and a stable internet connection

  • Are confident tutoring online, can adapt your approach to keep students engaged, and are comfortable using different tools and platforms to bring lessons to life

  • Are currently at university or recently graduated

  • Want flexible work that fits around your other commitments

What you'll do

You'll work one-on-one with IB students online, primarily tutoring DP subjects. Most tutors cover around three subjects. Depending on your background and interests, you may also support students with Extended Essays, TOK, IGCSE, or university mentoring.

Some students need a few weeks of focused exam prep, others want support across their whole IB journey. In sessions you will explain concepts, work through problems together, and set homework where it helps. No two students are the same, and the best tutors adapt quickly to what each student actually needs.

What you'll get

  • £22/hour

  • Fully remote, flexible work that fits around your schedule

  • Students found for you, no cold outreach or self-marketing

  • Study resources provided

  • A supportive team behind you, ready to help with anything from safeguarding to academic integrity questions

  • Meaningful experience to add to your CV

What to expect

We review applications on a rolling basis. Successful candidates are invited for a short introductory call, followed by a second interview including a mock lesson. If everything clicks, we'll send over a contract and get you started.

If you are an IB teacher rather than a graduate, please visit ourIB Teacher Tutorlisting instead. If you are an IB teacher who would like to work both as a tutor and a substitute teacher, please apply through ourIBDP & MYP Online Substitute Teacherposition.

The Raymond A. Mason School of Business at William & Mary is recruiting a pool of Adjunct Faculty (Section Lead) to lead one or more 7.5-week asynchronous course sections within the Online Master of Science in Finance and Online MBA programs. Leads serve a vital role within our online programs and are valued members of the Raymond A. Mason School of Business and the William & Mary community. Under the supervision of the Faculty Lead, Section Leads facilitate their assigned course section(s) by posting course announcements, engaging in discussion boards, offering weekly office hours, responding to student inquiries, monitoring student progress, grading student assignments, and providing students with substantive, timely feedback. Section Leads are provided with professional learning opportunities and are invited to attend on-campus events.

Job Description:

  • Maintain frequent and open communication with William & Mary faculty and staff through email, mail, telephone, and any other medium deemed appropriate.
  • Complete online instructor orientation and technology training before teaching online for the Mason School and complete continuing training each year after.
  • Review course syllabus, content, activities, and assignments prior to the term start date.
  • Adhere to the course design, instructional and grading guidelines, and due dates.
  • Post a minimum of two weekly announcements relevant to the course content and learning activities.
  • Respond to student inquiries within 24 hours.
  • Provide students with timely, personalized, and substantive feedback on graded assignment submissions.
  • Grade assignments and exams in a timely manner based on the instructions/rubrics provided by the Faculty Lead (48 – 72 hours).
  • Monitor and participate in weekly discussion boards.
  • Offer virtual office hours (drop-in or by appointment) totaling at least one hour per week for individual or group consultation and communicate this information through announcements and the course calendar.
  • Monitor student progress and notify the Faculty Lead when a student is unresponsive or at risk of failing.
  • Meet weekly with the Faculty Lead during regularly scheduled calls throughout the course.
  • Submit final grades to the Faculty Lead according to William & Mary and Mason School grading policies and the Online Programs calendar.
  • Submit Section Lead end-of-semester reflection form and attend debriefing meetings as applicable.
  • Section Leads typically spend 15 to 20 hours per week on the duties listed above.

Required Qualifications: Please make sure your cover letter and resume clearly indicate how you meet the following required qualifications:

jobs.description:
Somos Thaia, una boutique de recruiting especializada en conectar startups tech de alto crecimiento con talento excepcional en LATAM y US. Trabajamos con empresas desde seed hasta Series D como Profound, CookUnity, MaintainX, Lemon, Bombo, entre otras.

Nuestro enfoque: encontrar no solo skills técnicos, sino fit cultural que construya equipos de largo plazo. Somos partners estratégicos en el proceso de hiring.

GTM Analyst / SDR

Thaia es una agencia boutique de recruiting tech para startups en LatAm y US. Cerramos a través de relaciones personales y warm intros de calidad. El cuello de botella no es falta de oportunidades, es consistencia: cuando el equipo está en delivery, el pipeline se vacía.

Necesitamos un SDR que genere leads calificados, maneje el funnel y abra puertas mientras nuestros founders venden.

Qué vas a hacer:

  • Prospecting y list building: identificar startups Serie A+ en LatAm y US con roles tech abiertos. Usar LinkedIn, Apollo, Clay y herramientas internas para mapear decisores y oportunidades reales. Detectar señales de compra: funding reciente, expansión, roles nuevos.

  • Outreach personalizado: ejecutar campañas de mensajería (LinkedIn, email) con templates definidos pero personalizados por empresa. Tu objetivo es generar respuesta y iniciar conversación, no enviar volumen de basura.

  • Gestión de herramientas: mantener actualizado el pipeline (Sheets o CRM interno). Estado de cada lead, fechas de follow-up, próximos pasos.

  • Calificación y movimiento: cuando un lead responde o hay interés, tu trabajo es calificarlo rápido y pasarlo a las founders cuando hay oportunidad real de reunión.

  • Reporting semanal: métricas claras. Cuántos outreaches, tasa de respuesta, conversaciones iniciadas, reuniones agendadas.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia en SDR, ventas B2B o outreach. Sabes cómo iniciar una conversación y generar respuesta.

  • Dominio de LinkedIn: búsqueda, investigación de decisores, mensajería. Identificar contactos en minutos.

  • Manejo fluido de Google Sheets, herramientas de productividad y CRM básico.

  • Autonomía: recibe el brief, ejecuta sin necesidad de validar cada paso.

  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura y escritura).

Lo que valoramos:

  • Curiosidad para probar nuevas tools y canales de outreach.

  • Resiliencia.

  • Proactividad para detectar problemas y proponer soluciones. Si ves que una estrategia no funciona, lo planteas y probamos otra.

  • Ownership.

  • Nice to have: experiencia con AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) y automatización de procesos (N8N, Zapier, Clay). No es requisito, pero aceleramos mucho si sabés iterar con AI.

Qué ofrecemos:

  • Exposición a startups tech de distintas etapas (pre-seed a scale-up) en Latam y US.

  • Modalidad contractor, pago en USD.

  • Part-time: 6 horas diarias.

  • Remoto desde Argentina.

jobs.excerpt: Do zespołu EER Poland (Expert Executive Recruiters), szukamy headhuntera, człowieka z charakterem i doświadczeniem w proaktywnym poszukiwaniu kandydatów.
jobs.description:
Do zespołu EER Poland (Expert Executive Recruiters), szukamy headhuntera, człowieka z charakterem i doświadczeniem w proaktywnym poszukiwaniu kandydatów.

Nasze wymagania:

  • minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w samodzielnych rekrutacjach 𝐞𝐧𝐝-𝐭𝐨-𝐞𝐧𝐝,

  • doświadczenie w pracy z 𝐇𝐌,

  • angielski na poziomie >B2,

  • doświadczenie w efektywnym sourcingu lub pracą z sourcerami,

  • umiejętność organizacji pracy własnej i poczucie odpowiedzialności za efekt,

  • wiedza, że za słowami "klient" oraz "kandydat", kryją się ludzie 😉,

  • poczucie humoru i świadomość, na czym polega praca w firmie zajmującej się headhuntingiem.

Oferujemy

  • stabilne i perspektywiczne zatrudnienie, start od 6000 - 9000 PLN,

  • pracę z ciekawymi, często międzynarodowymi klientami,

  • nieograniczone premie za sukcesy - nasze miesięczne bonusy wahały się w poprzednim roku od 2000 PLN do 19000 PLN,

  • uczestnictwo w projektach, które zmieniają rynek,

  • pracę w 100% zdalną,

  • wpływ na rozwój firmy,

  • tonę zaufania, wyzwania i niezbędne wsparcie.

Taką, która wykuje z Ciebie eksperta,u którego rekrutacje określane jako "karkołomne", będą wyzwalały delikatny uśmiech na twarzy 😉.

Można się u nas sporo nauczyć.

Dołącz do EER Poland oraz 80 koleżanek i kolegów z naszego międzynarodowego zespołu! Być może czekamy właśnie na Ciebie!

jobs.description:
Job title: Solution Architect

Job Summary:

EY is a global leader in Advisory, Assurance, Tax, and Transaction Services. In our globalizing economy the availability of skills and expertise is becoming more and more distributed. Within the End User Technology Experience team, we enable EY professionals to meet the increasing pace of business by delivering productivity and collaboration solutions that empower them to work together where they want and how they want. The Solution Architect is a highly skilled senior role with industry leading architecture and design expertise to support one or more programs. He/she has a deep end to end understanding of architecture standards and platform solution development expertise. The End User Technology Experience requires a seasoned Solution Architect to provide technical guidance on Application development, Microsoft Platform solutions, and lead customer service applications. Candidate must be a self-starter with Agile framework experience and provide RISK/Technical architecture leadership.

Essential Functions of the Job

§ A Solution Architect provides architecture leadership & subject matter expertise to product and program managers focusing on complex & innovative solutions

§ The solution architect creates innovative and practical designs that account for the end-to-end technical solution of a system, in line with EY's Strategic and Enterprise Technology Goals

§ For that, the candidate works closely and continuously with stakeholders to focus on meeting business requirements and incorporating broader aspects such as overall product costs/revenue, data privacy & sovereignty, business continuity, information security, integration with other systems, etc.

§ The candidate works with vendors to assess vendor products, understand vendor’s delivery models and assist in implementing them at EY.

§ A solution architect can work across multiple projects with varied stakeholders. The candidate sets architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts providing technical leadership and consulting services to the business.

§ The candidate anticipates needs and potential objections and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants: Solution and Technical Architects, engineering teams, product manager, project managers, Information Security and Operations.

§ The candidate has excellent interpersonal communication and organizational skills that are required to operate as a leading member of global, distributed teams that deliver quality services and solutions.

§ Solution design will include the creation of reusable, repeatable IP and artifacts

§ Lead Agile sprints in product owner capacity and mentor technical staff on newer design sprints

§ Enforce adherence to architectural standards/principles, global product-specific guidelines, usability experience and design standards, etc.

§ Identify, communicate and mitigate Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions throughout the development lifecycle.

§ Responsible to propose with a custom solutions & collaboration with business application owners, project managers, designers, engineers, and infrastructure teams to build a quality experience for users

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:

To qualify for the role, you must have:

§ Expert understanding of solution architecture.

§ The ability to adopt and relate new technologies to the set of problems we face at EY while adhering to security and other EY standards

§ The ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to a variety of (business) stakeholders effectively and comprehensibly

§ Expert understanding of latest cloud computing and data technologies, business drivers, emerging cloud trends, and deployment options.

§ Experience with Agile & DevSecOps methodologies

§ Experience in Modern Application Design and development

§ History of working credibly with senior stakeholders

§ Adapts personal communication style to the style of others, develops rapport and stays calm under pressure or escalating issues using advanced oral and written English communication skills.

§ Strong verbal and written skills including strong cross-cultural communication and the ability to draft effective communications

§ Ability to work with people in a variety of cultures, countries and time zones

§ Demonstrate excellent technical & architecture skills in the context of cloud-based platform/product design, service management and product lifecycle management

§ Demonstrate ability to rapidly learn new and emerging technologies and developing a vision of their suitability

Technical Experience

§ Extensive working knowledge on Cloud application architect role using Azure PaaS and IaaS and SaaS services

§ Subject matter expertise in Azure Microservices, Functions, Logic, Webapp or Digital services

§ Experience in building Analytics platforms using Azure Data Factory, Databricks and PaaS SQL

§ Experience with generative AI, specifically text based models. Experience with implementing RAG search using libraries such as langchain, llama_index, semantic kernel etc.

§ Experience in architecting and designing Adobe PDF solutions and exposure to Azure Cognitive search tools is a huge plus.

§ Experience with mission critical technology components with DR capabilities

§ Experience with multi-geography, multi-tier service design and management

Experience:

A minimum of 15+ years overall IT industry experience"

ADVANCED ENGLISH

REMOTE

Who we are?

HarfangLab is a leading European cybersecurity scale‑up focused on securing endpoints against modern cyber threats. Since our founding in 2018, we have become a recognized innovator in endpoint protection, with our flagship EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) solution continuously enhanced with cutting‑edge detection, investigation, and response capabilities.

Building on this strong foundation, our portfolio has expanded significantly. We introduced HarfangLab Guard, a unified security offering that combines EDR and EPP (Endpoint Protection Platform) to provide comprehensive protection, automatic threat blocking, and optimized analyst workflows. More recently, we launched Scout, an integrated Attack Surface Management (ASM) solution that enables organizations to proactively identify vulnerabilities, shadow IT, and configuration gaps — all within the same agent and platform used for endpoint security.

HarfangLab's technology has earned widespread recognition and achieved the distinction of being the first ANSSI (National Cybersecurity Agency of France) certified EDR in 2020, followed by becoming the first to receive ANSSI qualification in 2025. We are also proud to have joined the French Tech 2030 program alongside 80 other French innovative companies at a time when cyber resilience has become a strategic priority for Europe.

Today, we protect hundreds of organizations across the world — from large enterprises and government institutions to mid‑sized businesses — and continue to grow through strategic partnerships, innovation, and a commitment to European cybersecurity sovereignty.

Why are we hiring?

Today, we are determined to become the European leader in EDR by accelerating our international expansion. To achieve this, we have already started building our international sales team, hiring Account Executives and Presales Engineers for the BENELUX and DACH regions. At the same time, we are developing our presence across EMEA as a whole, laying the groundwork for the next regions we will specifically target.

jobs.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview:

The Interpreter provides in-person and/or remote interpretation to facilitate, with accuracy, impartiality, and confidentiality, the language needs of Limited English Proficient (LEP) individuals and their service providers. Activities include providing professional interpretation services, use of software to track assignments, and occasional trainings and assessments.

Major Responsibilities:Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Provide accurate, impartial, and confidential interpretation to LEP individuals and service providers in a variety of settings, including clinics, hospitals, schools, community-based organizations, and government agencies. Services may be rendered in-person, via telephone, videoconference, or other virtual means.
• Track assignments and work hours within designated software.
• Participate in trainings and assessments.
• May support special projects and initiatives.
• Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:

Education and Certifications:

  • High school diploma strongly preferred.
    • Interpretation certification preferred.

Work Experience:

  • Relevant professional interpretation experience preferred.
    • Experience working with refugee and/or immigrant populations strongly preferred.

Demonstrated Skills & Competencies:

  • Cultural sensitivity; ability to build trust with clients, colleagues, and partners.

PROFESSIONAL STANDARDS

All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies:

US Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive set of benefits. In the US, these include: 10 sick days, 10 US holidays, 20-25 paid time off days depending on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163 per month, dental starting at $6.50 per month, and vision starting at $5 per month, FSA for healthcare and commuter costs, a 403b retirement savings plans with immediately vested matching, disability & life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program which is available to our staff and their families to support counseling and care in times of crisis and mental health struggles.

Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About CurifyLabsCurifyLabs is pioneering 3D printing solutions for personalized medicine.
jobs.description:
About CurifyLabs

CurifyLabs is pioneering 3D printing solutions for personalized medicine. We partner with compounding pharmacies to streamline production, expand what they can offer, and ultimately improve patient care — making personalized treatments faster, safer, and more accessible to the people who need them.

We’re looking for a

Senior Marketing Specialist

with a strong visual eye and real fluency in the U.S. compounding pharmacy space to lead how CurifyLabs shows up in the market. You’ll own the marketing toolkit that makes our story land — campaigns, content, conference presence, sales collateral, social, and the visual language that ties it all together.

You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Customer Success and Commercial teams to turn complex science into clear, compelling stories that speak directly to pharmacists, pharmacy owners, and the broader compounding community. If you can spot a misaligned logo from across the room and also explain 503A vs 503B without breaking a sweat, we want to talk.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute the U.S. marketing plan — campaigns, content, events, and channel strategy.
  • Lead the visual identity of our U.S. presence: presentations, sales collateral, social, website assets, booth design.
  • Translate technical and clinical content into approachable, persuasive marketing material.
  • Plan and run our presence at key compounding pharmacy conferences and industry events.
  • Build customer stories and case studies in close partnership with our pharmacy customers.
  • Partner with the global marketing and product teams in Helsinki to keep the brand consistent across regions.
  • Track campaign performance and refine based on what actually moves the needle.

What We’re Looking For

  • Several years in B2B marketing, ideally with exposure to pharmacy, pharma, healthcare, or life sciences.
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. compounding pharmacy landscape — 503A/503B, key associations (APC, PCCA, NCPA), and the regulatory backdrop.
  • Strong visual eye and design sensibility — comfortable directing or producing clean, on-brand assets in Figma, Canva, or Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Excellent writer who can hold a consistent brand voice across long-form, social, and sales material.
  • Self-directed and at ease working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.
  • Bonus: existing relationships in the U.S. compounding pharmacy community, or experience launching a product into U.S. pharmacy channels.

Why CurifyLabs

  • Join a category-defining company genuinely changing what pharmacies can offer their patients.
  • Own the U.S. marketing function for an emerging product — high impact, high visibility, real creative latitude.
  • Collaborate with an international, mission-driven team that takes the work seriously and each other a little less so.
  • See your work translate directly into pharmacies adopting the technology and patients getting better care.

How to Apply

If this sounds like you, send your CV along salary expectations and a short pitch video through our recruitment portal no later than 14th of July. We look forward to drive innovation together with you!

Job Requisition:

JR101884 Adjunct Faculty (Section Lead) Pool - Online Accounting Courses (Open)

Job Posting Title:

Adjunct Faculty (Section Lead) Pool - Online Accounting Courses

Department:

CC00174 WM001 | SOB | OLP - MAC

Faculty - Adjunct

Worker Sub-Type:

Adjunct (non-benefited)

Remote Work - Virginia

Primary Job Posting Location:

Posting Location - William & Mary

Job Description Summary:

The Raymond A. Mason School of Business at William & Mary is recruiting a pool of Adjunct Faculty (Section Leads) to lead one or more 7.5-week asynchronous course sections within the Online Master of Accounting (MAcc) and Online MBA programs. Please visit the following website to learn more about these program:

Leads serve a vital role within our online programs and are valued members of the Raymond A. Mason School of Business (MSOB) and the William & Mary community. Under the supervision of the Faculty Lead, Section Leads facilitate their assigned course section(s) by posting course announcements, engaging in discussion boards, offering weekly office hours, responding to student inquiries, monitoring student progress, grading student assignments, and providing students with substantive, timely feedback. Section Leads are provided with professional learning opportunities and are invited to attend on-campus events.

Job Description:

Position duties include:

  • Maintain frequent and open communication with William & Mary faculty and staff through email, mail, telephone, and any other medium deemed appropriate.
  • Complete online instructor orientation and technology training before teaching online for the Mason School and complete continuing training each year after.
  • Review course syllabus, content, activities, and assignments prior to the term start date.
  • Adhere to the course design, instructional and grading guidelines, and due dates.
  • Post a minimum of two weekly announcements relevant to the course content and learning activities.
  • Respond to student inquiries within 24 hours.
  • Provide students with timely, personalized, and substantive feedback on graded assignment submissions.
  • Grade assignments and exams in a timely manner based on the instructions/rubrics provided by the Faculty Lead (48 – 72 hours).
  • Monitor and participate in weekly discussion boards.
  • Offer virtual office hours (drop-in or by appointment) totaling at least one hour per week for individual or group consultation and communicate this information through announcements and the course calendar.
  • Monitor student progress and notify the Faculty Lead when a student is unresponsive or at risk of failing.
  • Meet weekly with the Faculty Lead during regularly scheduled calls throughout the course.
  • Submit final grades to the Faculty Lead according to William & Mary and Mason School grading policies and the Online Programs calendar.
  • Submit Section Lead end-of-semester reflection form and attend debriefing meetings as applicable.
  • Section Leads typically spend 15 to 20 hours per week on the duties listed above.

Required Qualifications: Please make sure your cover letter and resume clearly indicate how you meet the following required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in accounting or a closely related field.
  • Significant expertise and relevant professional and/or instructional experience in accounting and related fields, including financial accounting, financial statement analysis and valuation, cost and managerial accounting, taxation, audit, and accounting analytics.
  • Experience providing instruction to adult learners in an academic or corporate setting.
  • Demonstrated excellence in communicating and collaborating in digital environments.
  • Demonstrated commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive learning environment for a diverse student population.
  • Demonstrated commitment to upholding William & Mary’s historic reputation for academic excellence and innovation.

Preferred Qualifications: Please make sure your cover letter and resume clearly indicate whether you meet any of the preferred qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree in accounting.
  • Active Certified Public Accounting (CPA) license.
  • Demonstrated excellence teaching adult learners in a professional degree program.
  • Experience providing online instruction.
  • Enthusiasm for delivering education in an online mode.
  • Proficiency using video conferencing technologies and web-based collaboration platforms.
  • Experience using Canvas or a similar learning management system.

Other details:

  • For full consideration, please upload a Resume, Cover Letter, Teaching Statement, and Unofficial Transcripts reflecting a degree associated with the subject area being taught.
  • The review of applications is ongoing, and only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  • Hired candidates are required to provide official transcripts prior to the contracted start date.
  • This part-time position is restricted to the term in which it is assigned and hired and is not eligible for benefits.
  • This position is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.
