jobs.excerpt: Role SummaryTerabase Energy is seeking an RTDS Engineer to support the delivery of real-time Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation solutions for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid renewable energy projects.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Terabase Energy is seeking an RTDS Engineer to support the delivery of real-time Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation solutions for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid renewable energy projects.

This role will be primarily responsible for developing, configuring, validating, and maintaining project-specific RTDS and RSCAD models used for plant controller, SCADA, EMS, inverter, and substation control validation. The RTDS Engineer will work closely with Controls Engineering, SCADA Engineering, Project Engineering, Modeling & Validation, Commissioning, and customer-facing teams to ensure HIL simulations are ready for internal testing, FAT, customer witness testing, and field issue replication.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of hands-on experience with PSCAD, RSCAD, RTDS modeling, and HIL setup for project-specific power plant validation.

Key Responsibilities

RTDS / RSCAD Modeling

  • Develop and configure project-specific RTDS and RSCAD models for utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid power plants.
  • Translate electrical one-lines, control narratives, interconnection requirements, equipment data, and project specifications into real-time simulation models.
  • Build and validate plant-level models for active power, reactive power, voltage control, frequency response, ramp-rate control, curtailment, and grid support functions.
  • Develop and maintain reusable RSCAD model libraries, templates, and project standards.

PSCAD and Dynamic Modeling

  • Develop, review, and validate PSCAD models to support project-specific studies, controls validation, and grid compliance requirements.
  • Support model alignment between PSCAD and RTDS/RSCAD environments.
  • Work with inverter OEMs, BESS OEMs, and internal engineering teams to validate control behavior and model assumptions.
  • Support testing related to inverter-based resource performance, plant controller behavior, and interconnection compliance.

HIL Setup and Project Delivery

  • Set up project-specific Hardware-in-the-Loop environments using RTDS and physical control hardware.
  • Integrate PPCs, EMS controllers, RTACs, relays, gateways, SCADA servers, network switches, firewalls, and communication interfaces into the HIL environment.
  • Configure I/O mapping, signal routing, protocol interfaces, and controller communication paths.
  • Support FAT, eFAT, customer witness testing, internal validation, and project readiness reviews.
  • Ensure HIL environments are delivered on schedule to support project milestones.

Testing, Validation, and Troubleshooting

  • Develop and execute HIL test plans, procedures, acceptance criteria, and validation reports.
  • Validate controls performance under normal operating conditions, grid disturbances, curtailment scenarios, plant trips, communication failures, and recovery events.
  • Troubleshoot model, controller, communication, network, and simulation issues during HIL setup and testing.
  • Replicate field issues in the HIL environment to support commissioning, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Document test results, model assumptions, issue logs, lessons learned, and final validation outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Controls Engineering, SCADA Engineering, Project Engineering, Commissioning, IT/OT, and Product teams to align HIL setup with project needs.
  • Support customer-facing technical discussions related to HIL testing, plant controller validation, and model behavior.
  • Work with vendors and OEMs to obtain model data, controller interfaces, firmware details, and communication requirements.
  • Contribute to Terabase’s standard HIL delivery process, test automation roadmap, and quality improvement initiatives.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Controls Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience with PSCAD, RSCAD, RTDS, or real-time power system simulation.
  • Hands-on experience setting up Hardware-in-the-Loop environments for project-specific validation.
  • Strong understanding of power systems, inverter-based resources, utility-scale solar, BESS, hybrid plants, and plant-level controls.
  • Experience developing and validating PSCAD and RSCAD models.
  • Experience integrating physical controllers, RTACs, relays, gateways, SCADA systems, or network devices into simulation environments.
  • Familiarity with PPC, EMS, SCADA, inverter controls, substation automation, and plant controller validation.
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols such as DNP3, Modbus TCP, IEC 61850, OPC UA, or similar protocols.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical one-lines, network diagrams, control narratives, points lists, equipment data sheets, and interconnection requirements.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across models, controls, communication networks, and physical hardware.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Controls Engineering.
  • Experience with RTDS NovaCor, RSCAD FX, GTNET, GTFPGA, or similar RTDS hardware/software platforms.
  • Experience with OPAL-RT, Typhoon HIL, Speedgoat, or other real-time simulation platforms.
  • Experience with SEL RTACs, SEL relays, SEL-3555, Schweitzer controllers, Ignition SCADA, or similar control platforms.
  • Experience with IEEE 2800, NERC, ERCOT, CAISO, PJM, or other utility interconnection and grid compliance requirements.
  • Experience with inverter OEM and BESS OEM models.
  • Experience creating automated HIL test scripts, reusable test libraries, and validation templates.
  • Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning, or field troubleshooting for renewable energy projects.
  • Experience with Python, MATLAB/Simulink, scripting, or test automation tools.

Core Competencies

  • Deep technical understanding of RTDS, RSCAD, PSCAD, and real-time power system simulation.
  • Hands-on ability to connect simulation models with actual control hardware.
  • Strong project execution discipline and ability to deliver HIL systems against customer and project milestones.
  • Structured approach to testing, validation, issue tracking, and documentation.
  • Ability to simplify complex technical issues and communicate clearly with internal teams, customers, and vendors.
  • Strong ownership mindset and willingness to work through urgent project issues when required.
  • Customer-focused approach to project delivery and technical problem solving.

Success Measures

  • Project-specific RTDS/HIL environments are delivered on time and ready for FAT, eFAT, and customer witness testing.
  • RSCAD and PSCAD models accurately represent project requirements, controls behavior, and expected plant response.
  • HIL testing identifies controls, communication, and integration issues before field deployment.
  • Test procedures, model documentation, and validation reports are complete, clear, and reusable.
  • Field issues can be replicated and resolved using the HIL environment.
  • HIL workflows improve project quality, reduce commissioning risk, and support repeatable SCADA and controls delivery.

Travel

This role may require travel to Terabase facilities, HIL labs, customer FAT locations, vendor facilities, and project sites as needed to support testing, project delivery, and commissioning activities.

Benefits

Compensation And Benefits

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This role offers a base salary of $140,000 – $170,000. Within each posted range, individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher), dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Terabase offers competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Generous time off and holiday policy

• And much more!

We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our products, the diverse consumers we represent, and the communities we call home.

jobs.description:
Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

The Role

Cardiff is seeking a Salesforce System Administrator to take hands-on ownership of the administration, stability, optimization, and ongoing improvement of our Salesforce environment.

This is not a ticket based Salesforce Administrator role. We are looking for someone who can step into a complex, established Salesforce org, understand how the system currently operates, identify technical debt and process gaps, and independently recommend and implement scalable solutions.

The Salesforce Administrator will partner closely with Salesforce Development, Software Engineering, Product, Data, Sales, Operations, Underwriting, Marketing, and other business stakeholders.

You will be expected to understand the complete lifecycle of a business process before making changes, including what creates or updates Salesforce data, what automation is triggered, which integrations consume that data, how records are assigned and converted, and what downstream processes could be impacted.

When an issue occurs, we expect you to identify and correct the root cause rather than add another workaround or layer of automation.

What You'll Do

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Salesforce Flows, including record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and autolaunched Flows.
  • Configure custom objects, fields, record types, Lightning pages, validation rules, formulas, reports, and dashboards.
  • Manage users, permission sets, profiles, roles, sharing rules, and field-level security.
  • Troubleshoot Flow failures, permission issues, automation conflicts, data problems, and other Salesforce issues.
  • Troubleshoot record assignment, ownership, routing, and conversion issues across Salesforce automation, assignment rules, integrations, and third-party tools.
  • Perform impact and dependency analysis before changing existing automation or configuration.
  • Evaluate business requirements and existing Salesforce functionality before introducing new fields, automation, or configuration, and recommend the simplest scalable solution that addresses the underlying business need.
  • Test changes in sandbox, support UAT and regression testing, deploy changes, and validate them in Production.
  • Proactively communicate planned Salesforce changes, expected business and system impacts, deployment timing, and post-deployment outcomes to relevant stakeholders. Ensure material Production changes are documented and follow established change-management and review processes.
  • Support Salesforce integrations and collaborate with the Salesforce and Software Engineering teams on more complex technical issues.
  • Support and test managed-package upgrades.
  • Maintain data quality through audits, duplicate management, imports, exports, mass updates, and cleanup.
  • Build reports and dashboards that provide useful business and operational insights.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Monitor Production and proactively investigate automation failures and recurring issues.
  • Maintain documentation and provide user support and training when needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator, required
  • Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, required
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • Demonstrated experience performing root-cause analysis across complex Salesforce automation.
  • Advanced experience designing, troubleshooting, and optimizing Salesforce Flow.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce order of execution, security, permissions, sharing architecture, and field-level security.
  • Experience working with custom objects, fields, record types, validation rules, formulas, reports, and dashboards.
  • Experience supporting integrations between Salesforce and external applications or APIs.
  • Experience troubleshooting integration users, API-driven record changes, data mappings, and automation conflicts.
  • Experience with sandbox management, UAT, regression testing, deployment, Production validation, and release management.
  • Experience with Data Loader or similar Salesforce data-management tools.
  • Working knowledge of SOQL for data investigation, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of Salesforce automation best practices, bulk processing, and governor limits.

jobs.title: Director, Leadership Giving & Partnership
jobs.excerpt: OverviewJoin our Team as Director, Leadership Giving & Partnerships!
jobs.description:
Overview

Join our Team as Director, Leadership Giving & Partnerships!

About Boys & Girls Clubs of America

For more than a century, Boys & Girls Clubs of America (BGCA) has worked to enable all young people, especially those who need us most, to reach their full potential as productive, caring, responsible citizens. Through a nationwide Movement of local Boys & Girls Club organizations, BGCA reaches millions of young people each year, creating opportunities for them to learn, lead, thrive and build great futures. Our ability to deliver on that mission is strengthened by philanthropic partners who believe in the potential of young people and invest in solutions that can create meaningful, lasting change at scale.

About the Team

The Development & Board Relations team is a small remote team of three that report directly to the CEO and builds and stewards the organizational most complex philanthropic relationships and those closest to the CEO & President, that advance BGCA's mission, strategic priorities and impact across the Boys & Girls Club Movement. Working across BGCA and alongside local Clubs, senior leaders, trustees and external partners, the team ensures philanthropic partnerships and board of governors are thoughtfully managed, commitments are delivered with excellence, and donors remain connected to the impact their investments make possible.

About the Role

The Director, Leadership Giving & Partnerships is a strategic project manager and relationship partner responsible for the successful stewardship and execution of some of BGCA's most significant and complex philanthropic partnerships.

Reporting to and working in sync with the SVP, Development & Board Relations, approximately 80% of this role is focused on project management, stewardship and account management; turning complex commitments into clear plans, coordinating work across multiple teams, managing budgets and deliverables, and ensuring partners receive an exceptional and timely experience from commitment through completion.

You will manage relationships representing significant strategic and financial value, including $50M+ in existing grant commitments and renewal potential. Success requires someone who can see both the big picture and the details: building trusted relationships, managing multiple workstreams, work independently & strategically, synthesizing complex information, monitoring financial performance and creating clear, executive-ready reports for donors, senior leaders and board audiences.

While there will be opportunities to support renewals and future portfolio ownership in this new teams growth, expanded investments and other fundraising activities, this is not primarily a frontline fundraising role. At its core, this role is about ensuring BGCA delivers exceptionally on the partnerships already entrusted to us, and using strong stewardship and relationship management to position those partnerships for continued success.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Lead Complex Partnership Projects & Deliverables

  • Serve as the project management lead for a portfolio of significant philanthropic partnerships, translating agreements and commitments into clear workplans, timelines, milestones and deliverables.
  • Manage multiple complex projects simultaneously, coordinating activities across Development, Finance, program teams, local Clubs and other internal stakeholders.
  • Establish project rhythms, track progress and maintain accountability to ensure commitments are delivered accurately, on time and in alignment with partner expectations.
  • Anticipate potential challenges, dependencies and risks and proactively develop solutions to keep work moving forward.
  • Work independently to advance projects while knowing when to engage senior leaders, subject matter experts or other stakeholders.
  • Bring structure and clarity to complex work, ensuring stakeholders understand priorities, responsibilities, deadlines and next steps.

Steward & Manage Strategic Relationships

  • Serve as a trusted relationship partner for SVP and assigned donors and partners, building credibility through responsiveness, follow-through and a strong understanding of their priorities.
  • Develop and execute customized stewardship and engagement plans that strengthen relationships throughout the lifecycle of the partnership.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for partners to understand and experience the impact of their investment.
  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships with diplomacy, confidence and sound judgment.
  • Build strong relationships internally and externally, using influence and persuasion to create alignment and move work forward.
  • Identify emerging partner needs and opportunities to strengthen engagement, retention and long-term relationships.

Manage Financial & Partnership Performance

  • Partner closely with Finance and program teams to monitor grant and partnership budgets, expenditures, forecasts and financial commitments.
  • Understand the financial components of partnership agreements and ensure spending and deliverables remain aligned with donor intent.
  • Identify budget variances, risks or emerging issues and work with appropriate stakeholders to address them.
  • Maintain accurate partnership information, documentation, milestones and activity within Salesforce and other systems.
  • Provide leaders with clear visibility into partnership performance, upcoming commitments, risks and decisions needed.

Translate Information into Reports & Insights

  • Synthesize financial, programmatic and impact information from multiple sources into clear, concise and meaningful narratives.
  • Lead the development of high-quality stewardship reports, executive updates, presentations and board-level reports.
  • Translate complex information and data into the most important insights for different audiences.
  • Partner with subject matter experts, Finance, writers and other teams to gather information and ensure reporting is accurate, timely and compelling.
  • Communicate progress, challenges and recommendations clearly to senior leaders and stakeholders.

Support Partnership Growth & Renewal

  • Recognize opportunities to deepen existing relationships through exceptional stewardship, engagement and demonstrated impact.
  • Partner with fundraising leadership on renewals, expanded investments and select cultivation or solicitation opportunities.
  • Contribute partnership knowledge, donor insights and project results that strengthen renewal strategies and funding conversations.
  • Participate in donor meetings and presentations when appropriate.

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're making an impact when:

  • Complex partnership commitments are delivered on time, within budget and with a high level of quality and accuracy.
  • Donors and partners experience BGCA as responsive, organized, thoughtful and easy to work with.
  • Senior leaders have clear, reliable information about partnership progress, financial performance, risks and outcomes.
  • Board and donor reports effectively synthesize complex information into meaningful insights and impact stories.
  • Internal teams understand their responsibilities, deadlines and dependencies and have the coordination needed to successfully deliver.
  • Potential challenges are identified early and addressed proactively.
  • Strong stewardship and execution position partnerships for continued engagement, renewal and potential growth.
  • Through stewardship and gift management donor experience and expectations are met and donor gift renewals occur and team revenue goals are met.

Why This Role Matters

Significant philanthropic partnerships require more than securing an investment. They require exceptional execution after the commitment is made.

As Director, Leadership Giving & Partnerships, you'll help ensure BGCA delivers on what we promise. You'll connect people, plans, budgets and information across the organization; build trusted relationships with partners; and turn complex commitments into well-managed work and meaningful results. Your ability to bring structure to complexity, communicate impact and create an exceptional partner experience will help strengthen relationships that provide critical resources and opportunities for young people across the Boys & Girls Club Movement.

Qualifications

Who You Are

You are a highly skilled project manager and relationship builder who enjoys taking complex work and creating clarity, structure and momentum.

You build trust easily and know how to work with different personalities, priorities and perspectives. You are persuasive and engaging, but you don't rely on authority to get things done, you build relationships, make the case and bring people along.

You can move comfortably between strategy and execution. One moment you may be reviewing a multimillion-dollar budget or identifying a project risk; the next, you may be synthesizing information for a board report, coordinating deliverables across several teams or meeting with a partner.

You are highly organized and comfortable working independently. You anticipate what needs to happen next, follow through on commitments and know when something requires escalation.

Most importantly, you understand that exceptional stewardship is about more than reporting back to a donor. It is about building confidence that their partnership is well managed, their investment is being thoughtfully stewarded and their support is creating meaningful impact.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Significant experience in project management, account management, stewardship, relationship building and management, strategic partnerships or a related field, with demonstrated success managing complex, high-value relationships or initiatives.
  • Experience managing multiple projects involving cross-functional stakeholders, competing priorities, deadlines and complex deliverables.
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience managing or monitoring budgets, expenditures and financial reporting.
  • Experience synthesizing complex information into clear, executive-level reports, presentations and recommendations, including materials for senior leadership or board audiences.
  • Experience with philanthropic partnerships, grants, donor stewardship or nonprofit development is preferred but not required.
  • Experience with CRM and/or project-management systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Experience within a national nonprofit, foundation or federated/networked organization is a plus.

Work Environment & Travel

This role requires regular collaboration with colleagues across BGCA, local Boys & Girls Club organizations and external partners. Travel may be required for partner meetings, stewardship activities, organizational events, conferences and other business needs and is estimated at up to 20% (approximately 3–5 days in a given month, which may occasionally include weekends).

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $120,000.00 BGCA takes into consideration a combination of a candidate’s education, training and experience, as well as the position’s scope and complexity, the discretion and latitude required for the role and other external and internal data when establishing a salary level. We are highly invested in every employee’s total well-being and offer a substantial and comprehensive total rewards package.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NOOKS

Nooks is pioneering Classified-Infrastructure-as-a-Service (CIaaS) — designing, building, and operating Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and other secured, classified environments for the defense and national security community. We work with the agencies, contractors, and mission-driven organizations that keep the nation safe, delivering the physical infrastructure that makes classified work possible. We’re growing fast, operating across multiple markets, and building a company that takes both the mission and the business seriously.

About the Role

You will support the Government Delivery team by administering assigned government contracts, analyzing contract documents, negotiating routine agreements, and supporting proposal preparation. Reporting to the Senior Director of Government Delivery and working day to day with program managers and the Program Director, you exercise independent judgment on contract administration matters while acting at the direction of Government Delivery leadership. You identify contractual issues early, recommend resolutions, and guide teammates on contract administration principles and regulations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

At Nooks, we move fast. While you'll have clear ownership over your core responsibilities, startup life means priorities can shift. We're looking for a proactive problem-solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and ready to lean in wherever the team needs them most to drive us forward.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Administration

  • Administer assigned contracts from award setup and kickoff briefings through modifications and closeout, keeping files complete and audit-ready.
  • Serve as a point of contact for Contracting Officers and Contract Specialists on administrative matters for assigned contracts.
  • Coordinate between program teams and Finance on invoicing so billing matches contract terms, funding, and delivered work.

Performance and Compliance Monitoring

  • Monitor contract performance against delivery schedules, pricing, and terms, and identify when modifications, amendments, or extensions are needed.
  • Determine when customer-directed changes fall outside contract scope and raise them with Government Delivery leadership before work proceeds.
  • Track deliverables, reports, and Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) items for assigned contracts, alerting owners and escalating risk to the Program Director.

Agreements and Subcontracts

  • Negotiate and maintain nondisclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and subcontracts within policy and the approved fallback playbook, routing final versions for signature.
  • Flow down required Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) clauses, keeping subcontract provisions clear and compliant.
  • Monitor subcontractor performance with program managers, and investigate and recommend resolutions to claims, disputes, and complaints.

Pre-Award Support

  • Support solicitation reviews, compliance assessments, and teaming coordination in partnership with Growth.
  • Help prepare proposal contract documentation, including representations, certifications, and required forms, for leadership review and submission.
  • Draft solicitation questions and responses to customer data calls for leadership review.

The Skillset

  • Four or more years of government contracts administration experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS.
  • Experience supporting Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) and General Services Administration (GSA) Schedule contracts.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating NDAs, teaming agreements, and subcontracts.
  • Ability to identify contract risk and develop solutions to moderate and complex contractual issues.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction from program and department leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or Federal Acquisition Certification in Contracting (FAC-C), preferred.
  • Prior experience as a federal 1102 Contract Specialist, a plus.
  • Familiarity with the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) and Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS), a plus.
  • Experience with Other Transaction (OT) agreements or Intelligence Community customers, a plus.
  • An active Secret clearance, preferred. An active Top Secret clearance, a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

Yearly Bonus Structure + Equity Ownership

Premium Health Coverage

401(k) Employer Contribution

Flexible Time Away

Eligibility & Clearance

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. An active Secret clearance is preferred. All candidates must be eligible for and committed to obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government Secret security clearance as a condition of employment.

Location-Specific Addendums

You are not attached to a single Nooks site. You support contracts across Nooks locations, working remotely with travel as needed or from the Arlington, Virginia area. Government Delivery is still setting its standards, so you will help build the tracking and file practices the team runs on.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

Every assigned contract has a complete, audit-ready file, and its deliverables, options, and modifications are tracked and acted on before they become problems. Out-of-scope customer requests are identified and raised before work proceeds. Routine NDAs and teaming agreements move to signature without leadership involvement unless a term falls outside the playbook. Proposal contract documentation reaches leadership complete and on time. Program managers, the Program Director, and Finance rely on you for accurate answers on what each assigned contract requires.

Cross-Functional Expectations

You work most closely with program managers and the Program Director, acting at their direction on assigned contracts. You support Growth on pre-award reviews and coordinate with Finance on invoicing. Externally, you handle administrative matters with government Contracting Officers, Contract Specialists, and teaming partners. You do not sign agreements or submit proposals on behalf of Nooks.

Salary Range for all departments

Salary Range
$117,000—$130,000 USD

jobs.title: Clinical Supervisor, RDN (Part-time)
jobs.excerpt: About CookUnity:Food has lost its soul to modern convenience.
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the team:

The B2B team operates like a startup within CookUnity — entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and bold in its ambitions. We're building a new category at the intersection of food, healthcare, and outcomes-driven nutrition. Our Healthcare vertical is one of our highest-priority growth areas, and this role sits right at the center of it.

CookUnity is the leading chef-to-consumer platform connecting independent chefs with food lovers across the country. By combining culinary creativity with a powerful technology platform, we're redefining meal delivery and making chef-crafted meals more accessible than ever. Our mission is to empower chefs while delivering an exceptional food experience to customers nationwide.

About the Role:

CookUnity is building a clinical nutrition model to support the delivery of medically tailored meals (MTM) for members living with chronic conditions — primarily diabetes, cancer, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular disease. We work with a network of Registered Dietitian Nutritionists (RDNs), including 1099 contractors and subcontracted providers, to deliver nutrition assessments and nutrition education and counseling to members across diverse, medically complex populations.

The RD Supervisor will be the clinical anchor of this model. This is a part-time, fully remote role (~20 hours/week) for a seasoned RDN who brings deep clinical expertise, a passion for population health and food equity, and the judgment to translate evidence-based practice into scalable, culturally responsive care. You will work directly with CookUnity leadership and our two founding RDNs to co-develop the clinical framework, carry a focused direct-care caseload, and ensure every clinician in our network delivers consistent, high-quality care.

What You'll Do

This role ramps in three phases, though phases may overlap depending on contract timelines. The primary focus in the first 90 days is building the clinical model; direct patient care may begin concurrently if active contracts require it. Network supervision scales as the model and tools are in place.

Phase 1 — First 90 Days: Clinical Model Development (Primary Focus)

  • Develop a framework for building and growing the CookUnity RDN network — defining the clinical competencies, disease-area specializations, and cultural and linguistic attributes required of network providers, and establishing a structured recruitment and vetting process to ensure every RDN added to the network is aligned with the CookUnity model of care.
  • Co-develop disease-specific nutrition protocols for diabetes, oncology, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular conditions grounded in current evidence and clinical guidelines (ADA Standards of Care, ASCO, ACC/AHA, Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics Evidence-Based Practice Guidelines)
  • Define the nutrition assessment framework — intake tools, flagging criteria, and escalation pathways for medically complex members
  • Build structured visit frameworks for nutrition education and counseling (initial assessments, follow-up, and group modalities as applicable)
  • Integrate behavior change methodology — including Motivational Interviewing, Stages of Change, and SMART goal-setting — into care delivery standards
  • Establish culturally responsive practice standards to support care delivery across diverse patient communities
  • Develop clinical documentation standards, quality metrics, and outcome tracking aligned with plan and regulatory requirements
  • Build and curate a clinical resource library — including condition-specific patient education materials, counseling tools, and handouts — building on the existing nutrition assessment and education templates; the resource library will be the foundation for training and standardizing care delivery across the RDN network

Phase 2 — Direct Patient Care (May Begin Concurrently with Phase 1)

  • Carry a defined direct-care caseload (target: 8–12 active members) spanning diabetes, cancer, weight management with GLP-1s, and cardiovascular conditions
  • Conduct comprehensive nutrition assessments and develop individualized, person-centered care plans that incorporate medically tailored meal planning
  • Deliver evidence-based nutrition counseling and education using behavior change frameworks
  • Collaborate with health plan care teams and care coordinators on member care management and referral pathways

Phase 3 — Ongoing: RDN Network Supervision (As Model Matures)

  • Provide clinical oversight and quality assurance for the CookUnity RDN network; scope of supervision calibrated appropriately for 1099 contractors (clinical quality and protocol fidelity) versus subcontracted providers
  • Conduct regular chart audits and clinical case reviews to assess documentation quality, protocol adherence, and clinical appropriateness
  • Facilitate monthly peer review or case consultation sessions with the RDN network
  • Serve as the primary clinical escalation point for complex, high-acuity, or ethically sensitive cases
  • Lead onboarding and training of contracted and subcontracted RDNs to the CookUnity clinical model — including use of the standardized nutrition assessment, the nutrition education template, and the clinical resource library — to ensure consistent, model-faithful care delivery across the network
  • Identify individual and collective training needs; coordinate continuing education or skill-building resources for the network

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Active Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential in good standing with the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)
  • Active state dietitian licensure where required by state of practice (e.g., CDN in New York)
  • 5+ years of clinical RD experience with a meaningful focus on chronic disease management — diabetes, cardiovascular disease, oncology, weight management, or combinations thereof
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and nutrition counseling to vulnerable, medically complex, and/or diverse patient populations
  • Familiarity with behavior change frameworks, including Motivational Interviewing
  • Strong clinical documentation skills and comfort with telehealth or virtual care delivery
  • Self-directed and comfortable building processes in a fast-moving, start-up environment

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

  • CDCES — Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist (strongly preferred; required for certain plan contracts)
  • NBC-HWC — National Board Certified Health and Wellness Coach
  • CSO — Board Certified Specialist in Oncology Nutrition
  • CSOWM — Board Certified Specialist in Obesity and Weight Management (particularly relevant given GLP-1 meal line)
  • Washington State Licensed Dietitian (LD) licensure, or willingness to obtain (preferred for current contract pipeline; licensure support available)
  • FAND — Fellow of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics
  • Formal Motivational Interviewing training or certification (MINT network or equivalent)
  • Experience in medically tailored meal (MTM), food-as-medicine, or community-based nutrition programs
  • Prior experience supervising or mentoring RDNs, dietetic interns, or clinical nutrition staff

Benefits:

🩺 Health Insurance coverage

🌅 401k Plan

⛱ PTO policy and paid sick day

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle

👩🏾‍🏫 Personalized Spanish coach

🚀 Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

We are currently recruiting a Governance and Legal Operations Manager to join our Legal, Ethics & Compliance team.

This is a remote, permanent position open to candidates based in the UK. The role will be full-time, offering a salary of circa. £40k per annum.

At Relief International, we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work.

This role is classified as requiring standard pre-employment checks.

About Relief International

Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. Our teams work across Africa, Asia and the Middle East, delivering Health and Nutrition, WASH (Water, Sanitation and Hygiene), Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for community resilience. We work alongside local actors to deliver safe, inclusive and evidence-based programmes that reach those most in need.

About the Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to play a central role in the governance and legal operations of a global humanitarian organisation.

The Governance and Legal Operations Manager leads Relief International's corporate secretariat function and is responsible for ensuring the effective governance of the three entities that make up the Relief International network in the United States, United Kingdom and France. Working closely with the Chief Legal, Ethics & Compliance Officer, executive leadership and board members, you will ensure governance processes remain compliant, efficient and aligned across the organisation.

You will oversee board and committee governance, statutory compliance, senior leadership governance processes and legal operations systems, while also supporting compliance initiatives and legal risk management. This highly visible role requires exceptional organisation, discretion and stakeholder management skills, with regular interaction with board members, senior leaders and colleagues across multiple countries and time zones.

The successful candidate will help strengthen organisational accountability, support effective decision-making and ensure Relief International maintains the highest standards of governance and compliance across its global operations.

Your Responsibilities

This role includes the following responsibilities.

  • Lead the governance processes for Relief International's boards, committees and network-level governance bodies, ensuring meetings are well managed, compliant and effectively documented.
  • Manage governance calendars, board papers, resolutions, minutes, action logs and board member engagement across the three RI entities.
  • Coordinate Senior Leadership Team governance processes, including agendas, decision tracking, action management and escalation of matters requiring board approval.
  • Oversee statutory and regulatory compliance requirements across the US, UK and French entities, ensuring accurate and timely filings and governance records.
  • Manage legal operations systems, including powers of attorney, delegations of authority, signatory registers, entity registrations and legal records management.
  • Lead Relief International's annual conflict-of-interest declaration process and maintain governance compliance registers.
  • Conduct legal and compliance research on a range of topics including data protection, sanctions, safeguarding, anti-bribery and anti-money laundering requirements.
  • Develop governance tools, guidance materials and awareness resources that strengthen governance and compliance practices across the organisation.

About You

You will bring the following experience and skills.

  • Experience working in governance, legal operations, compliance, corporate secretariat, paralegal or related legal administration roles.
  • Strong experience supporting boards, committees and senior leadership teams, including preparation of governance documentation and minute-taking.
  • Demonstrated understanding of governance, regulatory and compliance issues relevant to non-profit organisations, including conflicts of interest, sanctions, anti-bribery and data protection.
  • Excellent organisational, project management and administrative skills, with exceptional attention to detail and quality assurance.
  • Strong judgement, integrity and discretion when handling confidential board, legal and executive matters.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work across international time zones and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Experience in an international NGO, multi-entity organisation or governance-intensive environment would be highly desirable. Familiarity with governance frameworks in the US, UK or France and working knowledge of French would be an advantage.

How To Apply

To apply for this post, click on the Apply button in the job advert page.

  • You will be asked to upload a CV and Cover Letter.
  • The cover letter should be one page and explain why you are interested in this post with Relief International and how your skills and experience make you a good fit.

Closing Date

October 8, 2026.

As a humanitarian organization, Relief International is committed to the safeguarding of all those we come into contact with through our work. We are committed to the core humanitarian principles regarding prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse. Relief International expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment and uphold the values and behaviours outlined in the Code of Conduct.

We’re looking for an Account Director, Strategic Accounts to help accelerate Trustonic’s growth across the North American wireless ecosystem.

As a global B2B SaaS business operating in the cybersecurity space, we help organisations manage risk and unlock opportunities by securing billions of connected devices across mobile, automotive, IoT, retail, and banking and payments.

This is a great opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who enjoys building strong customer relationships, navigating complex enterprise sales, and turning strategic opportunities into long-term commercial growth. You’ll have the opportunity to own larger strategic relationships, influence our growth strategy, and work closely with senior stakeholders across Trustonic and our customers.

As the Account Director, Strategic Accounts, you will:

Strategic account management

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts across North America

Commercial leadership

  • Work closely with Legal, Product, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to progress strategic opportunities
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and CRM records

Who you are...

  • A commercially driven and customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building long-term strategic relationships
  • Confident managing complex enterprise sales involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Comfortable balancing account management with new business development and pipeline generation
  • A strong communicator and negotiator who can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders
  • Commercially curious, proactive, and motivated by finding opportunities for growth
  • Organised and able to manage multiple strategic accounts and sales opportunities at different stages
  • Collaborative by nature, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams to deliver for customers

What makes you, you...

Experience

  • Proven experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, business development, or a similar commercial role
  • Demonstrable success managing complex sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders
  • Experience owning and growing strategic enterprise customer relationships
  • Strong experience in customer retention, account expansion, upselling, and new business development
  • Experience leading sales opportunities from initial engagement through to contract execution

  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience within telecommunications, wireless, SaaS, fintech, mobility, device lifecycle management, or related technology industries
  • Experience working with mobile operators, retailers, MVNOs, distributors, channel partners, or service providers

Desirable

  • Experience selling into enterprise technology organisations
  • Existing relationships or understanding of the North American wireless and connected device ecosystem

Skills & knowledge

  • Strong commercial acumen and an ability to identify and develop revenue opportunities
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong negotiation and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM discipline
  • A strategic, customer-focused approach with a clear focus on delivering measurable commercial outcomes

What we can provide you in return for your investment...

Competitive compensation

  • A base salary that reflects your expertise and impact.

Financial security & wellbeing

  • Private medical insurance for you and your family from day one.

Flexibility & work-life balance

Growth & development

Inclusive, supportive culture

We collaborate with professional and regulatory organizations, industry leaders, and other health care partners who support our mission. Our culture is one of openness, teamwork, risk taking and being at the cutting edge of our field and we only look for employees who hold these same traits.

Values mean more to AORN than just bullets on a page. They drive our daily decisions and impact how we work as an organization:

  • Innovation:Taking courageous and bold actions for growth and sustainability.
  • Communication:Exemplifying respect, collaboration, transparency and honesty.
  • Quality:Ensuring accountability and excellence.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusiveness:Promoting fairness, valuing differences, considering all perspectives.

Our Strategic Partnerships & Customer Success Manager supports the AORN Industry team by strengthening relationships with industry partners and internal stakeholders to advance adoption, retention, and growth of AORN educational solutions and industry offerings. This role manages post-sale customer success activities, supports renewal and expansion opportunities, coordinates partner and customer communications, and helps translate customer and industry feedback into actionable insights for product, education, marketing, and sales strategies. The position works collaboratively across AORN teams to ensure a consistent, high-value partner and customer experience that aligns with AORN’s mission and supports revenue goals.

AORN is based in Denver, CO. Our Strategic Partnerships & Customer Success Managerwill work remotely.

More about what you’ll get to do as our Strategic Partnerships & Customer Success Manager:

  • Owns customer onboarding, implementation follow-up, utilization monitoring, and ongoing customer engagement for AORN Industry educational solutions and partner programs.
  • Leads proactive quarterly business reviews with customers and partners to evaluate utilization, identify opportunities, address barriers, and reinforce the value of AORN offerings.
  • Drives renewal planning by maintaining clear timelines, account health indicators, stakeholder follow-up, and coordinated action plans for upcoming renewals.
  • Identifies at-risk accounts through utilization trends, customer feedback, engagement history, and renewal signals; leads outreach and escalation plans to improve retention.
  • Creates and maintains clear renewal forecasting, account status reporting, and a repeatable operating cadence that supports visibility, accountability, and revenue planning.
  • Partners with Industry Account Executives and Clinical Program Managers to secure renewal revenue, support expansion opportunities, and ensure customer needs are understood and addressed.
  • Maintains strong knowledge of AORN Industry offerings, educational solutions, sponsorship opportunities, and related products to identify renewal, expansion, cross-sell, and up-sell opportunities.
  • Builds and maintains trusted relationships with industry partners, facility customers, educators, executives, administrators, and decision makers involved in purchasing, implementation, and ongoing engagement.
  • Coordinates with Account Executives, Marketing, Education, Nursing, Customer Service, Finance, Technology, Sales, and Clinical Program Managers to deliver a seamless customer and partner experience.
  • Uses Salesforce, iMIS, Tableau, Definitive Healthcare, Excel, and other systems to maintain accurate account records, manage renewals, monitor utilization, support forecasting, and provide reports.
  • Gathers partner and customer feedback to identify market needs, educational gaps, product opportunities, customer risks, and process improvements.
  • Supports development of partner-facing materials, renewal communications, implementation resources, and customer success tools in collaboration with Marketing and Industry leadership.
  • Participates in interdepartmental and intradepartmental initiatives, meetings, and projects that support Industry team priorities, revenue goals, customer success, and AORN’s mission.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Must Have’s to be our Strategic Partnerships & Customer Success Manager:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Health Care Administration, Education, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of experience in customer success, account management, strategic partnerships, business development, sales support, or related relationship management responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage renewals, strengthen customer relationships, evaluate account needs, and support revenue retention and growth.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, and other tools used to manage accounts, analyze data, prepare forecasts, and identify operational issues.
  • Experience communicating professionally with customers, partners, executives, and internal stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Successful experience in consultative sales, strategic partnerships, sponsorship support, customer success, or account management with hospitals, surgery centers, health care companies, or associations.
  • Understanding of the perioperative, surgical facility, medical device, health care education, or association environment.
  • Knowledge of AORN, AORN Industry offerings, and educational solutions provided for the perioperative environment.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Excellent customer service orientation, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to prioritize work, strategize independently, manage competing deadlines, and help customers and partners create comprehensive programs.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to identify customer needs, recommend solutions, and support revenue retention and growth.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with personnel in the operating room, surgical, health care, association, and industry partner environments regarding AORN products and services.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, presentation, negotiation, and follow-up skills.

jobs.description:
The Academic Coach serves as the primary contact for learners from matriculation (orientation) through the completion of their program. The Academic Coach manages a pipeline of learners by coaching, motivating, mentoring, removing barriers, issue ownership through resolution, strategies for completion, and progress. They help learners clarify key decision-points and identify solutions and alternatives which align with the learners’ motivations and goals. The Academic Coach utilizes strong relationship-building and influencing skills resulting in positive learner behaviors and outcomes, contributing to overall learner success and persistence.
The Academic Coach is responsible for providing personalized interactions to assist learners in successfully navigating the path to achieve their educational goals. The Academic Coach will provide outreach at key milestones and based on identified behaviors throughout learners’ programs to help keep them on track and to assist with overcoming obstacles they encounter. Each interaction includes exploration of needs and provides personalized solutions to learners to effectively prepare them for long-term success.
The Academic Coach also works with faculty and other University partners to address learner concerns and to collaboratively define options to help learners overcome obstacles and achieve academic success.

Essential Duties

  • Academic Planning & Engagement

  • Leverage tools, systems and software applications to optimize advising engagement.
  • Build a relationship with the learner to encourage learner success and engagement
  • Utilize program analytics and outreach protocols to drive purpose-driven and transformational conversations.
  • Help learners navigate changes in their programs and plans and understand and respond to Capella-initiated changes
  • Explore alignment of learner’s educational and financial plans in relation to degree completion
  • Provide resources and refer learners to university support services

  • Progress Monitoring & Academic Risk Mitigation

jobs.title: SaaS Portfolio Sales Advisor (Remote | 100% FTE or Fractional)
jobs.excerpt: 🧬 About us With more than 60 SaaS and hosting brands, 4,000+ employees, operations across 23 European countries, and 3.
jobs.description:
🧬 About us

With more than 60 SaaS and hosting brands, 4,000+ employees, operations across 23 European countries, and 3.5 million customers,team.blueis one of Europe's leading digital service providers, empowering businesses with the tools they need to succeed online.

We place values such as privacy, transparency, innovation, and local customer support at the heart of everything we do, delivering trusted digital solutions tailored to local market needs.


❗IMPORTANT: on the nature of this role❗

This is a hands-on advisory role, not an operating one (you will not carry a number, own a P&L, or manage the companies’ sales teams.This role does not include commission or variable pay tied to a single company’s performance. If you would miss these responsibilities, this is not the role for you).

The profile that thrives in this role is a senior operator who has earned their stripes running sales, and who now gets more satisfaction from developing other leaders and businesses across a portfolio than from owning a single company’s quota.

What this role offers is influence across a portfolio of businesses, freedom from single-company politics, and real flexibility in how and when you work. Your job is to make our companies’ own sales leaders succeed by advising and coaching: success looks like a Head of Sales who runs a better business because you were there.


🎯 Mission & Core Purpose

As a Portfolio Sales Advisor, you will report to the Director of Growth and work for the SaaS division (a €300m ca revenue group of +15 software businesses, built through acquisition and spanning a wide range of products and markets, from social media management to point of sale) directly inside our companies (one or two at a time) to diagnose and improve their sales go-to-market. We are building a small central capability to support the sales and go-to-market performance of these businesses. This role is the senior advisory part of that: a proven sales leader who helps our companies’ own sales leaders get materially better.

You will embed with a company’s CEO and head of sales for a focused period, understand how they identify their ideal customers, how their funnel works end to end, how their team is structured and how they sell, and then help them fix what is holding them back and build what they are missing.


💼 Key Responsibilities

- Diagnose:focus on one or two companies at a time, embedding for a defined period of several months. Assess a company’s sales go-to-market quickly and honestly: ICP and segmentation, pipeline and conversion, team structure and roles, forecasting, and where revenue is leaking.
- Coach and build:work alongside each company’s CEO and Head of Sales to fix what is broken and build what is missing, staying long enough to make the change stick rather than handing over a slide deck and leaving. Authority comes from the mandate the division gives the role and from your own credibility as someone who has done the job, not from a reporting line. Central performance visibility, dashboards, and sales tooling are handled separately within the team. This role is the subject-matter expert, not the data engineer: you use the numbers; you do not build the pipes.
- Develop leaders:many of our sales leaders have grown into the role from within their company. A large part of this job is developing them: raising their game, not replacing them.
- Bring the outside in:carry modern sales best practices from company to company, so the portfolio compounds what works rather than each business learning it alone.
- Flag honestly:give the division a clear, unemotional read on where each company you work with genuinely stands, and where intervention will and will not pay off.


💡Experience & Skills

  • Sales leadership at scale:+10 years and a proven track record as a senior sales leader (VP of Sales, Sales Director, CRO, or equivalent) in B2B SaaS leadership roles with a European market focus and across more than one business or sales model, having carried and scaled a sales organisation (you have built pipeline, structured teams, fixed forecasting, and lived the problems you will be helping others solve).
    - Advisory temperament:genuine coach and developer of people skills, patient enough to build up a less experienced sales leader rather than talk over them. Credibility and presence to earn the trust of a company’s CEO and Head of Sales quickly, and to be listened to because of what you have done, not the title you hold. You are comfortable being accountable without being responsible, and effective without a reporting line.
    - Practical fit: working knowledge of modern sales operations, HubSpot and Salesforce environments, and the metrics that matter, enough to diagnose and advise credibly. You will not be asked to build or administer the tooling.
    - Happy to travel to and spend focused time inside our companies.
    - Full professional proficiency in English.


    👤 Added Values

    - Low ego, high credibility:you build trust with a wide range of people and let your work show your strengths rather than telling people about them.
    - Honest and direct:you speak the truth as you see it, kindly and clearly, and you present it with data rather than opinion.
    - Comfortable with ambiguity:you can walk into a business you do not know, orient fast, and be useful quickly.
    - Motivated by breadth:you are energised by helping several businesses improve, and you value scope and flexibility over the ownership and comp of a single-company operating seat.


    ⏱️ Flexible 100% FTE or Fractional

    We are open to this role being full-time or fractional. For the right senior operator who values flexibility, an arrangement of two to three days a week across the portfolio may suit both sides well.


    🌐 Location

    This is a remote-friendly function: you can work from wherever you're most productive in the world.
    For those based near one of our offices, if you enjoy a mix of remote and in-person work, you are welcome to take advantage of them.
    Wherever you’re based, this role involves working within a ±2 CET time frame to stay closely aligned with the rest of the team and make collaboration easy.

jobs.description:
Purpose Unlimited is an independent financial services company with an unrelenting focus on customer-centric innovation, delivered through technology-driven solutions. Led by entrepreneur Som Seif, the company is developing a diversified product platform aimed at addressing historically underserved segments of the market. Purpose Unlimited’s businesses include Purpose Investments, Advisor Solutions by Purpose, and Driven.

Vacancy Status: This is for a current vacancy

Job Description Who you are Customer behavior is a signal. Most companies collect it. Few know how to read it. You will be one of the early data science hires shaping how Purpose understands the clients on our wealth platform — and how the platform responds to what we learn. You'll build the measurement architecture, behavioral models, and causal infrastructure that connects product decisions to client outcomes. Not what looks like it works. What actually does. This is a foundational role at a foundational moment. The intelligence layer you build will shape how Purpose designs, measures, and evolves its platform for years — and increasingly, how our AI systems understand and serve the clients who depend on us. You're an engineer as much as a scientist — you own the work from raw event data to deployed system, and you hold yourself accountable for whether it changed how the business operates. What AI does so you don't have to

  • Recurring insight generation — automated analytics workflows run on schedule with defined guardrails. You design the system and own the governance; you don't write the weekly summary.
  • Boilerplate feature engineering — AI coding assistants accelerate pipeline construction from event data. You define what to build and review what the tools produce.
  • First-pass segmentation refreshes — classification and scoring jobs re-run automatically. You set the standards and monitor for drift, you don't rerun the job.
  • Standard visualization and reporting — AI tools increasingly generate monitoring views from structured data. You define what signals matter; the generation is handled.

What only you can do

  • Determine what is worth measuring — in a platform generating thousands of behavioral signals, the most valuable judgment is deciding which three metrics actually reflect client value and which are vanity.
  • Push back on attribution that flatters — AI systems generate correlations at scale. You are the person who asks whether the relationship is causal, whether the experiment is valid, and whether the conclusion will hold when the business acts on it.
  • Translate behavioral reality into a measurable operating model — starting from how clients actually make financial decisions, not from how the product team assumes they do.
  • Design AI analytics systems with the rigor of a statistician — evaluating LLM-generated insights with the same calibration and drift standards you apply to your own models.
  • Build the institutional trust that makes product and business leaders act on quantitative findings, including findings they didn't want.

What you will own

  • The client intelligence architecture: the measurement model that maps how clients discover, onboard, activate, and engage with Purpose's wealth platform — with FOMs that connect platform activity to real client outcomes.
  • Behavioral models that change decisions: client segmentation, lifecycle classification, churn prediction, propensity scoring, and behavioral clustering — validated against real outcomes and governed for drift.
  • Causal measurement with discipline: experiment design and analysis, causal inference when experiments aren't possible, and a consistent standard for what counts as evidence that a product or AI intervention actually worked.
  • Agentic analytics governance: you set the standards for what AI-generated insight requires human review, what guardrails govern automated outputs, and how the intelligence layer stays accurate and auditable in a regulated environment.

What you must bring

  • Deep fluency in Python and SQL — owning work end-to-end from raw event data to deployed software, with production-grade testing and documentation standards.
  • Proven experience building and evaluating predictive models in production-like settings: classification, survival models, segmentation, scoring, calibration, and cost-sensitive decision frameworks.
  • Applied causal inference — A/B testing, matching/propensity, diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity. You know the difference between a valid experiment and a flattering one.
  • Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or equivalent) — you treat data access controls, model auditability, and responsible use of customer data as core professional standards.

What will set you apart

  • You've been early on a data science or analytics team and built measurement and modeling foundations before the playbook existed — you know what it means to make something from scratch that others depend on.
  • You have experience evaluating LLMs or AI-generated outputs with statistical rigor: calibration, drift detection, bias assessment. You apply the same skepticism to AI outputs that you apply to your own models.
  • You've used AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine productivity multiplier in data science workflows.
  • You have applied behavioral economics or behavioral finance principles to how you designed metrics or interpreted client behavior — you think about why clients make financial decisions, not just what they do.

What success looks like in your first year

  • A measurement architecture is live — FOMs that connect platform activity to client outcomes are defined, instrumented, and being used by product and business leaders to make decisions they couldn't make before.
  • At least two behavioral models are in production — churn prediction, propensity scoring, or lifecycle classification — with monitoring, documentation, and governance that any engineer on the team can maintain.
  • Causal measurement is the standard — at least one major product or AI intervention has been evaluated with a valid causal method, and the findings have changed how the team approaches attribution.
  • The AI analytics layer has governance — the standards for what AI-generated insight requires human review, and what guardrails govern automated output, are defined, documented, and in use.
  • You've become the person that product and business leaders bring their hardest measurement questions to — because they trust that what you tell them reflects reality, including when reality is inconvenient.

Every role at Purpose is assessed against our five values:

  • Innovation – You bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find better ways of building. You don’t wait for permission to experiment.
  • Courage – You speak up when something isn’t working, take difficult stands on technical quality, and act with conviction even when it’s uncomfortable.
  • Owner’s Mindset – You take full accountability for your squad’s outcomes. You treat the platform, the team, and the business as your own.
  • Client Focus – You place client outcomes at the center of every architectural and delivery decision.
  • Winning Through Individual and Collective Growth – You invest in your own development and actively contribute to the growth of every engineer around you.

Why should you join us?

  • We are one of Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers' 2023, 2024, 2025 & 2026.
  • We believe in innovation and a vibrant culture - work for an innovative, people-first, financial services firm that values entrepreneurialism.
  • We believe in a flexible work structure – A flexible hybrid work model that empowers you to do your best work whether at home or the office.
  • We care about your rewards - Competitive compensation including equity program.
  • We care about your health – comprehensive group health and dental benefits and life insurance at little to no cost to you. We also offer a Lifestyle Spending Account for all your wellness needs.
  • We care about your quality of life - flexible paid time-off policy with unlimited vacation days, and flexible sick and mental health days.
  • We care about your family - Paid parental leave for eligible employees with a top-up.
  • We care about your future – Generous Group RRSP matching and an optional TFSA program.
  • We care about your development – We offer training opportunities and tuition support year-round.

Purpose Unlimited is an equal employer and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier-free work environment for all employees and candidates. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and if accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of the People & Culture team at . We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted. Our work philosophy is a hybrid model allowing for flexibility and collaboration. Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Immigration sponsorship is not offered for this role. We may use artificial intelligence technology to assist in screening, assessing, or selecting applicants for this position. Final hiring decisions are made by qualified human reviewers.

The Role, Analytics Engineer I
- this role is based for applicants located in Canada

We’re the highest-rated EHS platform on Gartner-owned Capterra, empowering field teams and safety leaders to replace paperwork, boost compliance, and drive real-time visibility where it matters most.

The group brings together more than 15 specialised brands, including GoCanvas, Bluebeam, FirmusAI, Nevaris, AllPlan, VectorWorks, and SpaceWell, serving customers across the full AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction & Operations) spectrum. Position Overview:

As an Analystics Engineer I, you will entail collaborating with multiple teams across the organization to evaluate our customer’s data needs, design data models, and produce effective data visualizations to enable data-driven decision making. There will be numerous opportunities to influence our analytics strategy, contribute to best practices, and mentor other team members.

  • Produce clear, effective data visualizations and dashboards using BI platforms to enable data-driven decision making.

  • Contribute to and help evolve analytics best practices, standards, and documentation.
  • Mentor and support fellow team members, serving as a knowledgeable resource for the broader organization.

What You Bring:
  • 1-3 years of SQL experience, including writing and optimizing complex queries

  • Interdependence - We build systems that require everyone to perform with excellence, we are a team, and we succeed or fail together.

  • Data Driven Decisions - Because wisdom requires understanding the facts of the matter, disputes between competing perspectives are resolved with data.
